title: Lead Workday Specialist
description:
Wood Mackenzie is the global leader in analytics, insights and proprietary data across the entire energy and natural resources landscape.

  

For over 50 years our work has guided the decisions of the world’s most influential energy producers, utilities companies, financial institutions and governments.

  

Now, with the world’s energy system more complex and interconnected than ever before, sector\-specific views are no longer enough. That’s why we’ve redefined what’s possible with Intelligence Connected.  



  

By fusing our unparalleled proprietary data with the sharpest analytical minds, all supercharged by Synoptic AI, we deliver a clear, interconnected view of the entire value chain. Our trusted team of 2,700 experts across 30 countries breaks siloes and connects industries, markets and regions across the globe.

  

This empowers our customers to identify risk sooner, spot opportunities faster and recalibrate strategy with confidence – whether planning days, weeks, months or decades ahead.

  

Wood Mackenzie  

Intelligence Connected

 **WoodMac.com**

 **Wood Mackenzie Brand Video**

**Wood Mackenzie Values**

* Inclusive – we succeed together
* Trusting – we choose to trust each other
* Customer committed – we put customers at the heart of our decisions
* Future Focused – we accelerate change
* Curious – we turn knowledge into action

**Role Purpose:**


With broad directions and plans and working with the Senior Manager – Digital HR, support the Workday application within Wood Mackenzie to include, incident management, delivery of enhancements and small projects and participation in the delivery of larger projects. You will work with key stakeholders to understand business requirements, define scope and understand dependencies, allowing you to ensure stability, reliability and data security on the existing Workday platform whilst supporting a continually evolving and growing business through ensuring successful and timely delivery on requirements for enhancements and projects.

**Main Responsibilities:**

* Work to resolve any issues and requests from users relating to the Workday platform working with 3rd party support providers and Workday when required
* Help manage requests for day\-to\-day data maintenance to include but not limited to user access and security, master data values, complex organisational changes
* Work towards becoming a Wood Mackenzie solutions expert on the Workday platform understanding all key components and reliance and integration on other systems
* Contribute to a rolling release program of enhancements and reporting requests as prioritised by the Senior Manager – Digital HR and Business Solutions Governance Board
* Work within the Workday team to understand the application roadmap including the content of the periodic releases and how any changes will impact existing processes, support communication of these impacts to the key stakeholders
* Support testing and regression testing of changes, periodic updates and integrations within the HR systems area
* Support the business to write requirements documents and translate them into functional design documents for complex enhancements and interfaces
* Ensure all process and knowledge share information and tools are kept up to date as the business and processes evolve.
* Support internal and external audit activities as required and ensure that the controls supporting the Workday solution within Wood Mackenzie reflects the governance standards required
* Ensure data privacy remains at the core of everything we do on the platform

**About You:**

* An experienced HR systems support professional with a passion and a genuine interest for Workday HR cloud technologies and products developed over 5\+ years
* Experienced in supporting and configuring Workday HCM, Compensation, Recruiting and Talent Optimisation for a global organisation.
* Experience of working in a business applications environment using Workday technology
* Ability to understand complex business process flows and the data dependencies within them
* Experienced in communicating with HR business stakeholders
* Experience as a HR professional preferred
* Workday Pro or Certification desirable

**Expectations:**

* We are a hybrid working company and the successful applicant will be expected to be physically present in the office at least 2 days per week to foster and contribute to a collaborative environment, but this may be subject to change in the future.
* While this is expected to be a full\-time role, part\-time arrangements will be considered.
* Due to the global nature of the team, a degree of flexible working will be required to accommodate different time zones being worked within our team and our wider business.


\#LI\-DB1

 **Equal Opportunities**

  

We are an equal opportunities employer. This means we are committed to recruiting the best people regardless of their race, colour, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, disability or protected veteran status. You can find out more about your rights under the law at www.eeoc.gov

title: HR Executive
description:
HR Executive

Company: Dr Sachin Mittal Advanced DentistryLocation: Hisar, HaryanaJob Type: Full\-time

About the Clinic

Dr Sachin Mittal Advanced Dentistry is a NABH\-accredited, state\-of\-the\-art dental clinic in Hisar, with a strong focus on advanced dentistry, dental implants, cosmetic dentistry, and digital dentistry.

We are looking for a proactive and responsible HR Executive to manage our growing team and establish strong HR systems and processes.

Job Responsibilities

* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for doctors, dentists, dental assistants, front\-office staff, telecallers, housekeeping, and other clinic positions.
* Prepare job descriptions and post vacancies on Indeed and other recruitment platforms.
* Screen CVs, conduct initial interviews, and coordinate final interviews with management.
* Manage employee joining, onboarding, induction, and exit formalities.
* Maintain employee files, HR records, attendance, leave, and salary\-related information.
* Coordinate monthly payroll inputs with the accounts department.
* Monitor employee attendance, punctuality, discipline, and workplace behaviour.
* Coordinate employee performance reviews and appraisals.
* Identify training requirements and organise staff training programs.
* Develop and implement HR policies, rules, and SOPs.
* Handle employee grievances and resolve routine HR issues professionally.
* Promote teamwork, professionalism, accountability, and a patient\-centric work culture.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee and clinic information.
* Support NABH\-related HR documentation, training records, and compliance requirements.
* Prepare regular HR reports for management.
* Take responsibility for day\-to\-day HR and administrative activities.

Skills Required

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong recruitment and employee\-management skills.
* Good knowledge of HR processes and documentation.
* Good command of MS Office / Google Workspace.
* Strong organisational and multitasking abilities.
* Good problem\-solving and conflict\-management skills.
* Professional, mature, and disciplined approach.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership.

Qualifications

* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources preferred.
* Graduate candidates with relevant HR experience may also apply.
* Experience in a hospital, dental clinic, healthcare, or service organisation will be an advantage.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate should be people\-oriented but firm on discipline, organised, proactive, and comfortable managing a diverse healthcare team. Experience in managing recruitment and HR operations for a growing organisation will be highly valued.

What We Offer

* Professional and growth\-oriented working environment.
* Opportunity to work with a leading advanced dental healthcare organisation.
* Exposure to structured HR and NABH\-oriented systems.
* Career growth opportunities.
* Competitive salary based on experience and capability.

To Apply: Submit your updated CV through Indeed. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

* Conduct structured Training Needs Analysis (TNA) across Sales, Service, and enabling functions.

* Calendarize and deliver role\-based learning programs that support productivity improvement and cross\-product selling.

* Address capability gaps identified through TNA and mid\-year business feedback.
* Facilitate group\-wide programs through TTT certifications and collaborate with ecosystem learning teams to improve overall Learning Index and training coverage
  

Induction \& Cross\-LOB Enablement  

* Drive structured induction programs for all new hires, including frontline salesforce.
* Ensure full learning coverage and accelerated ramp\-up of new joinees.
* Deliver multi\-product capability programs across AMC and broader ABC ecosystem.
* Identify early performance or capability gaps and escalate appropriately to Zonal Heads/HRBPs.
  

Productivity Reinforcement \& Learning Impact  

* Monitor on\-the\-job implementation of training through structured follow\-ups.
* Partner with Zonal and Regional leaders to identify low productivity cohorts and design targeted reinforcement interventions.
* Analyze periodic performance data in collaboration with Business and HR teams to measure learning effectiveness and refine interventions.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers.
   

  

 Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked \#153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full\-stack portfolio of AI\-enabled, AI\-ready, and AI\-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world\-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992\) (ADR: LNVGY).
   

  

 This transformation together with Lenovo’s world\-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.
   

  

**About Lenovo**
 Lenovo is a global technology leader in AI infrastructure, high\-performance computing (HPC), and data center solutions. Through its AI Cloud and Data Center Services (AICDS) organization, Lenovo enables customers to design, deploy, and scale next\-generation accelerated computing environments.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 We are hiring a
 **Technical Project Manager** 
 to join the Global AICDS team. This role leads the delivery of complex AI infrastructure and data center projects, while also supporting bid and pre\-sales activities to ensure successful project execution.
   

  

 You will manage end\-to\-end deployments, validate delivery assumptions, and coordinate across global teams, customers, and partners to deliver projects on time, within scope, and within budget.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of AI infrastructure projects, including GPU clusters, HPC environments, and data center deployments
* Manage project scope, timelines, budgets, risks, and dependencies
* Ensure alignment with Statement of Work (SOW) and project deliverables
* Support bid and pre\-sales activities by validating technical and delivery assumptions
* Collaborate with sales, solution architects, procurement, and delivery teams
* Coordinate multi\-vendor and cross\-functional teams across geographies
* Establish project governance including reporting, communication plans, and escalation management
* Track financial performance and drive resolution of project risks and issues
* Support transition of completed projects into operations or managed services


**Skills Experience**
**Must\-have**
* 5\+ years of project management experience in technical or infrastructure environments
* Experience delivering AI infrastructure, HPC, GPU clusters, or data center projects
* Strong stakeholder management across customers and global teams
* Experience in bid support, proposal validation, or pre\-sales project planning
* Knowledge of project governance, risk management, and delivery frameworks
* PMP / PRINCE2 or equivalent certification
* Strong communication skills (written and verbal English)


**Good\-to\-have**
* Experience with NVIDIA ecosystems or GPU\-based platforms
* Exposure to hyperscale or cloud service provider environments
* Knowledge of data center infrastructure (power, cooling, networking)
* Experience with Agile or hybrid delivery models
* Familiarity with cluster deployment, benchmarking, and validation

**Internship Duration:** 6 Months  
**Stipend:** ₹12,000 per month

About the Role

We are looking for a proactive and detail\-oriented **HR Intern** to join our Human Resources team. This internship is a great opportunity for someone who is interested in building a career in HR and wants hands\-on exposure to recruitment, onboarding, employee engagement, HR administration, and other HR functions.

* Support employee engagement activities and events.

description:
**We're looking for a**
**Principal Product Manager \- HR Platforms \& Technology**
===========================================================


**This role is** **Office Based, Hyderabad Office****Principal Product Manager \| HR Technology \& Platforms \| Hyderabad**
  

  

**Summary**


Cornerstone OnDemand is seeking a Principal Product Manager to grow our performance and talent management agent portfolio, leading the delivery of AI\-native products and enterprise outcome agents that drive measurable customer value.
  

This is a customer\-facing AI\-native product management role for a hands\-on PM who can move quickly from customer discovery and requirements to working prototypes, using modern AI\-native product development tools such as Lovable, Claude, Co\-Pilot and similar platforms. The role requires close collaboration with customers, FDEs, engineering, and cross\-functional teams to validate solutions early, iterate rapidly, and launch outcome agents that solve meaningful business problems. As our agent portfolio grows, individual agents increasingly work together to compound value for customers, and this role will help shape how new agents fit into that broader picture.
  

The ideal candidate is highly execution\-oriented, comfortable working in ambiguity, and able to translate customer needs into prototypes, product direction, and shipped capabilities with speed and rigor


**About the Team**


You'll join a growing product team building AI\-native agents for the performance and talent management domain, part of a broader portfolio of enterprise outcome agents at Cornerstone. Our agents help enterprise customers connect everyday work to business outcomes, from goal\-setting to performance reviews to coaching and development. As the portfolio expands, we're increasingly focused on how individual agents can work together to create more value than any single agent alone. This role is an opportunity to help shape that next chapter, taking ownership of new agent areas as the team grows.


**What Success Looks Like**


In your first 6 to 12 months, you will:
* Take end\-to\-end ownership of one or more new agent initiatives within the performance and talent domain, from customer discovery through working prototype.
* Build strong relationships with customers, FDEs, and engineering partners, establishing a fast, repeatable feedback loop between discovery and prototype iteration.
* Ship a working AI\-native prototype that customers and internal stakeholders can review, test, and validate against real business problems.
* Identify meaningful opportunities for your agent(s) to complement others in the portfolio, contributing to how the team thinks about multi\-agent value.
* Establish yourself as a trusted, execution\-oriented voice on the team, someone who can take ambiguous customer problems and turn them into shipped product direction with minimal oversight

**In This Role You Will**


* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of new AI\-native products and enterprise outcome agents within the performance and talent management domain, from customer discovery and requirements gathering through prototype creation, iteration, and launch.
* Partner directly with customers to understand business problems, workflows, pain points, and desired outcomes in performance management, goal\-setting, and talent development.
* Translate customer needs into clear product requirements, use cases, and solution concepts that can quickly be tested and refined.
* Identify opportunities for new agents to complement existing ones in the portfolio, contributing to a cohesive experience as agents are increasingly deployed together.
* Build and evolve working prototypes using AI\-native tools such as Lovable, Claude, Co\-Pilot and similar rapid prototyping platforms, using prototypes as the new PRD motion so customers, FDEs, and engineering can review, test, and refine solutions directly.
* Collaborate closely with FDEs and engineering to validate feasibility, refine user flows, and prepare solutions for launch, working in tight feedback loops to confirm value and shape deliverable product capabilities.
* Drive cross\-functional execution across product, engineering, design, data science, architecture, and go\-to\-market teams to bring validated concepts into production.
* Turn customer specific outcome agents into re\-sellable out\-of\-the box agents.
* Ensure launched outcome agents are practical, scalable, and easy for enterprise customers to adopt.
* Use customer feedback, adoption signals, and business\-impact metrics to continuously improve product execution and outcomes.


**You Have Got What it Takes If you Have**


* 5\+ years of experience in product management, including significant experience delivering enterprise software, SaaS, AI, or platform products.
* Hands\-on experience using AI\-native prototyping and product development tools such as Lovable, Claude, Co\-Pilot or similar tools to accelerate product definition and validation.
* Strong track record in customer\-facing product delivery for enterprise SaaS or AI\-native products.
* Demonstrated ability to go from customer discovery and requirements to working prototypes and launched solutions.
* Experience collaborating closely with customers and technical delivery partners such as FDEs to iterate rapidly and launch customer\-ready solutions.
* Strong product execution skills, including prioritization, prototype validation, release planning, cross\-functional coordination, and delivery tracking.
* Experience translating ambiguous customer problems into structured product requirements and testable product experiences.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to operate effectively in fast\-moving, matrixed environments and drive alignment across technical and business teams.

Preferred Qualifications
* Experience in the performance management or broader HR technology space, for example goal\-setting platforms, performance review tools, or coaching and enablement platforms.
* Experience contributing to a multi\-product or multi\-agent portfolio, with an understanding of how individual products can be designed to work well together.
* Experience delivering AI agents, copilots, workflow agents, or decision\-support products.
* Demonstrated success using rapid prototyping to accelerate product\-market fit and customer adoption.
* Experience working in close partnership with customer success, services, sales, and solution delivery teams.

  

  

**Our Culture:**


Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.


**Who We Are:**


Cornerstone powers the potential of organizations and their people to thrive in a changing world. Cornerstone Galaxy, the complete AI\-powered workforce agility platform, meets organizations where they are. With Galaxy, organizations can identify skills gaps and development opportunities, retain and engage top talent, and provide multimodal learning experiences to meet the diverse needs of the modern workforce. More than 7,000 organizations and 100 million\+ users in 180\+ countries and in nearly 50 languages use Cornerstone Galaxy to build high\-performing, future\-ready organizations and people today.

title: Talent Acquisition Lead
description:
About Us  

We are India's first 60\-minute fashion delivery platform, bringing curated, trend\-forward clothing and accessories to consumers within an hour across Bengaluru. We are building India's premium quick\-commerce destination for fashion\-where trend, speed, and curation come together for the modern, style\-conscious consumer.  

Backed by a recent $10M Series A funding round led by top\-tier global venture capital firms, we are one of the fastest\-funded fashion\-tech startups in India. We are aggressively scaling our core teams across tech, product, design, merchandising, category management, and operations, and we are looking for a relentless TA Lead to drive hyper\-growth hiring.  

The Role  

As our Talent Acquisition Lead, you will take complete ownership of our end\-to\-end talent engine. You will partner directly with the Founders, Business Heads, and Hiring Managers to build and execute high\-velocity hiring roadmaps.  

This is not an administrative HR role\-it is a fast\-paced, high\-ownership mandate for a hands\-on recruiting leader who thrives in early\-stage, 0\-to\-1 environments, loves headhunting exceptional talent, and knows how to close top\-tier candidates fast.  

Key Responsibilities  

End\-to\-End Ownership: Own the entire recruitment lifecycle across non\-tech and tech verticals\-including Fashion Design, Merchandising, E\-Commerce/Shopify Operations, Product, Marketing, and Field Ops.  

Proactive Sourcing \& Headhunting: Leverage non\-traditional sourcing channels, deep Boolean search, LinkedIn Recruiter, GitHub, Behance/Dribbble, and talent networks to build strong active and passive candidate pipelines.  

Stakeholder Partnership: Work closely with Founders and Vertical Heads to understand team capacity plans, craft role profiles, and set clear scorecard\-based evaluation frameworks.  

Candidate Experience: Ensure a transparent, seamless, and high\-touch candidate journey from initial outreach to offer negotiation and onboarding.  

Data\-Driven Recruiting: Track, analyze, and optimize core TA metrics\-including Time\-to\-Hire, Cost\-per\-Hire, Sourcing Channel ROI, Offer Acceptance Rates, and Pipeline Velocity.  

Employer Branding: Help establish our company as the premier employer brand in the quick\-commerce and fashion\-tech space through engaging talent campaigns and campus/industry outreach.  

What We Are Looking For  

Experience: 4 to 8 years of core talent acquisition experience, with a heavy emphasis on early\-stage, high\-growth startup environments (Series A/B preferred).  

Multi\-Discipline Hiring: Proven success hiring across cross\-functional domains (Retail/Fashion/Category, Creative, Operations, and Core Tech).  

Headhunting Prowess: Strong outbound sourcing DNA; someone who relies on proactive outreach and market mapping rather than just waiting for inbound applications.  

Speed \& Agility: Demonstrated capability of closing high\-priority positions within aggressive turnaround times without compromising on talent quality.  

Negotiation \& Closing: Excellent interpersonal communication and negotiation skills with a proven track record of converting passive talent into enthusiastic hires.  

Availability: Immediate joiners or candidates with a notice period of 15 days or less.  

Why Join Us?  

Hyper\-Growth Phase: Be at the center of building the foundational team for India's fastest\-growing fashion\-tech platform.  

High Visibility: Direct collaboration with the Founding Team and functional leaders.  

Compensation: Competitive salary, performance bonuses, and wealth creation opportunities via ESOPs.  

Culture: High ownership, fast\-paced execution, and a flat hierarchy where great work is recognized immediately.

From our roots in agricultural inspections, Control Union have been operating for over 100 years and by now are engaged in many fields including inspections, certifications, logistics, collateral management and risk management etc. Our in\-depth knowledge and experience covers all aspects of the supply chain in many industries including agriculture, textile, energy, forestry and sustainability etc.

title: Instructional Designer
description:
Req ID:524691

  


At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high\-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, more than 80 000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

  



Alstom is hiring a Training Development Manager to support the growing Bid, Project, Planning Management Academy. In this role, you will oversee learning \& competencies development by defining, designing and creating the global training curriculum for the global Bid \& Project Management as well as Commercial communities.



Purpose:



The role is key to enable our global communities with the best knowledge of Tender, Project and Commercial Management processes and usage of applications and tools. All aspects of competency and capabilities need to be continuously developed and updated to cover the actual business demand of Alstom operating model. Bid and Project Management competencies are to be defined and developed as per Learning and Development roadmap for the academy to ensure a global approach across Regions and Product Lines.

  



Main Responsibilities:



Main point of contact reporting to the Senior Training Manager for all operational aspects of competence development regarding the global training offer and the Academy digital learning global catalog offer in Alstom University.


Continuously develop and update based on defined job competencies, the learning and development strategy to cover growing community and business demand of Alstom operating model.


* Manage and coordinate the development and deployment of the global training curriculum for the community to complement existing offer on Academy digital page. Align with other function / métiers, Alstom University and HR, across all Regions and Product Lines to ensure a high level of competency development.
  


* Based on competency/training gaps and learning orientation roadmap, follow\-up training development roadmap with Métier Owner/Subject Matter Expert to ensure timely delivery of various projects in parallel.

  


* Build a strong link between the competency matrixes for each Métier and the learning curriculum. Based on available learning material and yearly competency development gap analysis per métier, identify weak areas and propose corrective actions for training development.

  


* Coordinate training definition, design developments including updates/enhancements of training material with Subject Matter Experts and potentially external agencies.

If an external development is needed, support Request for Proposal process by synthesizing request and following up proposals and selection.


If an internal development is needed, Create/Review training material to ensure compliance with objectives and user\-friendly digital training experience in partnership when required with Alstom University for complex developments.

  


* Liaise with Alstom University to ensure timely deployment as per defined training target audience and format. Follow\-up on participation and feedback to propose any corrective action.

title: Control Business Partner – ICG / TIPMO / Others
description:
**About Northern Trust**

  

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.  



  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.  



  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.  



  

  

**Job Description:** Control Business Partner – TIPMO / ICG / Others (Suggested Designation : Infrastructure Risk \& Control Analyst – TIPMO / Shared Governance)

**Location:** Pune

**Job Description**
-------------------


Northern Trust is seeking a new team member to join the Infrastructure Control Governance team as a Control Business Partner aligned to TIPMO, ICG, and other shared governance functions. This role will provide embedded advisory support across project governance, infrastructure delivery oversight, reporting, documentation, and cross\-functional control activities. The position will work closely with project managers, TIPMO governance, ADO capability teams, ICG leads, and infrastructure stakeholders to improve control execution, strengthen evidence quality, surface risks early, and support a disciplined governance operating model across project and shared service functions.

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**
------------------------

* **Project \& Governance Risk Support –** Assess risks and controls across TIPMO and related governance activities including initiation, planning, execution, change control, closure, reporting, and project artifact quality.
* **Control Design \& Operating Effectiveness Reviews –** Evaluate design and operating effectiveness of key project governance and shared\-service controls; identify control gaps, process breakdowns, and opportunities to simplify or automate governance activities.
* **Planning \& Approval Readiness –** Support review of project planning artifacts, risk mitigation plans, communication plans, governance gates, and design approval evidence to improve readiness and consistency before projects move forward.
* **Issue \& Action Plan Governance –** Partner with owners to track governance\-related findings and action plans, validate remediation quality, and escalate aging or high\-impact items to the appropriate leadership forums.
* **KRI / KPI \& Executive Reporting –** Prepare metrics, dashboards, and concise reporting views on project governance health, delivery risk, artifact compliance, and recurring themes for leadership, control meetings, and oversight councils.
* **Documentation \& Evidence Management –** Help ensure project and governance documentation is complete, current, version controlled, and audit\-ready across repositories such as SharePoint, ADO, OneNote, Clarity, and associated tooling.
* **ADO / ServiceNow / Governance Tooling Advisory –** Support the practical use of enterprise tooling for planning, tracking, evidence retention, and governance transparency; identify enhancements that strengthen traceability and control consistency.
* **Cross\-Functional Coordination –** Serve as a liaison among TIPMO governance, ADO capability teams, infrastructure stakeholders, control officers, and ICG functions to align expectations, close gaps, and improve response times.
* **Broader Shared Governance Support –** Provide flexible risk and control support to adjacent ICG or other shared governance domains as priorities evolve, including audit support, reporting initiatives, documentation governance, and operational process reviews.
* **Assessment Documentation \& Evidence –** Produce audit\-ready assessment packs, walkthrough records, risk summaries, and evidence repositories using approved tools and templates with strong version control and traceability. Participate in RCSA exercise for Infrastructure Tower RAU.

**REQUIRED SKILLS**
-------------------


As a partner at Northern Trust, you must actively manage and mitigate risk and act with integrity. In accordance with our core values of service, integrity, and expertise, you are expected to:

* Adhere to all applicable risk management programs, policies, and procedures.
* Complete all mandatory training by the deadline.

* Escalate employee relations, policy or other non\-routine matters to the appropriate HR Business Partner.

**Process Improvement \& Reporting**

*Drives Results • Ensures Accountability • Collaborates*

* Maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), process documentation and guidance for HR Shared Services activities.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve service delivery and reduce manual administration through HR system workflows and automation.

This role operates within a global HR Shared Services environment supporting employees and managers across multiple countries and time zones. The successful individual will be expected to manage competing priorities while maintaining high standards of accuracy, confidentiality, compliance and customer service.


This job description outlines the general scope and expectations of the role and is not intended to represent a complete or exhaustive list of responsibilities. Duties may evolve in line with business requirements and the continued development of Unilode’s HR Shared Services model.

description:
**Job Title:** Analyst \- Recruitment

**Location:** Chandigarh/Mohali

**About Us:** eClerx is a leading provider of Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) services in the telecom industry. We specialize in delivering high\-quality, cost\-effective solutions to our clients, helping them streamline their operations and improve customer satisfaction.

**Job Overview:** As a Recruitment Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the acquisition of top talent for our BPO operations in the telecom sector. You will be responsible for sourcing, screening, and selecting candidates who possess the skills and expertise necessary to excel in various roles within our organization.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Talent Sourcing:** Utilize various channels such as job boards, social media platforms, networking events, and referrals to attract potential candidates with telecom industry experience.
* **Candidate Screening:** Review resumes and applications to assess candidates' qualifications, experience, and suitability for available positions.
* **Interview Coordination:** Schedule and conduct interviews with candidates, both in\-person and via video conferencing, to evaluate their technical skills, cultural fit, and alignment with our organizational values.
* **Candidate Assessment:** Administer assessments and tests, as needed, to evaluate candidates' competency and proficiency in relevant areas.
* **Collaboration:** Work closely with hiring managers and department heads to understand their staffing needs and develop tailored recruitment strategies.
* **Candidate Relationship Management:** Build and maintain positive relationships with candidates throughout the recruitment process, providing timely communication and feedback.
* **Market Research:** Stay updated on industry trends, best practices, and competitor activities to inform recruitment strategies and decision\-making.
* **Data Management:** Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records of candidate information, interviews, and hiring status using our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) or other relevant tools.
* **Compliance:** Ensure compliance with all relevant employment laws, regulations, and company policies throughout the recruitment process.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Identify opportunities to optimize and streamline recruitment processes, driving efficiency and effectiveness in talent acquisition.

**Qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Fresher or Proven experience in recruitment, preferably within the telecom or BPO industry.
* Familiarity with applicant tracking systems and other recruitment tools.
* Strong understanding of recruitment best practices, sourcing techniques, and candidate assessment methods.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment with changing priorities.
* High level of professionalism, integrity, and confidentiality.

**Benefits:**

title: HR Consultant
description:
Winet Infratel is looking for an HR Generalist who will wear two hats: a hands\-on people\-operations professional handling recruitment and day\-to\-day HR generalist responsibilities, and a functional consultant working closely with our technical/engineering teams to design and roll out an in\-house HR automation software suite (attendance management, leave management, salary/payroll sheet calculation and related HR workflows).

This is an in\-person role. You will spend significant time directly with the technical/development team — translating real HR processes into functional requirements, testing built modules and iterating with engineers — alongside your core generalist duties of hiring and employee lifecycle management.

Key Responsibilities

A. HR Generalist \& Talent Acquisition

* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment: sourcing, screening, interview coordination and offer rollout for open positions across departments.
* Handle onboarding and induction for new hires, including documentation and orientation.
* Maintain employee records, HR files and statutory compliance documentation.
* Administer day\-to\-day HR operations: attendance tracking, leave approvals, grievance handling and employee engagement activities.
* Support performance management cycles, appraisals and policy communication.
* Assist in drafting and updating HR policies, SOPs and employee handbooks.
* Coordinate exit formalities, full\-and\-final settlements, and exit interviews.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labor laws and statutory requirements (PF, ESI, gratuity, etc.).

B. HR Systems / Software Automation (Consulting with Technical Team)

* Act as the subject\-matter expert (SME) bridging HR process knowledge and the technical development team building Winet's internal HR software.
* Document current HR workflows (attendance, leave, payroll/salary calculation, reimbursements, appraisals) in detail to translate into functional requirements/specifications for developers.
* Collaborate with the technical team to design logic for:
* Attendance management (biometric/manual entry sync, shift rules, late\-mark/half\-day logic)
* Leave management (leave types, accrual rules, approval workflows, balances, carry\-forward policy)
* Salary sheet/payroll calculation (CTC breakup, deductions, LOP calculation, statutory compliance fields, payslip generation)
* Any additional HR modules (performance tracking, employee database, document management, etc.)
* Participate in requirement\-gathering sessions, UAT (User Acceptance Testing) and iterative feedback rounds as modules are built.
* Validate calculations and logic built by developers against real HR/payroll scenarios to ensure accuracy before go\-live.
* Help define user roles, permissions and approval hierarchies within the software.
* Assist in creating user manuals/SOPs for HR software once modules are deployed and support internal rollout/training for employees and managers.
* Flag process gaps or inefficiencies and propose how automation can resolve them.
* Ability to translate business/HR requirements into clear, structured inputs for a technical team (no coding required, but comfort working closely with developers is essential).
* Strong understanding of Indian labor laws and statutory compliance (PF, ESI, gratuity, etc.).
* Excellent communication, documentation and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Detail\-oriented with strong numerical accuracy, particularly for payroll/salary\-related logic.
* Proficiency in MS Office, familiarity with any HR software is an advantage.

Preferred:

* Experience in a startup / fast\-growth environment where processes are still evolving.
* Comfortable working cross\-functionally with engineering/technical teams on a recurring basis.
* Process\-oriented mindset with an interest in automating and streamlining manual HR work

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

title: Senior Associate Workforce Planning
description:
**About the Role**
------------------



Support Operations is one of our core operations teams, responsible for making sure that when things go wrong, there's always someone there to make it right. The team designs, manages, and operates a large and growing global network of support centers, with the goal of delivering a world\-class customer experience every time.



We're looking for an experienced Workforce Planner to help develop and scale our support lines of business. This role is central to planning monthly, daily, and hourly staffing levels, and to keeping hiring plans current so we consistently deliver best\-in\-class service. You'll play a key part in improving forecast accuracy, reporting, and how we plan around floor staff utilization and efficiency — for a 24/7/365 organization, wherever it operates.


**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------


**Capacity planning**


* Build and maintain support capacity plan models at the monthly, weekly, and interval level, using a quantitative model to determine the staff required to service forecasted volumes
* Match staffing supply to required staff to ensure efficient service level attainment, and make hiring, ramp, and staff\-reduction recommendations
* Keep capacity plans and assumptions accurate, current, and aligned to source\-of\-truth headcount data, auditing regularly for accuracy
* Ensure alignment from the smallest site/team level of detail up through the broader org\-wide capacity plan
* Maintain documentation of planning methodology, assumptions, and processes, and continually improve the planning tools, models, and templates themselves


**Forecasting \& scenario planning**


* Forecast incoming contact volume using historical and benchmark data, tracking deviations between forecast and actuals on a regular cadence
* Build, update, and present "what\-if" scenarios to evaluate potential changes and support upcoming initiatives, as well as annual, half\-year, and quarterly planning scenarios for long\-range and financial planning
* Build and validate capacity models for new lines of business, queues, or markets, and identify overtime activation needs while ensuring compliance with local labor regulations in each region you support
* Build out and report on seasonality trends for a complex, growing organization


**Performance \& insights**


* Dig into historical data to surface insights that improve support operations, speed, quality, and customer experience
* Monitor service level performance, perform SL\-miss analysis, and feed those insights back into planning


**Staffing \& headcount**


* Guide short\-term staffing adjustments to close current gaps, and partner with Operations to track how staffing is implemented and optimized, driving proactive and corrective improvements
* Reconcile planned vs. actual headcount and budget with Finance/HR, monitor the hiring pipeline against plan, and track new\-hire ramp against expected productivity curves
* Maintain a risk register or contingency plan for capacity gaps such as surges, outages, or attrition spikes, and incorporate attrition, absenteeism, and other shrinkage assumptions into the model


**Cross\-functional partnership**


* Partner with Real Time Analysts for demand insight and outage reporting
* Partner with teams across operations, customer experience, product, engineering, and tools to improve processes and the resulting experience for customers and partners
* Hold regular capacity plan reviews with leadership, and flag service level risks — with supporting analysis and a recommended mitigation plan — for upcoming projects and initiatives
* Own your recommendations end\-to\-end: dig into the data, build the model, set implementation timelines, align partners, test ideas, and measure results

**We're excited about you because…**
------------------------------------


* You're analytical and data\-driven — you love getting into the weeds, and you let data win arguments
* You enjoy tackling complex problems and building something that hasn't existed before
* You're well\-organized and detail\-oriented, with excellent written and verbal communication skills
* You follow up and follow through — you execute and get the job done
* You're comfortable in a fast\-paced, constantly changing, team\-oriented environment, and can manage multiple deadlines at once
* You have an owner mentality: quality\-focused, output\-driven, proactive, and always pushing yourself to do better
* You bring creative solutions to big challenges
* You're comfortable operating at the lowest level of detail while also thinking long\-term and inspiring a team
* You're energized by rapid change and constant learning
* You're comfortable pulling data or modeling in Excel/Google Sheets
* You don't give up — if your first plan doesn't work, you have a few more in your back pocket
* You have 4\-6 years of relevant experience, having succeeded in diverse environments (tech, operations, strategy, consulting, banking, or similar)
* You have a Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
* You bring hands\-on experience with workforce management software (e.g., NICE, Verint, Genesys, or Aspect) and advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets; SQL experience is a plus

**About DoorDash**
==================



At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door\-to\-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.



DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.


**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
=============================================



We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: Workforce Transformation HR Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**
===============


The Workforce Transformation Analyst supports the design, analysis, and implementation of initiatives that reshape how the organization's workforce operates — including workforce planning, skills\-based talent strategies, organizational restructuring, automation/AI adoption impacts, and change management. This role combines data analysis, strategic thinking, and project execution to help the organization anticipate future talent needs and adapt its workforce model to meet evolving business demands.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Analyze current workforce data (headcount, skills, roles, costs, attrition) to identify gaps, inefficiencies, and transformation opportunities
* Support workforce planning models that forecast future talent needs based on business strategy, technology adoption, and market trends
* Assess the impact of automation, AI, and process changes on roles, skills requirements, and staffing levels
* Develop skills taxonomies and competency frameworks to support reskilling/upskilling initiatives
* Partner with HR Business Partners, Finance, and business leaders to design organizational structures that align with strategic goals
* Build dashboards and reports (e.g., in Excel, Power BI, Tableau) to track workforce transformation KPIs and present findings to leadership
* Support change management efforts, including communication plans, training needs assessments, and stakeholder engagement
* Conduct benchmarking and market research on workforce trends, labor market shifts, and industry best practices
* Assist in developing business cases for workforce restructuring, redeployment, or reduction initiatives
* Document processes, playbooks, and standard methodologies for workforce transformation projects

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Data Analytics, Organizational Psychology, or related field
* 2–5 years of experience in HR analytics, workforce planning, organizational design, management consulting, or a related analytical role
* Strong proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, modeling); experience with data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau) a plus
* Familiarity with HRIS systems (Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, or similar)
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex findings to non\-technical stakeholders
* Project management skills and comfort working across cross\-functional teams

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Master's degree in a related field, or HR certification (SHRM\-CP/SCP, PHR/SPHR)
* Experience with change management frameworks (Prosci/ADKAR, Kotter's model)
* Exposure to workforce automation, AI impact assessments, or future\-of\-work research
* Consulting background in organizational transformation or workforce strategy
* Experience with statistical analysis tools (SQL, R, or Python) for advanced workforce modeling

**Key Competencies**
====================

* Analytical rigor and data\-driven decision making
* Strategic and systems thinking
* Stakeholder management and influence
* Adaptability in ambiguous, fast\-changing environments
* Strong written and verbal communication

Business Analyst

Lin \& S Corporation

**Locations:** Bengaluru, Karnataka \& Gurugram (Gurgaon), Haryana  
**Work Mode:** Hybrid  
**Employment Type:** Internship / Full\-Time

Lin \& S Corporation is looking for a motivated and analytical Business Analyst / Business Development professional who will contribute to business growth through market research, lead generation, client communication, data analysis, and strategic business initiatives. This role is ideal for candidates who are eager to understand how businesses operate, identify growth opportunities, analyse data, and build strong relationships with potential clients. Candidates may join as interns with the opportunity to transition into a full\-time position based on performance.

Key Responsibilities

* Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify new business opportunities.
* Generate and qualify potential leads through various online and offline channels.
* Assist in preparing business proposals, presentations, quotations, and client documentation.
* Analyse business data, sales reports, and operational metrics to identify insights and trends.
* Maintain and update CRM records with accurate lead and client information.
* Coordinate with internal teams including Marketing, Operations, Technology, and Management.
* Participate in client meetings and assist in requirement gathering and documentation.
* Prepare weekly reports on business development activities and project progress.
* Support strategic planning initiatives and contribute ideas for improving business processes.
* Build and maintain professional relationships with prospective clients and business partners.

Required Skills

* Strong communication skills
* Business research \& analytical thinking
* Microsoft Excel \& Google Sheets
* PowerPoint \& presentation skills
* Lead generation \& client interaction
* Problem\-solving mindset
* Attention to detail
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment

Preferred Qualifications

* BBA, MBA, BBM, B.Com, BE, B.Tech, or related degree.
* Freshers are encouraged to apply.
* Previous internship or exposure to sales, business analysis, consulting, or marketing is an added advantage.
* Knowledge of CRM tools, Power BI, Tableau, or basic data visualization is a plus.

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Language:

* Hindi (Required)
* English (Required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Bengaluru, Karnataka (Bengaluru, Bengaluru Urban District)

title: Accounting & Reporting Analyst-Payable
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.


This Position reports to:


R2R Expert **Your role and responsibilities**  

  

In this role, you will have the opportunity to support account receivables and/or credit activities in line with defined strategies, policies, and procedures. Each day, you will be responsible for managing and analyzing accounts receivable data. You will also showcase your expertise by ensuring accurate financial reporting and compliance with the relevant accounting standards.  

  

The work model for the role is: \#Hybrid

**Your responsibilities**

* **Processing accounts payable transactions, ensuring accurate tracking and processing. Performing necessary activities within the accounts payable area to ensure accurate and timely reporting.**

**Qualification of the role:**

* You hold a Bachelor’s/Master’s degree **in Accounting, Finance or Commerce** and have a demonstrated track record in financial management and comfortable working in English
* **Freshers with post\-graduation or 2 \- 3 years of experience with a Degree in Commerce background** demonstrating advanced skills in managing end\-to\-end payment cycles and optimizing cash flow.
* You are immersed in SAP, Order to Cash (O2C) processes, including Accounts Payables and Procure to Pay (P2P) workflows. You enjoy working with Excel and PowerPoint to analyze and present financial data effectively.
* You are highly adept in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, ensuring accurate reporting and impactful presentations.

title: Business Analyst Intern
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for motivated and enthusiastic **freshers** to join our team as **Business Analyst Interns**.

This role is ideal for candidates who are interested in **business, technology, software applications, AI, and client communication**.

You will work closely with clients and our internal technical team to understand business requirements, document them clearly, and help coordinate software projects.

No prior professional experience is required. We are looking for candidates who are **willing to learn, communicate well, and take responsibility for their work**.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Communicate with clients and understand their requirements.
* Ask questions to understand business problems and workflows.
* Collect and organize client requirements.
* Prepare simple requirement documents and notes.
* Create basic user stories and feature descriptions.
* Explain requirements to developers and designers.
* Coordinate between clients and the technical team.
* Track project requirements and updates.
* Maintain project information using Excel or Google Sheets.
* Participate in client meetings and project discussions.
* Help test software features against client requirements.
* Identify issues, missing requirements, and process gaps.
* Prepare meeting notes and follow\-up actions.
* Research software, AI tools, and technology solutions when required.
* Complete assigned tasks independently and provide regular updates.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Fresh graduates or candidates with **0–1 year experience**.
* Good communication skills in English.
* Good analytical and logical thinking.
* Ability to understand and explain information clearly.
* Good listening and questioning skills.
* Basic computer knowledge.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel or Google Sheets.
* Interest in software and technology.
* Willingness to learn Business Analysis and software development processes.
* Ability to work independently.
* Responsible and disciplined approach to work.

**Preferred Skills**

These are **not mandatory** for freshers:

* Business Analysis
* Requirement Gathering
* MS Excel / Google Sheets
* Documentation
* User Stories
* Basic SQL
* Basic understanding of APIs
* Software Testing
* Agile / Scrum
* Jira
* Basic knowledge of AI and SaaS applications

**Training \& Learning**

Selected candidates will receive practical exposure to:

* Business requirement gathering
* Client communication
* Software project workflows
* Requirement documentation
* User stories and use cases
* Software testing
* Project coordination
* SaaS products
* AI\-powered applications

Candidates will learn by working on **real\-world software and technology projects**.

**Performance Expectations**

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Understanding of requirements
* Quality of documentation
* Communication with clients and team members
* Timely completion of assigned tasks
* Ability to learn new concepts
* Attention to detail
* Ability to work independently
* Contribution to project delivery

Growth Opportunity

Candidates who demonstrate strong performance can grow into roles such as:

**Business Analyst → Senior Business Analyst → Project Coordinator → Project Manager**

High\-performing candidates may also get opportunities to take responsibility for client projects and small teams.

Who Should Apply?

This position is suitable for freshers who:

* Want to start a career in the technology industry.
* Are interested in both **business and technology**.
* Enjoy solving problems.
* Like communicating with people.
* Want to understand how software products are built.
* Are willing to learn and take responsibility.

**Freshers from any degree background can apply. Candidates with a technical, business, management, or engineering background are encouraged to apply.**

**How to Apply**

Please apply with your updated resume.

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Hyderabad, Telangana

description:
**The Company**
 Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.
   

  

 We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing\-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.
   

  

**Meet The Team**
 We’re a collaborative and innovative software quality team focused on ensuring the reliability and performance of Dexcom’s continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) systems. Our mission is to build quality into every stage of the development lifecycle through smart automation, rigorous testing, and a passion for improving lives. If you're eager to grow your skills while contributing to life\-changing technology, this is the team for you.
   

  

**Where You Come In**
* You participate in building quality into products by writing automated tests and performing ad hoc testing throughout the development cycle.
* You contribute to the development of software requirements and design specifications.
* You design, develop, execute, and maintain both automated and manual test scripts to validate Dexcom CGM software and systems.
* You create verification and validation test plans, traceability matrices, and test reports, and review them with relevant stakeholders.
* You record and track issues using the bug tracking system.
* You analyze test failures and collaborate with development teams to investigate root causes.
* You contribute to continuous improvement of the release process.


**What Makes You Successful**
* You have 1–3 years of hands\-on experience in software development or software test development using Python or other object\-oriented programming languages.
* You have experience with SQL and NoSQL databases.
* You bring experience in automated test development for API testing.
* You have worked with a variety of automated testing frameworks, including Robot Framework.
* Your strong understanding of API testing, microservices, and distributed systems in cloud environments sets you apart.
* You have experience with automated UI testing.
* You are familiar with cloud platforms like Google Cloud or AWS.
* You have experience with containerization tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* You may have experience in the medical device industry and familiarity with FDA design control processes (highly desired).
* Your knowledge of GCP tools like Airflow, Dataflow, and BigQuery is a plus.
* Experience with distributed event streaming platforms like Kafka is a plus.
* Experience with performance testing is a plus.
* You bring CI/CD experience, especially with cloud\-based technologies.
* You have five or more years of Agile development and test development experience.
* You collaborate effectively across functions to support testing, deployment, and reporting on product performance, quality, security, and stability.
* You are a self\-starter who works well with minimal guidance and communicates clearly both verbally and in writing.


**What You’ll Get**
* A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave \#dexcomwarriors community.
* A full and comprehensive benefits program.
* Growth opportunities on a global scale.
* Access to career development through in\-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people.
   

  

 Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self\-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Support and contribute to SRE initiatives that improve reliability, scalability, and developer efficiency across enterprise systems.
* Assist in building and maintaining distributed systems that power NVIDIA’s AI\-powered enterprise products and services, learning modern architectural patterns along the way.
* Help automate database operations — including provisioning, scaling, backup, and failover — for relational and vector database services.
* Contribute to observability and monitoring efforts by building dashboards, alerts, and automation scripts to improve system performance and reliability.
* Participate in incident response processes, learning to triage issues, reduce mean time to resolution (MTTR), and contribute to post\-incident reviews.
* Collaborate with Cloud, Platform, Security, and AI/ML teams to support platform reliability and help implement SRE best practices.
* Learn to operate and troubleshoot complex systems — including Kubernetes\-based and cloud\-native infrastructure — following established standards in system design and incident management.
* Explore and adopt AI\-assisted engineering practices, including coding agents and LLM\-powered tooling, to accelerate day\-to\-day development workflows.


**What We Need To See**
* BS degree in Computer Science or a related technical field (e.g., physics, mathematics), or equivalent practical experience.
* Foundational proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, or Go.
* Basic understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and containerisation technologies like Docker and Kubernetes.
* Exposure to or coursework in infrastructure\-as\-code tools (e.g., Terraform, AWS CDK, CloudFormation) or willingness to learn.
* Familiarity with Linux/Unix systems, networking fundamentals, and version control (Git).
* Interest in observability concepts (logging, metrics, tracing) and tools such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, or Grafana.
* Basic knowledge of relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) — understanding of SQL, indexing, and simple query optimisation.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, curiosity, and a willingness to learn in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment.
* Good communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to ask the right questions and learn from senior engineers.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Personal projects, internships, or coursework involving cloud infrastructure, automation, or DevOps/SRE practices.
* Contributions to open\-source projects or active participation in hackathons, coding competitions, or technical communities.
* Exposure to AI/ML concepts — e.g., building or deploying a simple ML model, experimenting with LLM APIs, or using AI\-powered developer tools (Copilot, Cursor, etc.).
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, scripting for automation, or container orchestration (even in personal or academic projects).
* A strong sense of ownership, curiosity, and initiative — you turn challenges into learning opportunities and aren’t afraid to dive into unfamiliar systems.


 NVIDIA leads the charge in innovative breakthroughs in Artificial Intelligence, High\-Performance Computing, and Visualization. The GPU, our invention, functions as the visual cortex of today’s computers and forms the core of our products and services. Our work opens new realms to explore, encourages outstanding creativity and discovery, and powers inventions once thought of as science fiction — from artificial intelligence to autonomous systems. NVIDIA is searching for outstanding talent like you to help us advance the next wave of artificial intelligence!
   

  

 Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/

description:

 This transformation together with Lenovo’s world\-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.
   

  

 Security Operations Centre (SOC) Analyst plays a vital role in Security delivery. As a SOC Analyst, you will be on the front line of Cyber Defense, detecting responding to Cyber Incidents as they happen. You will work with other team members to provide situational awareness through detection, containment, and remediation of IT threats. This job requires great attention to detail and general awareness of Cyber Security tools like SIEM, XDR, EDR, IDS/ IPS, ability understand various logs – network logs, sys logs, Firewall logs. As a SOC Analyst you are expected to have working knowledge in areas of networking, malware analysis, incident response, vulnerability management.
   

  

* Threat vulnerability analysis
* Investigate, document report Information security issues emerging trends
* Analysis response to unknown vulnerabilities


**Responsibilities**
 As a SOC Analyst – Level 1, you will:
   

  

* Monitor security logs and alerts from different security monitoring platforms and sources using SIEM and direct information on an advanced level
* Perform Triage on Incidents detected.
* Submit incidents for a follow\-up to functional maintenance.
* Track progress on incidents that have been submitted from outside of the SOC
* Resolve Incidents as per Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
* Propose and identify automation opportunities resulting from incidents.
* Prepare SOC Management Reports.
* Analyzing preparing daily and monthly reports based on the devices which are being monitored
* Creating Reports and Dashboards based on the customer requirement.
* Creating Reports which helps in providing the logs for the alerts, for finding any possible threats.
* Analyze a variety of network and host\-based security appliance logs (Firewalls, NIDS, HIDS, Sys Logs, etc.) to determine the correct remediation actions and escalation paths.
* Work under supervision of technical lead to accomplish assigned tasks.
* Change Management/ Implementation: Independently implement changes to meet customer infrastructure needs within area of technical responsibility
* Patch and Security Management: Apply patch and security changes per policy."
* Configuration Management: Ensure Configuration Management Database (CMDB) entries are complete and accurate.
* Quality: Provide continual improvement recommendations for direct responsibility area (process improvement, technical standard updates, etc).
* Project Management: Participate in customer and internal projects, including transformation.
* Customer Relationship Management: Set expectations with customers and/or internal businesses/end users within defined parameters.
* Teamwork: Work as part of a team, which may be virtual and/or global. Participate as part of a team and maintains good relationships with team members and customers


**Skill**
 2 \- 4 years of relevant experience
   

  

**Typical Skills Include**
* Sufficient depth and breadth of technical knowledge to be individually responsible for the implementation of a specific deliverable.
* Understanding of technology in direct responsibility (SIEM, XDR, EDR, MDR)
* General understanding of related technologies (Networking, Operating Systems)
* Customer Service
* General Project Management (Basic)
* Customer/Vendor Management (Basic)
* Able to communicate broad and specific concepts with team and to peers.
* Able to produce documentation for use by team and customer.
* Good verbal written communication skills
* Proactive approach to meet exceed goals

 Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Computer Science
   

  

 Understanding of ITIL process

As AI reshapes every industry, Lenovo is at the forefront of helping customers realize its full potential through AI\-powered devices, Hybrid AI solutions, intelligent infrastructure, and AI\-enabled services.

title: Generalist / Founder’s Associate — Early Career
description:
**What if your first job let you understand how an entire business works — instead of putting you inside one tiny department?**

I’m looking for a **curious, driven early\-career professional**. You’ll work directly with the Founder, gaining exposure to real business decisions, problems and opportunities that are rarely accessible to someone at the beginning of their career.

This isn't a traditional role with a fixed script.

You might work on operations one day, coordinate with an international client the next, test an AI tool, improve a process, solve a customer problem, work with our CRM, or support a marketing/business initiative.

**The common thread: you'll be expected to think, learn quickly, figure things out and take ownership.**

**About Chess Gaja**

**Chess Gaja** is a global online chess academy founded by **Grandmaster Priyadharshan Kannappan**, serving students across 5**0\+ countries**.

We combine world\-class chess coaching with structured operations, technology and automation to deliver a consistent experience to students and families around the world.

We're a growing business, and we're looking for people who don't just want a job — **but want to grow with the company.**

What you'll work on

The work will evolve as you grow. Depending on what the business needs and where your strengths develop, you could be involved in:

* Improving operational workflows and processes
* Coordinating with international clients, students and internal teams
* Exploring and implementing AI and digital tools
* Working with our CRM and business systems
* Identifying and solving day\-to\-day business problems
* Coordinating with coaches and other stakeholders
* Supporting marketing and business development initiatives
* Finding ways to make existing processes faster, simpler or better

You'll get exposure to multiple parts of the business rather than being confined to one department.

What this role can become

You may start by supporting different areas and learning how the business works.

As you become more capable, you'll progressively move from:

**Learning → Executing → Owning → Leading**

The goal is **not** for you to remain a trainee.

Over time, you'll be trusted with increasingly important projects, processes and business functions.

If you spend the next **1–2 years** here, I want you to come out with something far more valuable than just another job title:

**a strong practical understanding of how a real business works.**

You'll develop practical skills across operations, communication, technology, project coordination, problem\-solving and business fundamentals.

Who we're looking for

You don't need prior corporate experience. Freshers and early\-career professionals welcome

What matters more to us:

**Curiosity** — You genuinely want to understand how things work.

**Initiative** — When you don't know something, you make a reasonable attempt to figure it out before waiting for instructions.

**Common sense** — You can make good decisions without everything being explicitly spelled out.

**Communication** — You can communicate clearly, professionally and politely in English. You'll be interacting with international clients and teams, so strong written communication matters.

**Adaptability** — You're comfortable learning new software, systems and ways of working.

**Reliability** — You follow through on commitments and don't need to be constantly reminded.

**Process discipline** — You take pride in keeping things organized, following up properly and getting the small details right.

**Learning speed** — You pick things up quickly and apply what you've learned.

**Chess is a plus, but not a requirement.** If you play chess or regularly enjoy playing online, we'd love to know. A **1000\+ rating on Chess.com or Lichess** is a bonus, but we're equally happy to hear from casual players.

What you'll get exposure to

One of the advantages of this role is that you'll work with the actual systems and tools used to run a growing international business.

You'll get hands\-on experience with **Zoho One**, including its CRM and business automation capabilities, as well as other digital and AI tools.

You won't just learn these tools theoretically — **you'll use them to solve real business problems.**

This role may not be for you if...

You prefer:

* A rigid job description
* Doing the same type of work every day
* Being told exactly what to do at every step
* Waiting for someone else to solve problems
* A role where learning new tools or skills isn't part of the job

This opportunity is best suited to someone who wants to build **depth through breadth** early in their career and gradually take on more responsibility.

Role Details

* **Location:** Preferably Madurai. Exceptional candidates from elsewhere may also be considered.
* **Role:** Full\-time \| Generalist / Founder’s Associate — Early Career
* **During Probation Salary:** ₹16,000\-₹18,000/month
* **Post Probation Salary:** ₹18,000–₹20,000/month (There is a yearly retention bonus component part of the salary)
* **Experience:** Freshers and early\-career professionals welcome
* **Work environment:** International business serving students and families across 50\+ countries
* **Equipment:** You must have your own reliable laptop and mobile phone, along with a **50\+ Mbps internet connection** at home.

Important Terms — Please Read Before Applying

**Working Hours:** 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM

Other shifts, such as **5:00 AM – 2:00 PM** or **12:00 PM – 9:00 PM**, may be assigned after probation based on business requirements.

**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday  
**Weekly Off:** Sunday

**Probation:** 3 months

**Notice Period:** 2 months after successful completion of probation

**Joining:** We are looking for **immediate joiners only**.

**Leave Policy:** Our current leave policy can be viewed here:

https://workdrive.zohoexternal.in/external/04a4811f48c16dcc8e85ad7f1e80f32630f47ae0120c3cd4bb048572f17733ed

**Please review these terms carefully before applying.**

About the Company

TradeInfra Networks LLP, based in Telangana, India, is a B2B International Trade Facilitation Service Provider connecting International Buyers with Indian Suppliers.
