Role

As an International B2B Marketing Executive, you will be responsible for developing and executing practical digital and organic marketing activities to strengthen TradeInfra's online presence, brand visibility and engagement among relevant Indian and international business audiences.

The role focuses on Digital Marketing, Social Media Marketing, SEO, Content Marketing, B2B Brand Marketing and organic online growth, using available free tools, platforms and AI technologies.

Important: This role is suitable for candidates who can independently work with free tools and platforms. The Company will not provide paid marketing tools or subscriptions at this stage. The Executive will be expected to build and develop marketing activities from a startup\-level foundation. A B2B website is already available for TradeInfra.

Responsibilities

\- Manage Social Media Marketing across LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and other relevant platforms.

\- Create, publish and optimise professional B2B content for International Buyers, Indian Suppliers, industries, products and international trade.

\- Support Website Marketing through useful content, SEO improvements and organic search opportunities.

\- Create AI\-assisted marketing videos, short\-form videos and other visual content using available free AI and digital tools.

\- Use free AI technologies and digital tools for content creation, research assistance, SEO, creative development and marketing productivity.

\- Monitor marketing performance, analyse results and continuously improve campaigns and content.

\- Support the Sales/Business Development team with relevant marketing content, campaigns and audience insights.

\- Maintain accurate marketing records and submit required weekly performance reports to management.

\- Follow Company policies, SOPs, confidentiality requirements and approved brand guidelines.

Compensation

This is a performance\-based opportunity with no fixed salary or guaranteed monthly income.

The Marketing Executive will be eligible for a Performance Incentive of up to 8% on every successful sale generated by the Company, irrespective of which authorised Business Development Executive completes the sale.

The applicable incentive will be based on the Executive's work, performance and demonstrated marketing results.

Incentive eligibility will begin after completion of the first month from the date of joining, subject to satisfactory performance and the Company's applicable incentive policy.

Working Arrangement

1\. Monday to Saturday

2\. Full\-Time Contractual Opportunity

3\. Contract Duration: 3 to 6 Months

4\. Work From Home

5\. Not a Part\-Time Opportunity

6\. Consistent daily marketing activity and timely communication are required.

Candidate Eligibility

Candidates with practical knowledge or experience in Digital Marketing, Social Media Marketing, SEO, Content Marketing or related areas are preferred.

\- Freshers with genuine practical marketing knowledge are welcome.

\- Good understanding of digital marketing and major social media platforms.

\- Basic knowledge of SEO, keyword research, content optimisation and organic marketing.

\- Ability to create professional written and visual B2B content.

\- Ability to effectively use free AI tools and technologies for marketing activities and productivity.

\- Ability to create or learn to create short\-form marketing videos and visual content using free tools.

\- Familiarity with Canva or similar free design tools is preferred.

\- Good written and verbal communication skills.

\- Creative thinking and ability to develop practical marketing ideas.

\- Ability to learn TradeInfra's business model, services and target audiences and apply marketing skills accordingly.

\- Strong self\-learning ability and willingness to continuously improve marketing skills.

\- Self\-motivated and capable of working independently in a startup environment.

\- Comfortable with performance\-based compensation.

\- Minimum Age: 18\+

\- Education: 12th / Graduation / Master's

\- Location: India

\- Work Mode: Work From Home

Company Support

The Company will provide the necessary business understanding, product/service information, marketing direction, operational guidance, SOPs and relevant training required to understand TradeInfra's business and target audiences.

The Executive will be expected to independently apply their marketing skills using available free digital platforms, free tools and AI technologies to produce measurable marketing results.

The objective is not simply to publish content. The objective is to build TradeInfra's digital presence, organic reach, credibility, lead generation and overall marketing impact among relevant Indian and international business audiences.

As a Business Development Associate, you will work closely with learners to understand their goals and guide them toward the right programs. You will own the journey from the first conversation to final enrolment, ensuring clarity, trust, and a strong learner experience throughout.

**What This Role Is Not**

* This is not a script\-driven or transactional sales role.

**Why Join Airtribe**

* High\-impact role with direct business visibility from day one

title: Systems Engineer | Defence
description:
**Location:** 
 Sector\-132, Noida, (involves travelling with the team to various test sites across India)
   

  

**Salary (CTC):** 
 ₹6\-7 LPA
   

  

**Job Type:** 
 Full\-time, On\-site
   

  

**About Zoid\-**
 ZOID is a deep\-tech R\&D startup developing advanced defence and aerospace technologies for the Indian Military and UAV manufacturers. Our work spans AI, electronics, robotics, autonomous systems and UAV platforms.
   

  

 Our current projects include AI\-based FOD detection for naval air stations, GNSS\-denied navigation, aerial intelligent mapping, reusable off\-board missile decoys, vision\-based kinetic strike systems and drone swarming solutions.
   

  

**Role Overview\-**
 We are looking for a hands\-on
 **Systems Engineer** 
 to support the end\-to\-end design, integration, testing, flight operations and deployment of UAV systems.
   

  

 The role requires strong practical knowledge of drone hardware, avionics, flight controllers, power systems, communication links, payload integration and field testing. The candidate must be comfortable manually flying small to medium\-category UAVs and travelling to test locations across India.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities\-**
**UAV Systems \& Integration**
* Lead, design and assemble end\-to\-end integration of UAV subsystems: propulsion, avionics, control, payload and power.
* Hands\-on with various frame designs — Quad/Hex/Octa copters, fixed\-wing, VTOL, etc.
* Select suitable drives, electronic components, sensors and hardware.
* Knowledge of motors, ESCs, propellers — their specs and configuration.
* Configure, integrate, calibrate and auto\-tune flight controllers (Pixhawk, Cube Orange\+, PX4, etc.).
* Analyse flight logs using Mission Planner, QGroundControl or MAVLink tools for pre\- and post\-flight debugging.
* Knowledge of standard flight modes (stabilize, althold, poshold, loiter, land, rtl, guided, auto), fail\-safes (RC, GCS, battery, geofence, EKF) and mission planning.
* Familiar with standard Pixhawk Cube parameters and setting them via Mission Planner.


**Communication \& Networking**
* Ability to configure IP networks — IP addressing, subnet masks, gateways, routing — and get companion computers, flight controllers, payload processors, routers and ground stations talking on the same network.
* Knowledge of serial communication protocols: UART, SPI, I²C, CAN, RS\-232, including baud rates and debugging.
* Understanding of telemetry radios, RC links, video links, mesh networks, Ethernet, LTE/5G modems, VPN/routing and IP\-based payload communication.
* Understanding of MAVLink routing, UDP/TCP endpoints, packet loss, latency and link redundancy.


**Basic RF knowledge** 
 — understanding of what a signal is and the fundamentals behind it.
   

  

**Power System Design**
* Understanding of Li\-ion/LiPo packs, C\-rating, discharge curves, BMS, cell balancing and safe charging/discharging.
* Ability to calculate power Budget, current draw, endurance, payload power and voltage rail requirements.
* Knowledge of PDBs, DC\-DC converters, BECs, fuses, connectors, wire gauge selection and grounding.
* Troubleshoot brownouts, voltage drops, ESC desync, power noise and overheating.


**Sensor \& Payload Integration**
 Integrate EO/IR cameras, gimbals, LiDAR, rangefinders, GNSS/RTK modules, IMUs, magnetometers, payload controllers and RF payloads.
   

  

* Read sensor datasheets and understand interfaces, power needs, mounting constraints and calibration.
* Test payload data flow from sensor → onboard computer → ground station.
* Ability to read datasheets, schematics, pinouts and reference manuals to bring up and test embedded boards.


**Software \& Development**
* Python skills are mandatory for development, log analysis / visualization, automation and tooling.
* Working knowledge of Ubuntu / Linux is required, including basic commands (SSH, SCP, mkdir, cd, rm, etc.) and day\-to\-day use of a Linux environment.
* Basic firmware development, flashing, debugging and peripheral interfacing on microcontrollers such as STM32, ESP32, Arduino or similar.


**Qualifications**
**Education:** 
 Diploma or degree in Electronics, Mechanical, Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical or a related field. Equivalent experience also considered.
   

  

**Experience**
* Minimum 3 years in a Avionics Systems Engineer preferably in a startup, R\&D or defence\-tech setup.
* Prior experience in defence/aerospace product testing and deployment.
* Experience building and operating drones from scratch and running day\-to\-day autonomous/semi\-autonomous flights.


**Hands\-on Skills**
* Soldering (board\-level), crimping, wiring, harness building and assembly.
* Integrating flight controllers with ESCs, GPS, power modules, telemetry, RF systems and onboard computers.
* Familiarity with aviation regulations and military standards for UAV development is a plus.


**Core Skills\-**
* Proficiency in MS Office, Canva, AI Tool like Claude.
* Strong problem\-solving — able to think critically and creatively about complex engineering challenges.
* Good communication skills for working with cross\-functional teams.
* Proficiency in English is mandatory.


**Additional Requirements**
* Willingness to travel to test sites across India.
* Comfortable working outdoors for extended durations.


**Preferred Skills**
 Beyond the requirements above, any of the following is a big plus:
   

  

* Advanced software experience with C\+\+, ROS and Gazebo.
* Familiarity with embedded processors beyond standard computers — microcontrollers, SBCs, SoCs and FPGA\-based development boards.
* Basic familiarity with FPGA / SoC\-FPGA workflows: HDL, synthesis, bitstream generation, programming and hardware validation using tools like Vivado/Vitis or similar.
* Awareness of different RF architectures, with the judgement to do design and analysis of the subsystems in an RF chain.
* Understanding of antenna theory, types of signals, jamming signals and SDRs


 Skills: debugging,avionics,python,ubuntu / linux,uav

title: Sales & Marketing Executive
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Marketing, Sales \& Technical Support ExecutiveSelexic Pay — Labour Contractor HRMS

**Company:** Deccan India Development Corporation Pvt. Ltd. (DIDC)  
**Product:** Selexic Pay – Labour Contractor Payroll \& HRMS  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Work Location:** Pune / Mumbai, Maharashtra  
**Work Mode:** Field \+ Office \+ Customer Site  
**Department:** Sales \& Customer Success  
**Reporting To:** Business Development Manager / Management

1\. About DIDC

Deccan India Development Corporation Pvt. Ltd. (DIDC) is a technology company focused on building practical digital solutions for businesses and organizations.

We are looking for a dynamic, target\-oriented and technology\-friendly **Marketing, Sales \& Technical Support Executive** to drive the growth of **Selexic Pay**, our specialized Labour Contractor Payroll \& HRMS platform.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for the complete customer journey—from identifying prospects and generating leads to conducting product demonstrations, closing sales, supporting implementation and maintaining customer relationships.

2\. About Selexic Pay

**Selexic Pay** is a specialized HRMS and payroll management solution designed for labour contractors and organizations managing large workforces.

The platform helps businesses manage areas such as:

* Labour/Employee Management
* Employee onboarding
* Aadhaar/PAN/Bank verification
* Attendance management
* Salary processing
* Salary structures
* Advances and loans
* Deductions
* Compliance calculations
* Minimum wages compliance
* Salary slips
* WhatsApp communication
* Client/company management
* Material management
* Pay\-per\-work
* Mobile access
* Payroll and workforce reporting

The candidate will be trained on the complete Selexic Pay platform.

3\. Role Purpose

The primary objective of this role is to **generate revenue and ensure customer success for Selexic Pay in Pune and Mumbai.**

The employee will perform three interconnected functions:

A. Marketing

Create awareness and generate qualified leads.

B. Sales

Convert prospects into paying Selexic Pay customers.

C. Technical Support

Help customers understand, configure and use Selexic Pay successfully.

This is therefore a **revenue \+ customer\-success role**, not a purely administrative support position.

4\. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Marketing \& Lead Generation

* Identify potential Selexic Pay customers in assigned territories.
* Conduct market research to identify labour contractors and workforce\-management businesses.
* Identify companies employing/managing large numbers of contract labour.
* Generate leads through:
* Field visits
* Cold calling
* WhatsApp
* Email
* LinkedIn
* References
* Business networking
* Local business associations
* Industry contacts
* Digital campaigns and marketing activities
* Build a database of prospective customers.
* Maintain accurate lead information in the CRM.
* Conduct regular market visits.
* Identify new business opportunities in Pune and Mumbai.
* Participate in exhibitions, seminars, networking events and promotional activities.
* Support DIDC marketing campaigns and local promotional initiatives.

5\. Sales ResponsibilitiesLead → Demo → Follow\-up → Closure

The employee will be responsible for managing the complete sales cycle.

Lead Qualification

Understand:

* Number of employees/labourers
* Number of clients/sites
* Current payroll process
* Attendance process
* Salary processing method
* Compliance requirements
* Current software/Excel usage
* Existing problems
* Decision\-maker
* Budget
* Expected implementation timeline

Product Demonstration

Conduct professional Selexic Pay demonstrations for:

* Labour contractors
* Contractors' HR teams
* Payroll teams
* Accounts teams
* Admin teams
* Business owners
* Company management

Demonstrate the product according to the customer's actual business problem rather than simply showing software screens.

Sales Conversion

* Prepare proposals and quotations.
* Explain packages and pricing.
* Handle objections.
* Conduct follow\-ups.
* Negotiate within approved limits.
* Coordinate with management wherever special pricing is required.
* Close sales.
* Collect required customer information for onboarding.
* Coordinate with the implementation/support team.

6\. Technical Support Responsibilities

The candidate will provide **Level\-1 product support** to Selexic Pay customers.

Responsibilities include:

* Help customers understand Selexic Pay features.
* Assist customers with basic configuration.
* Help users resolve common application issues.
* Guide customers during employee import.
* Assist with attendance data upload.
* Help users understand salary processing.
* Explain salary structures and deductions.
* Assist with basic payroll configuration.
* Help customers understand reports and salary slips.
* Assist customers with WhatsApp\-related workflows.
* Guide customers through application usage.
* Reproduce customer\-reported issues where possible.
* Record issues in the support/ticketing system.
* Escalate technical bugs to the development team.
* Follow up on escalated issues until closure.
* Maintain communication with customers during issue resolution.
* Conduct basic customer training.

**Important:** The employee is not expected to be a software developer.

However, the candidate must have sufficient technical understanding to **diagnose basic problems, understand software workflows and communicate technical issues clearly to the development team.**

7\. Customer Onboarding

After a successful sale, the employee will assist with customer onboarding.

Activities may include:

* Customer information collection
* Product configuration coordination
* Employee data import
* Attendance setup
* Salary configuration
* User creation
* Basic training
* First payroll assistance
* Customer handover
* Follow\-up after implementation

The objective is to ensure that the customer does not simply purchase Selexic Pay but **starts using it successfully.**

8\. Customer Relationship Management

* Maintain regular contact with existing customers.
* Understand customer problems and requirements.
* Identify opportunities for additional modules/add\-ons.
* Generate upselling and cross\-selling opportunities.
* Collect customer feedback.
* Identify dissatisfied customers early.
* Ensure timely resolution of customer issues.
* Maintain long\-term relationships with key customers.
* Generate referrals from satisfied customers.

9\. Field Sales \& Travel

This is a **field\-oriented role**.

The candidate should be comfortable travelling across assigned territories in:

Pune

Pune city and surrounding industrial/business areas.

Mumbai

Mumbai and surrounding business/industrial areas as assigned.

Regular customer meetings, prospect visits, demonstrations and support visits will be part of the job.

**Two\-wheeler ownership and a valid driving licence will be preferred.**

10\. Daily Responsibilities

A typical working day may include:

* Prospect research
* Cold calls
* Lead follow\-up
* Customer meetings
* Field visits
* Product demonstrations
* Proposal preparation
* Sales follow\-up
* Customer support
* CRM updates
* Customer onboarding
* Internal coordination
* Daily activity reporting

The candidate will be expected to maintain proper records of:

* Calls
* Leads
* Meetings
* Demos
* Follow\-ups
* Opportunities
* Closures
* Customer issues
* Support activities

11\. Key Performance Indicators — KPIs

Performance will be measured using a combination of **activity, sales and customer\-success metrics.**

Marketing KPIs

* New leads generated
* Qualified leads
* New prospects added to CRM
* Market visits
* Networking activities
* Campaign participation

Sales KPIs

* Customer meetings
* Product demonstrations
* Qualified opportunities
* Proposals submitted
* Follow\-ups completed
* New customers acquired
* Monthly sales revenue
* Conversion rate

Customer Success KPIs

* Successful customer onboarding
* First payroll completion
* Customer support response
* Issue resolution
* Customer retention
* Customer satisfaction
* Upselling/cross\-selling
* Customer referrals

12\. Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who is:

* Confident
* Energetic
* Self\-motivated
* Target\-oriented
* Customer\-focused
* Technology\-friendly
* Good at communication
* Comfortable with field work
* Good at explaining software
* Good at problem\-solving
* Comfortable speaking with business owners
* Willing to learn payroll/HRMS concepts
* Able to work independently

The candidate should have the ability to **sell a solution, not just a product.**

13\. Required SkillsSales Skills

* Lead generation
* Cold calling
* Field sales
* B2B sales
* Product demonstration
* Negotiation
* Follow\-up
* Closing
* Relationship management

Technical Skills

* Basic understanding of web applications
* Basic computer knowledge
* MS Excel/Google Sheets
* CRM usage
* Ability to understand software workflows
* Basic troubleshooting
* Ability to document technical issues

Communication Skills

* Excellent verbal communication
* Good presentation skills
* Professional customer communication
* Good written communication

Language

Preferred:

* Marathi
* Hindi
* English

Strong Marathi communication will be particularly useful for the Maharashtra market.

14\. Educational Qualification

**Minimum:** Graduate in any discipline.

Preferred backgrounds:

* BBA
* BMS
* B.Com
* BCA
* B.Sc.
* MBA – Marketing/Sales
* IT/Computer\-related graduation

However, **sales ability and attitude will be given more importance than the degree.**

15\. ExperiencePreferred Experience

**1–3 years** in:

* Software sales
* SaaS sales
* ERP sales
* HRMS sales
* Payroll software sales
* B2B sales
* IT product sales
* Field sales
* Customer support \+ sales

Candidates with strong field\-sales ability but no direct SaaS experience may also be considered.

**Freshers with excellent communication, confidence, technology aptitude and strong sales potential may be considered selectively.**

16\. Preferred Industry Experience

Candidates from the following industries will be preferred:

* HRMS
* Payroll software
* ERP
* Accounting software
* Attendance systems
* Biometric solutions
* Workforce management
* Labour contractor solutions
* B2B SaaS
* Business software
* IT services

Experience with products such as billing, accounting, HRMS, ERP or workforce\-management software will be an advantage.

17\. CompensationSuggested Structure

**Fixed Salary:** ₹20,000 – ₹30,000 per month  
**\+ Performance Incentives**  
**\+ Approved Travel/Field Expenses**

Final compensation will depend on:

* Experience
* Previous sales performance
* Software/SaaS experience
* Communication ability
* Technical capability
* Territory experience

A strong candidate with proven B2B SaaS sales experience can be considered above the standard range.

The incentive structure should be designed so that **high performers can significantly increase their monthly earnings through sales achievement.**

18\. What Success Looks LikeFirst 30 Days

The employee should:

* Understand Selexic Pay completely.
* Learn the target market.
* Learn the sales process.
* Learn CRM usage.
* Conduct supervised demos.
* Start prospecting.
* Build the initial pipeline.

60 Days

The employee should:

* Independently generate leads.
* Conduct product demonstrations.
* Handle basic objections.
* Manage follow\-ups.
* Start closing customers.
* Handle basic customer support.

90 Days

The employee should be able to independently manage:

**Prospecting → Lead Qualification → Demo → Proposal → Follow\-up → Closure → Onboarding → Basic Support**

and consistently contribute to the assigned revenue target.

19\. Who Should NOT Apply

This role may not be suitable for candidates who:

* Do not want field work.
* Are uncomfortable making cold calls.
* Do not want sales targets.
* Prefer only desk\-based work.
* Are uncomfortable travelling to customers.
* Do not want to interact directly with business owners.
* Have no interest in learning software.
* Expect a purely technical support role.
* Expect a purely marketing role.
* Are uncomfortable with performance\-based incentives.

20\. Why Join DIDC?

* Work with a growing technology company.
* Work on a specialized B2B SaaS product.
* Gain experience across sales, technology and customer success.
* Exposure to HRMS, payroll and workforce\-management technology.
* Direct interaction with business owners and decision\-makers.
* Performance\-based career growth.
* Opportunity to develop into a Senior Sales Executive / Business Development Manager / Customer Success Manager.

21\. Career Path

**Marketing, Sales \& Technical Support Executive**

↓

**Senior Sales \& Customer Success Executive**

↓

**Business Development Executive / Manager**

↓

**Business Development Manager**

↓

**Regional Sales Manager**

Core ObjectiveGenerate business, acquire customers, help them successfully implement Selexic Pay, and build long\-term customer relationships.

This role is expected to become the **local face of Selexic Pay in Pune/Mumbai** and act as the bridge between **DIDC, prospects, customers and the technical team.**

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 per month

Work Location: On the road

title: Internship HR Intern
description:
**Internship Summary**

We are looking for an enthusiastic and career\-oriented **HR Recruiter Intern** to join our Human Resources team for a period of **2 months**. This internship is designed to provide hands\-on experience in end\-to\-end recruitment, employee onboarding, documentation, background verification (BGV), and HR operations. The intern will work closely with the HR team to support hiring activities and ensure a smooth onboarding process for new employees.

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities**

**Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition**

* Source candidates through job portals, social media platforms, employee referrals, job fairs, and internal databases.
* Screen resumes and shortlist candidates based on job requirements.
* Conduct telephonic screening interviews to assess candidate suitability.
* Coordinate interview schedules between candidates and hiring managers.
* Follow up with candidates regarding interview status, feedback, offer acceptance, and joining confirmation.
* Maintain a healthy candidate pipeline for ongoing and future manpower requirements.
* Track daily recruitment activities and update recruitment MIS and trackers.
* Coordinate with the Operations team to understand manpower requirements and hiring priorities.
* Achieve recruitment targets within the specified turnaround time (TAT).

**Candidate Follow\-up \& Joining Coordination**

* Ensure regular follow\-up with selected candidates until their date of joining.
* Share interview details, joining instructions, reporting locations, and required documents.
* Coordinate with candidates to minimize offer dropouts and no\-shows.
* Maintain candidate communication throughout the recruitment cycle.

**Employee Documentation**

* Collect and verify all mandatory employee documents, including Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Bank Details, Educational Certificates, Address Proof, Passport\-size Photographs, and other required documents.
* Ensure employee files are complete and properly maintained before onboarding.
* Prepare and organize employee personal files, both physical and digital.
* Update employee master data and HR records accurately.

**Background Verification (BGV)**

* Initiate and coordinate Background Verification (BGV) for new joiners.
* Verify candidate identity, address, employment history, and educational qualifications.
* Follow up with candidates for pending documents required for BGV.
* Track BGV status and ensure timely completion within the defined turnaround time.
* Report discrepancies to the HR Manager for further action.

**Onboarding \& HR Operations**

* Assist in preparing offer letters, appointment letters, and other joining documents.
* Support employee onboarding and induction activities.
* Maintain employee attendance and joining reports.
* Assist in maintaining HR trackers, recruitment reports, and MIS.
* Support employee engagement activities and other HR administrative tasks as assigned.

**Skills Required**

* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong follow\-up and coordination abilities.
* Basic knowledge of recruitment and HR processes.
* MS Excel, Word, and Outlook/Zoho.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced and target\-driven environment.
* Good organizational and time management skills.
* Positive attitude, willingness to learn, and attention to detail.

**Eligibility**

* Pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Freshers and students looking to build a career in HR and Recruitment are encouraged to apply.

**Learning Outcomes**

By the end of the internship, the intern will gain practical exposure to:

* End\-to\-end recruitment and talent acquisition.
* High\-volume hiring and candidate relationship management.
* Employee onboarding and documentation processes.
* Background Verification (BGV) procedures and compliance.
* HR reporting, MIS, and workforce coordination.
* Professional communication and stakeholder management.
* HR operations in facility management industry.

Pay: ₹8,000\.00 \- ₹10,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Internet reimbursement

title: Talent Acquisition Analyst
description:
Overview:

As a Professional Recruiter focused on professional hiring, you will play a key role in attracting, assessing, and hiring top talent for PepsiCo. You will collaborate with hiring managers, HR business partners, and stakeholders to develop and execute strategic hiring plans while ensuring a seamless and engaging candidate experience.


This role requires a blend of strategic talent sourcing, stakeholder management, employer branding, data\-driven decision\-making, and process excellence to support our talent acquisition goals.

  


Responsibilities:

Recruitment Consulting, Advisory \& Partnership

* Partner with hiring managers to conduct recruitment strategy meetings, analyze hiring needs, define job requirements, and craft customized recruitment plans.
* Provide market intelligence and competitive insights on talent availability, salary benchmarks, and industry hiring trends.
* Act as a trusted talent advisor, guiding hiring managers on interviewing best practices, inclusive hiring strategies, candidate experience standards, and the effective use of assessment tools.
* Align recruitment efforts with workforce planning, strategic TA initiatives, and business priorities.
* Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with hiring managers, HR, and other key stakeholders.
* Provide regular updates and proactive communication throughout the recruitment lifecycle, ensuring alignment and transparency.


Candidate Sourcing, Attraction, and Engagement

* Develop and execute proactive sourcing strategies to identify and attract both active and passive talent using job boards, social media, employee referrals, and networking.
* Build and maintain talent pipelines for critical and recurring roles to reduce time\-to\-find and time\-to\-accept.
* Leverage PepsiCo’s employer branding and recruitment marketing to enhance talent attraction, including writing compelling job descriptions, optimizing job postings, and engaging candidates through our established EVP messaging.
* Deliver a consistent, high\-touch candidate experience, ensuring timely communication and engagement at every stage of the hiring process.


End\-to\-End Recruitment Process Management \& Execution

* Manage the full recruitment lifecycle, from job requisition creation to offer acceptance, ensuring efficiency, quality, and a seamless and positive candidate experience while adhering to all established process standards.
* Conduct structured interviews and behavioral assessments applying the company's established interviewing framework and standards to evaluate candidate qualifications, skills, and culture add.
* Facilitate hiring manager debrief sessions and provide structured feedback to support data\-driven hiring decisions.
* Manage the offer process, including extending offers and negotiating compensation packages in partnership with HR, Total Rewards, and Hiring Manager.


Data\-Driven Recruitment, Compliance \& Continuous Improvement

* Track and analyze key recruitment metrics (e.g., time\-to\-find, time\-to\-accept, candidate experience scores) to continuously improve hiring outcomes.
* Utilize external labor market data and talent analytics to refine sourcing strategies and hiring decisions.
* Ensure adherence to global hiring policies, DEI standards, and local employment laws.
* Stay updated on industry best practices, recruitment technology advancements, and innovative hiring trends.
* Effectively utilize the Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and other recruitment technologies to manage the recruitment process.


Process Adherence and Data Management

* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date candidate records in the Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and CRM platforms.
* Follow established recruitment process standards, ensuring consistency, compliance, and data integrity.


Global Talent Acquisition Initiatives Contribution and Team Support

* Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) in process, technology, or data, actively participating in SME networks and providing support to the assigned team.
* Team Support and Development: Provide backup support for team leaders and act as a coach/buddy for new hires to facilitate onboarding and development.
* Global Project Participation: Contribute as a Talent Acquisition Delivery SME on assigned global projects.


Specialized Responsibilities Based on Recruiter Type

* Focus on hiring for corporate/professional roles in Finance, HR, Marketing, IT, R\&D, and other business functions.
* Source specialized talent through LinkedIn Recruiter, professional associations, networking events, and industry\-specific job boards.
* Manage longer\-cycle, strategic hiring with structured interview processes and leadership engagement.
* Provide data\-driven insights and talent intelligence to support workforce planning.
* Work closely with senior leaders and HRBPs to align hiring strategies with business goals.

  


Qualifications:
* 7\-9 Years of Experience managing the full recruitment lifecycle, from sourcing to offer management within a corporate or agency environment
* Education: Bachelor's degree.
* Solid understanding of talent assessment methodologies and interviewing techniques (e.g., behavioral, competency\-based).
* Proven experience with recruitment marketing principles and various channels (e.g., social media platforms, and job boards).


Technology:

* Demonstrated experience using Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and other recruiting technologies.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
* Talent Intelligence \& Compliance: Knowledge of talent intelligence tools, competitor analysis, employment law, regulations, and compliance related to recruitment.
* Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze recruitment data and metrics to inform hiring strategies and drive data\-driven decisions.
* Organizational \& Time Management Skills: Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and consistently meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Communication \& Interpersonal Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to build strong relationships with candidates, hiring managers, and stakeholders at all levels.
* Problem\-solving \& Decision\-Making: Ability to analyze situations, identify potential solutions, and make sound judgments.
* Adaptability \& Flexibility: Ability to thrive in a dynamic environment and adapt to changing priorities.
* Results Orientation: Driven to achieve recruitment targets and contribute to team success.
* Language Proficiency: Fluency in English


Preferred Qualifications

* Global Experience: Experience working in a multinational or global organization.
* Experience coaching and mentoring junior recruiters.
* Solid understanding of project management principles.
* Experience recruiting within a Global Shared Services environment.

title: Vice President - ServiceNow Architect
description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**

  

At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.

  

Join us as we create something extraordinary together.

**Job Overview**
----------------


The ServiceNow Architect is a senior technical leader responsible for the strategic design, governance, and continuous evolution of the organization's ServiceNow platform. This role owns the end\-to\-end architectural vision for ServiceNow — spanning platform configuration, enterprise integrations, workflow automation, and the adoption of ServiceNow's AI and intelligence capabilities — ensuring the platform delivers measurable value across the business.


The ServiceNow Architect serves as the primary technical authority for the platform and works in close partnership with enterprise architecture, IT operations, business process owners, and product teams to transform ServiceNow from an ITSM tool into a strategic enterprise workflow automation hub. This individual operates at the intersection of technical depth and business strategy, shaping how work gets done across the organization.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

**Platform Architecture \& Governance**
---------------------------------------

* Own the ServiceNow platform architecture, including instance strategy (production, sub\-production), domain separation considerations, upgrade planning, and long\-term roadmap
* Establish and enforce platform governance standards: development practices, scoped application design, naming conventions, update set management, and code review processes
* Define the ServiceNow data model strategy, including CMDB architecture, CI relationships, and data integrity governance in alignment with ITIL and business requirements
* Lead architecture reviews for all significant ServiceNow development efforts, providing design authority sign\-off and ensuring alignment with platform best practices
* Maintain architectural documentation including reference architectures, design decision records, and platform topology diagrams

**Enterprise Integration Architecture**
---------------------------------------

* Design and own the integration architecture connecting ServiceNow to the broader enterprise technology ecosystem, including ERP, ITSM, HR systems, monitoring platforms, identity providers, and cloud services
* Architect integrations using ServiceNow's native capabilities — IntegrationHub, Flow Designer spokes, REST/SOAP APIs, MID Server, and Event Management — as well as third\-party iPaaS platforms where applicable
* Define integration patterns and standards for inbound/outbound data exchange, ensuring reliability, security, and maintainability at enterprise scale
* Lead integration efforts with key enterprise platforms including Microsoft 365 (Teams, Outlook, SharePoint), Azure, Active Directory/Entra ID, monitoring and observability tools, and HR platforms (e.g., Workday, SAP SuccessFactors)
* Establish and govern the ServiceNow CMDB as the authoritative source of truth for enterprise configuration data, including discovery tooling, reconciliation rules, and CSDM alignment
* Partner with security and IAM teams to architect identity federation, SSO (SAML/OIDC), and role\-based access control across the platform

**Workflow Automation**
-----------------------

* Lead the architectural strategy for enterprise workflow automation on the ServiceNow platform, spanning IT, HR, Legal, Finance, Facilities, and other business domains.
* Design scalable, reusable automation frameworks using Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, Business Rules, and Scripted REST APIs.
* Architect end\-to\-end process automation for key workflows including incident management, change management, employee onboarding/offboarding, procurement, and request fulfillment.
* Define standards for automation governance: approval workflows, SLA frameworks, notification architecture, and audit trail design.
* Identify and prioritize automation opportunities across the enterprise by partnering with process owners and analyzing ticket and workflow data.
* Champion low\-code/no\-code automation patterns to enable business teams to build within governed guardrails, reducing reliance on centralized IT development

**ServiceNow AI \& Intelligence Capabilities:**
-----------------------------------------------

* Drive the adoption and architectural strategy for ServiceNow's AI and intelligence portfolio, including:


	+ **Now Assist (Generative AI):** Virtual agent augmentation, case summarization, resolution note generation, and AI\-assisted search across ITSM and non\-ITSM workflows.
	+ **Predictive Intelligence:** ML\-based classification, categorization, and routing of incidents, cases, and requests.
	+ **AI Search:** Unified enterprise search architecture leveraging ServiceNow's semantic search capabilities.
	+ **Process Optimization:** Identifying bottleneck and deviation patterns in workflows using ServiceNow's process mining capabilities.
	+ **Virtual Agent:** Conversational interface design and NLU topic architecture integrated with enterprise channels (Microsoft Teams, web portal).
* Assess organizational AI readiness, including data quality, CMDB health, and historical record hygiene as prerequisites for effective AI model performance
* Define governance and ethical use standards for AI\-driven automation and decision support within ServiceNow
* Stay current with ServiceNow's AI roadmap and evaluate new capabilities for applicability within the enterprise context

**Product \& Module Ownership**
-------------------------------

* Provide architectural leadership across ServiceNow product lines as adopted by the organization, which may include:


	+ IT Service Management (ITSM), IT Operations Management (ITOM), IT Asset Management (ITAM)
	+ HR Service Delivery (HRSD), Legal Service Delivery, Workplace Service Delivery
	+ Security Operations (SecOps), GRC / Integrated Risk Management (IRM)
	+ Customer Service Management (CSM), App Engine / Creator Workflows
* Evaluate new ServiceNow modules for strategic fit, total cost of ownership, and integration complexity before platform adoption decisions are made
* Manage the platform upgrade lifecycle, including scoped impact analysis, regression testing strategy, and stakeholder communication

**Stakeholder Engagement \& Leadership**
----------------------------------------

* Act as a trusted advisor to business and IT leadership on ServiceNow capabilities, investment priorities, and platform roadmap
* Partner with process owners and product managers to translate business requirements into scalable platform solutions
* Mentor ServiceNow developers, administrators, and business analysts — establishing technical standards and elevating team capability
* Represent ServiceNow architecture in enterprise architecture governance forums and technology review boards
* Manage the relationship with ServiceNow account teams, technical success managers, and implementation partners to maximize platform value

**What are we looking for?**
----------------------------


We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast\-paced, team\-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates **pursue greatness**, **act with integrity**, and are **driven to help our clients succeed**. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we **win together** and **create and share joy** in our work.

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* 10\+ years of progressive IT experience, with at least 5 years in a senior architecture or technical lead role focused on ServiceNow
* Deep, hands\-on expertise across core ServiceNow platform capabilities:


	+ **Platform:** Instance architecture, Application Engine, Scoped Apps, CMDB, CSDM, Update Sets, ATF
	+ **Automation:** Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, Business Rules, Scheduled Jobs, Event Management
	+ **Integration:** REST/SOAP APIs, MID Server, LDAP/SSO, Azure/AWS connectors, iPaaS patterns
	+ **ITSM/ITOM/ITAM:** Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Discovery, Service Mapping, HAM/SAM
	+ **Portal \& UX:** Service Portal, Now Experience (UI Builder), Employee Center
* Demonstrated experience architecting ServiceNow integrations with complex, heterogeneous enterprise technology environments
* Proficiency in ServiceNow scripting: JavaScript (Glide API), REST API design, and client/server\-side scripting
* Strong working knowledge of ITIL processes and their implementation within ServiceNow
* Experience leading platform upgrades across major ServiceNow releases in production environments
* Excellent documentation skills with ability to produce architecture diagrams, integration maps, and design specifications

**Core Competencies:**
----------------------

**Platform Mastery:** Expert command of ServiceNow architecture patterns, APIs, and the platform's evolving capability landscape

**Integration Thinking:** Designs loosely coupled, resilient integration architectures that scale across enterprise system boundaries

**Process Orientation:** Translates ambiguous business processes into structured, automatable workflows with appropriate governance

**AI Fluency:** Understands where AI and machine learning add genuine value and architects for responsible, effective adoption

**Strategic Influence:** Earns credibility with senior stakeholders and shapes platform investment decisions

**Mentorship:** Actively develops others and raises the overall technical capability of the ServiceNow practice

**Preferences:**
----------------

* Hands\-on experience with ServiceNow's AI portfolio, including Now Assist, Predictive Intelligence, Virtual Agent, and AI Search
* ServiceNow certifications, including one or more of:


	+ Certified System Administrator (CSA)
	+ Certified Application Developer (CAD)
	+ Certified Implementation Specialist — ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, SecOps, or equivalent
	+ Now Certified Expert (NCE) designation
* Experience with ServiceNow App Engine and building custom scoped applications for enterprise use cases
* Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF, Zachman) and their application to platform governance
* Experience integrating ServiceNow with Microsoft 365, Azure Monitor, Dynatrace, Splunk, Workday, or SAP
* Background in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, government) and associated compliance requirements
* Exposure to DevOps practices as applied to ServiceNow development (source control integration, CI/CD pipelines, ATF)

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The PUD Manager is responsible for leading the end\-to\-end operations of one or more Pickup \& Delivery Units (PUDs), ensuring safe, timely and cost\-effective execution of first\-mile pickup, last\-mile delivery and customer service operations. The role is accountable for operational performance, fleet readiness, workforce productivity, customer satisfaction and service quality across the assigned locations.


Reporting to the Regional PUD Manager, the incumbent leads frontline operational teams, coordinates with cross\-functional stakeholders and transport partners, and ensures seamless integration of pickup, delivery and hub operations. The role drives operational discipline, revenue assurance, people capability and continuous improvement while ensuring compliance with organisational standards and customer commitments.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To lead and manage the operations of assigned Pickup \& Delivery Units by delivering operational excellence, customer service, workforce productivity, fleet optimisation and revenue assurance while ensuring safe, compliant and profitable first\-mile and last\-mile operations aligned with Blue Dart's service standards.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**PUD Operations Leadership**

* Lead the overall operations of the assigned PUD(s), ensuring consistent achievement of operational, service and business objectives.
* Drive operational planning and execution across pickup, delivery and customer service activities.
* Ensure adherence to operational workflows, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and service commitments.
* Monitor daily operational performance and implement timely corrective actions to address service gaps.
* Ensure operational readiness of manpower, fleet and infrastructure to support business requirements.

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Manage first\-mile pickup and last\-mile delivery operations to achieve committed service levels and customer expectations.
* Monitor daily pickup schedules, delivery performance and route execution to maximise operational efficiency.
* Ensure timely processing, dispatch and movement of shipments through seamless coordination with hubs and service centres.
* Drive reduction in missed pickups, delivery exceptions, return\-to\-origin (RTO) cases and operational delays.
* Monitor shipment visibility and ensure timely closure of operational exceptions.

**Customer Service \& Service Quality**

* Drive customer service excellence by ensuring adherence to pickup and delivery commitments.
* Partner with Customer Service teams to ensure timely resolution of customer complaints and service issues.
* Monitor customer feedback, operational performance and Net Promoter Score (NPS) trends to improve customer experience.
* Ensure timely communication and resolution of operational issues impacting customers.
* Support implementation of initiatives to improve customer satisfaction, service reliability and operational quality.

**Fleet, Route \& Resource Management**

* Ensure optimum deployment and utilisation of fleet resources to support daily pickup and delivery operations.
* Coordinate with Fleet Operations teams and transport partners to ensure vehicle availability and route optimisation.
* Monitor route productivity, vehicle utilisation and operational efficiency across assigned PUDs.
* Ensure availability of operational equipment, handheld devices and infrastructure to support uninterrupted operations.
* Support contingency planning during peak volumes, network disruptions and operational exigencies.

**Revenue Assurance \& Operational Controls**

* Drive revenue protection through adherence to shipment acceptance standards, reweigh compliance and operational controls.
* Ensure accurate processing of shipment documentation, manifests, COD reconciliation and operational records.
* Monitor operational exceptions impacting revenue and implement timely corrective actions.
* Drive compliance with billing, scanning and shipment handling processes to minimise operational leakage.
* Ensure effective utilisation and accountability of operational assets, handheld devices and infrastructure.

**Operational Governance \& Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with organisational policies, operational SOPs, statutory regulations and security requirements across the assigned PUD(s).
* Promote a culture of safety through adherence to road safety, workplace safety and shipment security standards.
* Support operational, quality and security audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Monitor operational risks and implement preventive actions to minimise service disruptions.
* Ensure governance through structured reviews, operational controls and performance monitoring.

**Team \& People Management**

* Lead, coach and develop Shift In\-charges, Fleet Executives, Quality \& Customer Service Executives and frontline operational teams across the assigned PUD(s).
* Build a high\-performance culture through regular performance reviews, coaching, mentoring and capability development.
* Ensure optimum manpower planning, deployment and utilisation across pickup, delivery and support operations.
* Drive employee engagement, discipline, attendance and adherence to organisational values and code of conduct.
* Support succession planning and implementation of functional training programmes to strengthen operational capability and leadership pipeline.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to improve productivity, route optimisation, service quality and operational efficiency across the assigned PUD(s).
* Drive implementation of process improvements, automation initiatives and operational best practices.
* Collaborate with Fleet, Hub Operations, Customer Service, Sales, HR and other support functions to improve end\-to\-end operational performance.
* Support regional transformation initiatives and ensure successful implementation of new operating models and digital solutions.
* Foster a culture of innovation, accountability and continuous improvement to enhance customer experience, operational excellence and business performance.

  



**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:


* Graduate in any discipline is mandatory.
* Degree or certification in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management or Business Management will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* **3–7 years** of experience in courier, express logistics, transportation, first\-mile, last\-mile or supply chain operations.
* Proven experience in managing pickup and delivery operations, branch operations, service centres, PUDs or similar operational units.
* Experience in leading frontline operational teams with accountability for customer service, workforce productivity, fleet coordination and operational performance.
* Exposure to service quality management, revenue assurance, route optimisation and operational governance within a high\-volume logistics environment.
* Experience in managing cross\-functional stakeholders and driving operational excellence through structured performance management and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Skills \& Capabilities:**

* Workforce Planning \& Productivity Management
* Revenue Assurance \& Operational Controls

**Key Competencies:**

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**


  

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

Clean Harbors Inc. (www.cleanharbors.com) is a NYSE listed US based $6\.3 billion company. Clean Harbors was founded in 1980 near Boston by Mr. Alan S. McKim, who today remains the company’s Chairman and CEO.  

Everywhere industry meets environment, Clean Harbors is on\-site, providing premier environmental, energy and industrial services. Clean Harbors employs a dedicated workforce of 18,000 employees and has over 450 service locations across the U.S., Canada and Mexico. title: Human Resources & Administration Operations Manager
description:
*India*

This role will be based in India – Bangalore and reports to the Human Resources Director, APAC.


**Brief Summary**
-----------------


This position will manage day\-to\-day human resources operations and general administration. The role is responsible for recruitment coordination, employee lifecycle management, attendance and payroll inputs, statutory compliance, employee engagement, performance management support, facilities administration, vendor coordination, and maintenance of HR records.


The ideal candidate should possess strong knowledge of HR processes and Indian labour laws, excellent interpersonal skills, and the ability to independently manage multiple operational priorities.


**Job Description**
-------------------


**Human Resources Operations**


* Manage employee lifecycle activities, including onboarding, confirmation, transfer, promotion, and separation.
* Prepare offer letters, appointment letters, confirmation letters, increment letters, experience certificates, and other employment\-related documents.
* Maintain accurate employee records, personnel files, HR databases, and HRIS information.
* Monitor attendance, leave, shift schedules, overtime, and employee regularisation requests.
* Coordinate monthly payroll inputs, including attendance, leave, incentives, deductions, reimbursements, and final settlements.
* Respond to employee queries regarding HR policies, attendance, leave, payroll, benefits, and employment matters.
* Ensure HR processes are completed within established timelines and approval procedures.

**Recruitment and Onboarding**


* Coordinate manpower requisitions with department heads and hiring managers.
* Source candidates through job portals, recruitment consultants, referrals, social media, and other appropriate channels.
* Screen applications, schedule interviews, coordinate selection processes, and follow up with candidates.
* Conduct reference and background verification as required.
* Manage pre\-joining documentation and joining formalities.
* Plan and conduct employee induction and orientation programmes.
* Track recruitment status, joining ratios, offer acceptance, and vacancy closure timelines.

**Performance Management and Training**


* Coordinate performance appraisal cycles and ensure timely completion of employee assessments.
* Support managers in setting performance goals and documenting employee feedback.
* Maintain records of appraisals, promotions, increments, and performance improvement plans.
* Identify training requirements in consultation with department heads.
* Coordinate internal and external training programmes.
* Maintain training calendars, attendance records, feedback, and effectiveness reports.

**Employee Engagement and Relations**


* Support employee engagement, recognition, welfare, and retention initiatives.
* Organise employee events, celebrations, meetings, surveys, and team\-building activities.
* Address employee concerns professionally and escalate sensitive matters when necessary.
* Support grievance handling and disciplinary processes in accordance with company policies.
* Conduct exit interviews, analyse reasons for attrition, and recommend corrective measures.
* Promote a positive, inclusive, and professional work environment.

**HR Policies and Statutory Compliance**


* Assist in communicating and implementing HR policies and procedures.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.
* Coordinate documentation relating to Provident Fund, ESIC, professional tax, gratuity, bonus, maternity benefits, and other applicable employee benefits.
* Maintain statutory registers, licences, notices, returns, and compliance records.
* Coordinate with consultants, auditors, government authorities, and legal advisers when required.
* Support internal, statutory, and HR audits and ensure timely closure of observations.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee information and sensitive organisational records.

**Administration and Facilities Management**


* Manage day\-to\-day office administration and ensure smooth workplace operations.
* Coordinate housekeeping, security, transportation, canteen, maintenance, stationery, and other administrative services.
* Manage office infrastructure, repairs, preventive maintenance, and utility services.
* Coordinate travel arrangements, hotel bookings, local transportation, and related documentation.
* Maintain records of company assets, access cards, mobile phones, laptops, SIM cards, and other administrative resources.
* Monitor office safety, security, hygiene, and emergency preparedness.
* Coordinate renewals of insurance policies, annual maintenance contracts, registrations, licences, and service agreements.
* Support office relocation, expansion, renovation, and workplace improvement projects when required.

**Vendor and Cost Management for HR and Administration Tasks**


* Identify, evaluate, appoint, and coordinate with HR and administration vendors.
* Obtain quotations, prepare comparative statements, and support commercial negotiations.
* Monitor vendor performance, service quality, contractual obligations, and payment documentation.
* Verify invoices and coordinate with the Finance department for timely payment.
* Track administrative expenses and identify opportunities for cost optimisation.
* Maintain vendor contracts, purchase records, and renewal schedules.

**Management Information and Reporting**


* Prepare periodic HR and administration reports for management review.
* Track manpower, recruitment, attendance, leave, overtime, attrition, training, and employee engagement data.
* Maintain HR dashboards and provide accurate information for management decision\-making.
* Monitor departmental budgets and report actual expenditure against approved budgets.
* Ensure all HR and administration data is complete, accurate, and submitted on time.

**Qualifications**
------------------


* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, Commerce, Management, or a related discipline.
* MBA, postgraduate degree, or diploma in Human Resource Management is preferred.
* Certification in labour laws, payroll, compliance, or HR analytics will be an advantage.
* 10–12 years of relevant experience in HR operations and general administration.

**Required Skills \& Abilities**
--------------------------------


* Practical knowledge of recruitment, payroll inputs, compliance, employee relations, performance management, and office administration.
* Experience working in \[Manufacturing/IT/Services/Corporate Office/Relevant Industry] is preferred.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook).
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Attention to detail and confidentiality.
* Ability to work in a team environment.
* Experience handling vendors, audits, statutory documentation, and administrative budgets is desirable.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn.
* Time management skills.
* Professional and approachable behaviour.

Take the lead and we’ll give you the support you need to be at the top of your game. And we offer you the freedom to be a positive disrupter and turn big ideas into bold, industry\-changing realities.


For our business, for clients, and for you

**APEX FUND SERVICES**

**Functional Title:** Senior Process Associate

**Department:** BPM

**Employment Type:** Permanent

**About Apex**


Apex Group Ltd., established in Bermuda in 2003, is a global financial services provider. With 50 offices worldwide and 12,000 employees upon the close of announced acquisitions, Apex delivers an extensive range of services to asset managers, capital markets, private clients and family offices. The Group has continually improved and evolved its capabilities to offer a single\-source solution through establishing the broadest range of services in the industry including fund services, digital onboarding and bank accounts, depositary, custody and super ManCo services, business services including HR and Payroll and a pioneering ESG Ratings and Advisory service for private companies.


We look to recruit bright, articulate, and numerate employees who are not afraid of a challenge. You are prepared to work hard, love what they do and be prepared to innovate.


Every employee plays a part in making Apex who we are today and the more that we grow, the more important that becomes. Whatever your career path or specialism Apex provides a global platform to allow you to thrive.

**About the Team:**


We are seeking a detail\-oriented and proactive Senior Process Associate to join our dynamic BPM – Lease Abstraction team. The Senior Process Associate is responsible for executing, reviewing, and improving operational processes with a high degree of accuracy and efficiency. This role supports complex tasks, ensures adherence to quality standards, and acts as a point of contact for escalations. The Senior Process Associate also contributes to process improvements, provides guidance to junior team members, and ensures timely delivery of assigned responsibilities.


Apex India office is in Pune or Hyderabad and Apex Bulgaria office is in Sofia, but we offer smart working, with some time working from home, as required.

**Key duties and responsibilities**

* Lease Document Review \- Analyze commercial and residential lease agreements to identify and extract critical financial, legal, and operational terms.
* Data Abstraction \& Validation: Review and validate key information such as rent schedules, renewal options, termination clauses, and operating expenses with 100% accuracy.
* Quality Assurance Leadership: Conduct juniors reviews, audits, and provide feedback to ensure compliance with SOPs and quality standards.
* Time Management: Ensure timely completion of deliverables within defined SLAs and KPIs.
* Mentorship \& Training: Support training and onboarding of new team members by sharing best practices and process knowledge
* Client\-Specific Customization \- Adapt abstraction formats and processes to meet unique client requirements and project specifications.
* Collaboration and Communication \- Work closely with team members, project leads, and cross\-functional departments to resolve queries and ensure smooth workflow.
* Documentation and Reporting \- Maintain proper documentation of abstracted leases and generate reports as required for internal tracking or client delivery.
* Compliance and Confidentiality \- Ensure all lease data is handled in accordance with confidentiality agreements and regulatory standards.
* Continuous Improvement \- Contribute to process enhancements, automation initiatives, and best practices to improve efficiency and accuracy

**Experience and skills:**

* Education: Any Graduate, preferably B.Com
* 3–5 years of experience in lease abstraction, real estate administration, or legal documentation review.
* Proven track record of working with commercial and residential lease agreements across diverse geographies and property types.
* Experience using lease abstraction platforms, document management systems, or real estate databases (e.g., Yardi, MRI, Lucernex, Visual Lease, CoStar).
* Familiarity with BPM (Business Process Management) environments and client\-driven service delivery models.
* Attention to Detail: Ability to identify and extract nuanced lease terms with precision and consistency.
* Legal and Real Estate Acumen: Understanding of lease structures, terminology, and implications of clauses such as CAM, rent escalations, and renewal options.
* Analytical Thinking: Strong ability to interpret complex documents and assess their impact on financial and operational metrics.
* Strong understanding of process workflows, SOPs, and quality control methodologies.
* Technical Proficiency: Skilled in Microsoft Excel, Word, and lease abstraction tools; comfortable navigating digital document workflows.
* Communication: Clear and concise written communication to produce accurate lease summaries and collaborate with internal teams.
* Time Management: Capable of handling multiple leases and meeting tight deadlines without compromising quality.
* Quality Assurance: Commitment to maintaining high standards through peer reviews, audits, and continuous improvement.

**Nice to have:**

* Exposure to global lease portfolios and multi\-jurisdictional legal frameworks.
* Knowledge of IFRS 16 / ASC 842 lease accounting standards.
* Experience in process automation or working with AI\-assisted abstraction tools.


Disclaimer: Unsolicited CVs sent to Apex (Talent Acquisition Team or Hiring Managers) by recruitment agencies will not be accepted for this position. Apex operates a direct sourcing model and where agency assistance is required, the Talent Acquisition team will engage directly with our exclusive recruitment partners.

* Proactively identify trends and suggest actions to reduce risk, provide proactive guidance to managers that will ultimately improve the employee experience.
* Ensure that service delivery standards are consistently met or exceeded by the HRBP Advisory team by providing high quality support and guidance.

**What you'll bring to the role:**

* Experience working as an HR Business Partner, supporting US workforce management and US labor laws.
* Prior experience supporting Financial Services.
* Knowledge of Workday, Ticketing, Compensation and Talent platforms.
* Strong Microsoft Office skills in Excel, Power Point, Word, etc. Experience with HRIS and ability to pick up new systems quickly.

Our values \- putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back \- aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. **Compensation, Benefits \& Payroll Support**

* Support compensation benchmarking and annual compensation review exercises.
* Assist employees with benefits\-related queries and enrollments mainly medical insurance, Term and Accident insurance.


**HR Compliance \& Governance**


* Help in filing of employee documentation and records
* Support preparation of required letters and reports.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee information.
* Participate in HR process improvement and policy enhancement \& formulation initiatives.
* Ensure adherence to company policies, ethical standards, and professional code of compliance and conduct guidelines**.**

* Bachelor's or Post Graduate degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, Commerce, or related field.

title: SME-Learning & Development
description:
Job Summary
  
This hybrid role as a subject matter expert in learning and development focuses on creating and delivering training solutions for claims adjudication and health care compliance within provider and payer environments. The position supports night shift operations enabling global coverage while ensuring accurate claims handling regulatory alignment and continuous capability building across multiple functional teams.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
Design comprehensive training programs that build strong capability in claims adjudication processes for provider and payer operations while aligning with current business objectives and quality standards.
  
Develop detailed learning content that simplifies complex health care claim rules and workflows so that new and existing team members can perform adjudication tasks with high accuracy and consistency.
  
Deliver engaging virtual and classroom training sessions during night shift hours to support hybrid team members and ensure consistent knowledge transfer across locations.
  
Conduct targeted training needs analysis by collaborating with operations and quality teams to identify skill gaps in claims adjudication and prioritize high impact learning interventions.
  
Monitor learner performance data and quality audit outcomes to refine course materials and ensure that training directly improves claim resolution accuracy and turnaround time.
  
Ensure that all learning content reflects current health care regulations and privacy requirements related to HIPAA so that team members handle sensitive information responsibly.
  
Create practical simulations and case based exercises that mirror real life provider and payer claim scenarios to help learners build confidence and decision making skills.
  
Provide ongoing floor support during production hours by answering process queries and clarifying adjudication rules so that associates can resolve complex claims efficiently.
  
Collaborate with process experts and compliance teams to update training materials whenever there are changes in benefit designs coding standards or regulatory guidance.
  
Track training effectiveness through feedback surveys assessments and quality metrics and present insights that show how learning programs support business performance and member satisfaction.
  
Maintain detailed training records and documentation that support internal audits and demonstrate adherence to organizational learning standards and regulatory expectations.
  
Coordinate with workforce management and team supervisors to schedule training sessions that minimize business disruption while meeting the needs of night shift hybrid associates.
  
Support the adoption of digital learning tools and knowledge repositories so that team members can access updated claims adjudication and HIPAA guidance on demand.
  
  

Qualifications
  
Apply strong knowledge of health care claims adjudication rules benefit structures and payment policies to design technically accurate learning content for provider and payer processes.
  
Use hands on experience with provider and payer workflows to explain real world scenarios and guide learners in applying policy rules to complex claim situations.
  
Apply working knowledge of HIPAA requirements and data privacy expectations to embed compliance guidelines into every stage of the learning and support process.
  
Utilize prior operations or quality experience within claims environments to connect training topics with performance outcomes such as first pass resolution and reduced rework.
  
Demonstrate proficiency with common office productivity tools and learning platforms to create clear presentations job aids and reference guides for hybrid teams.
  
Communicate clearly and inclusively with diverse audiences across global locations while adapting explanations to suit different experience levels and learning styles.
  
Show readiness to work permanent night shifts in a hybrid work model while maintaining high levels of responsiveness reliability and collaboration with onshore and offshore partners.
