title: HR & Executive Assistant | Zenara Health
description:
About Zenara


Zenara is building technology to enable a new way to practise psychiatry: whole\-person, continuous and psychiatrist\-led care.


Our products help psychiatric practices understand patients more deeply before visits, capture more useful signal between visits, and support more consistent ongoing care — while keeping the psychiatrist firmly at the centre of clinical decision\-making.


We are a growing, distributed company with team members working across India and other international markets. We are expanding the team, and we need a highly organised and trusted person to strengthen our recruitment, people\-operations and executive\-administration capabilities.


About the role
You will support our founders and leadership team across four connected areas: recruitment coordination, HR and people administration, timesheet and payroll administration, and confidential executive support.


This is a hands\-on, execution\-focused role. You will keep processes moving, maintain accurate records, communicate clearly with candidates and colleagues, and make sure agreed tasks are completed reliably and on time.


To be clear about the level: this is not a senior HR strategy or employment\-law role. We are looking for someone practical, highly organised, discreet, and capable of independently running routine people and administrative workflows without being chased.


You will have access to sensitive information — employee records, compensation details, candidate information, company plans and leadership discussions. Trust, discretion and sound judgement are essential parts of the job, not add\-ons to it.


What you will own1\. Recruitment coordination* Maintain the recruitment pipeline across multiple open positions
* Keep Workable, Linear and other recruitment trackers accurate and up to date
* Review incoming applications against agreed role requirements
* Organise and prioritise candidates for review
* Coordinate first\-round screening and interviews
* Communicate with candidates throughout the process
* Schedule interviews across India, US and other relevant time zones
* Send interview instructions, reminders and follow\-ups
* Track candidate completion of screening, interviews and assessments
* Coordinate background and reference checks where required
* Prepare candidate information for interviewers
* Maintain accurate records of interview outcomes and next steps
* Make sure candidates are followed up promptly and professionally
* Support offer, pre\-boarding and onboarding administration
* Help improve our recruitment workflows and systems as we scale


We are building technology\-supported recruitment workflows, including automated candidate screening, interview processes, ranking and follow\-up. You will help operate, monitor and improve those workflows rather than relying only on manual administration.


2\. HR and people administration* Maintain accurate employee records and HR documentation
* Support employee onboarding and offboarding
* Coordinate collection of required employee information and documents
* Track leave, attendance and other routine people\-administration matters
* Maintain records of probation periods, review dates and employment milestones
* Prepare standard HR letters, documents and internal records
* Support the administration of employment agreements
* Make sure routine HR processes are completed consistently and on time
* Respond to straightforward employee administration questions
* Escalate sensitive or complex employee matters to the founders
* Keep HR files organised, accurate and accessible


This role provides HR administration and coordination. You will not be expected to provide independent legal, employment\-law or senior employee\-relations advice.


3\. Timesheets and payroll administration* Collect and monitor employee timesheets
* Follow up on missing or incomplete submissions
* Maintain accurate records for payroll processing
* Prepare payroll inputs for review and submission
* Coordinate with payroll providers, accountants and other relevant parties
* Track payroll\-related questions and issues
* Maintain records of approved payments and payroll documentation


You will not own payroll, compensation or employment\-policy decisions. Your responsibility is to make sure the administrative process is accurate, organised and completed on time.


4\. Executive assistance* Provide trusted administrative support to our two co\-founders
* Manage and coordinate calendars and meetings
* Schedule internal and external meetings
* Prepare agendas, action lists and follow\-up trackers
* Record or organise meeting actions where required
* Follow up with team members on agreed actions
* Coordinate travel arrangements and related logistics
* Organise documents and information for leadership discussions
* Assist with practical administrative tasks and research
* Support occasional projects that need careful coordination and follow\-through


This will include practical, get\-it\-done administrative work. You should be comfortable handling a broad range of tasks without losing sight of priorities.


5\. Confidentiality and information management* Treat employee, candidate, compensation and company information as strictly confidential
* Store and share sensitive information only through approved systems
* Use sound judgement about who should have access to what
* Maintain professional boundaries with colleagues
* Avoid informal discussion of confidential matters
* Escalate any suspected confidentiality or data\-security issue immediately


You will be part of the trusted leadership\-support function. You should be comfortable working openly and warmly with the wider team while understanding that some information simply must not be shared.


Your first 60 days* Understand our current recruitment and HR workflows
* Review and organise existing employee and candidate records
* Get familiar with Workable, Linear and our other systems
* Take ownership of recruitment coordination for the roles we have open
* Establish a reliable process for interview scheduling and candidate follow\-up
* Take over timesheet and payroll administration
* Document recurring HR and executive\-administration processes
* Establish a regular reporting rhythm with the founders
* Identify administrative gaps, duplication or unnecessary manual work


What success looks like* Recruitment pipelines stay accurate and current
* Candidates receive timely, professional communication
* Interviews are scheduled efficiently and follow\-ups are never missed
* Recruitment workflows are consistently operated and steadily improved
* Employee records and HR documents are complete and organised
* Timesheet and payroll administration is accurate and on time
* Routine HR questions and administrative requests are handled without escalation
* The founders spend materially less time on scheduling, follow\-up and administrative coordination
* Sensitive information is handled with complete discretion
* The company has a more reliable and scalable people\-operations process


RequirementsRequired* Previous experience in HR administration, recruitment coordination, executive assistance, office administration or people operations
* Experience coordinating several tasks, candidates or workflows at the same time
* Strong organisational skills and genuine attention to detail
* Excellent written and verbal English
* Confidence communicating with candidates, employees, consultants and senior leaders
* Experience maintaining accurate records, trackers and documentation
* Proficiency with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office or equivalent
* Ability to work independently in a remote, distributed environment
* Strong follow\-through, and the willingness to chase outstanding actions
* Mature judgement when handling confidential information
* Ability to prioritise and meet deadlines
* Comfort learning new software, automation tools and AI\-enabled workflows
* A calm, professional and dependable working style


Strongly preferred* Experience recruiting for a startup or growing technology company
* Experience supporting recruitment across multiple roles at once
* Experience using Workable, Linear, an applicant\-tracking system or equivalent
* Experience with timesheet and payroll administration
* Previous experience as an executive assistant to founders or senior leaders


Nice to have* Experience supporting international or distributed teams
* Experience coordinating across India, US and UK time zones
* Experience working with confidential compensation or employee information
* Familiarity with AI tools and workflow automation
* Experience documenting and improving administrative processes


Who you are* Trustworthy and discreet
* Highly organised
* Reliable and responsive
* Comfortable taking ownership of routine tasks
* Willing to ask when something is unclear
* Able to work with limited supervision
* Calm under pressure
* Professional with candidates and employees
* Comfortable in a fast\-moving company
* Practical and solutions\-oriented
* Accountable for completion, not just activity


Working hours and location
This is a fully remote role, based anywhere in India.


You will work primarily during Indian working hours, with planned and reasonable overlap with the founders when required. This role should not require a routine late\-night schedule. Any out\-of\-hours work will be occasional, agreed in advance, and proportionate to the business need.


You will work remotely but in regular contact with the founders. Expect regular leadership check\-ins, clear written updates on recruitment and HR workflows, accurate records in the relevant systems, prompt escalation of blockers, visible tracking of outstanding actions, and reliable availability during agreed hours.


Compensation

**Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Corporate**


We’re a global, multi\-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Corporate, you are integral to our company’s award\-winning success.

* Enrich your managerial and organizational talents – from finance, quality, and supply chain to human resources, IT, sales, and strategy
* Augment your comprehensive skillset with expert training across decision\-making, change management, leadership, and business development

**About the Role**


As a Specialist, Global Benefits \& Well\-being (Corporate), you will be a key member of HARMAN's Global Benefits Center of Excellence (CoE), supporting the design, governance, continuous improvement, and future evolution of global benefits and well\-being programs.


Reporting to the Global Director of Benefits, you will partner with stakeholders across Europe, APAC, and the Americas to support program design, governance, compliance, well\-being initiatives, M\&A activity, and strategic projects. You will combine strong analytical capability with a continuous improvement mindset to generate insights, solve problems, simplify processes, and help deliver scalable solutions that enhance employee experience and organizational success.


This role offers exposure to high\-impact global initiatives and is ideal for someone who is naturally curious, enjoys tackling complex challenges, embraces innovation, and is motivated by creating practical value for others.

**What You Will Do**


Your responsibilities will include:

* Naturally curious and eager to learn.

* Adaptable, proactive, and resilient.
* Continuous improvement mindset with strong ownership and accountability.
* Collaborative and effective across cultures and geographies.

\#LI\-Hybrid

About The Role:  

As a Benefits Expert \- Invoicing \& PO Management, you independently lead and manage invoicing, purchase order, vendor management, reconciliation, reporting, and governance activities across assigned benefits programs. You do this by partnering closely with the core Benefits team, ensuring operational excellence, maintaining compliance and financial accuracy, and delivering a high\-quality stakeholder experience.  

  

In this role, you serve as a key point of contact for billing and payment\-related processes, supporting business continuity, resolving stakeholder queries, and ensuring the timely and accurate execution of invoicing and PO activities. You also drive continuous improvement initiatives, strengthening controls, enhancing process efficiency, and supporting the evolving needs of the Benefits organization.
### **About the Role**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage end\-to\-end Purchase Order (PO) and Invoice Management activities across benefits programs globally, ensuring timely creation, maintenance, amendment, closure, monitoring, processing, approval, payment tracking, and compliance with procurement, finance, and internal control requirements.
* Serve as a key point of contact for stakeholders, vendors, Finance, Procurement, P2P Operations, and business partners to resolve operational issues, invoice discrepancies, payment\-related queries, and support vendor onboarding, master data maintenance, documentation follow\-ups, and vendor lifecycle management.
* Support financial governance activities including budget tracking, accrual reviews, spend monitoring, open commitment management, reconciliations, reporting, and ensuring appropriate cost center usage, financial allocations, and adherence to corporate financial policies and controls.
* Maintain accurate operational databases, trackers, and financial records to ensure transparency, audit readiness, effective decision\-making, and the availability of complete and accurate documentation for audit, compliance, and management reporting activities.
* Monitor operational risks, identify process gaps, perform root cause analysis, and drive issue resolution through collaboration with cross\-functional teams.
* Support process improvement initiatives focused on enhancing efficiency, strengthening controls, improving stakeholder experience, reducing manual effort, and leveraging automation and digital solutions where appropriate.
* Develop, maintain, and continuously improve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), process documentation, governance materials, and knowledge repositories while supporting business continuity through cross\-training, knowledge sharing, and acting as backup for critical operational processes.
* Take ownership of assigned workstreams, manage multiple priorities, ensure high levels of quality, accuracy, and service delivery, and build strong relationships with global stakeholders through effective communication of operational and financial matters.

**Essential Requirements:**

* Full time graduation with 5\-7 years of experience in Finance Operations, with strong expertise in Accounts Payable, Purchase Order Management, Invoice Processing, and Financial Governance.
* Knowledge of SAP Ariba and procurement processes.
* Proven experience in Contract and Vendor Management, including vendor onboarding, master data maintenance, and stakeholder coordination. MBA or equivalent in Finance is preferred.
* Strong understanding of financial controls, reconciliations, budget tracking, accrual management, and audit/compliance requirements.
* Experience working with global stakeholders across Finance, Procurement, P2P, HR/Benefits, and external vendors in a multinational environment
* Demonstrated track record of driving process improvement, automation, standardization, and operational excellence initiatives.
* Proven experience managing complex operational processes and global stakeholder relationships.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment while maintaining strong attention to detail and ownership of deliverables.

**Desirable Requirements:**

* Familiarity with vendor governance and vendor management activities.
* Experience collaborating with cross\-functional and geographically diverse stakeholder groups.
* Exposure to process improvement and automation initiatives.
* Experience working in global, complex, and matrixed organizations.

title: Senior Research Associate
description:
Job Description — Research Associate / Process Engineer – Molten Salt Electrolysis

**Company:** Motorall / AmpCycle  
**Position:** Research Associate / Process Engineer – Molten Salt Electrolysis  
**Department:** R\&D / Advanced Materials \& Electrochemical Processing  
**Location:** Rohini, Delhi 110089\.  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 2–5 years relevant experience  
**Qualification:** M.Sc./M.Tech./B.Tech. in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Electrochemistry, Metallurgy or a related field

About the Role

We are looking for a hands\-on researcher/engineer to work on the development of **molten\-salt electrolysis and high\-temperature electrochemical processes** for the recovery and purification of valuable metallic constituents from complex solid feedstocks.

The candidate will work across the complete laboratory process chain, from **feedstock preparation and pretreatment to electrochemical separation, product recovery, purification and characterization**, with a focus on developing a scalable and commercially viable process.

Key Responsibilities1\. Feedstock Preparation

* Develop methods for receiving, sorting and preparing complex metallic feedstocks.
* Study dismantling, demagnetization and mechanical size reduction requirements.
* Develop crushing, grinding, sieving and particle\-size\-control procedures.
* Evaluate the effect of particle size and feedstock composition on downstream processing.
* Develop suitable methods for removing coatings, surface contaminants, adhesives and other unwanted materials.
* Establish safe handling and storage procedures for processed powders.

2\. Pretreatment \& Conditioning

* Develop thermal, chemical or mechanical pretreatment methods as required.
* Investigate oxidation/reduction behaviour of feedstock materials.
* Optimize removal of unwanted phases and contaminants before electrochemical processing.
* Study moisture, oxygen and impurity control requirements.
* Develop suitable drying and conditioning procedures.
* Establish reproducible feedstock specifications for electrolysis.

3\. Powder Processing

* Develop laboratory\-scale powder\-processing procedures.
* Study particle morphology, size distribution and chemical composition.
* Optimize powder preparation for uniform interaction with molten salts.
* Investigate material losses during crushing, sieving, transfer and handling.
* Maintain material balance throughout the process.

4\. Molten\-Salt Preparation

* Research and select suitable molten\-salt systems for electrochemical processing.
* Prepare and condition molten\-salt electrolytes.
* Study salt composition, melting behaviour and operating temperature.
* Control moisture and contamination in molten\-salt systems.
* Investigate salt conductivity and electrochemical stability.
* Optimize salt\-to\-feedstock ratio and operating conditions.
* Develop procedures for salt recovery, regeneration and reuse where applicable.

5\. Electrochemical Cell Development

* Assist in the design and development of laboratory\-scale molten\-salt electrolysis cells.
* Select suitable electrode, crucible and reactor materials.
* Study electrode configuration and electrode spacing.
* Develop systems for controlled feeding of solid material.
* Establish electrical connections and current/voltage control.
* Evaluate cell design, sealing, insulation and thermal management.
* Develop safe procedures for high\-temperature electrochemical operation.

6\. Molten\-Salt Electrolysis

* Conduct controlled electrolysis experiments under defined temperature and electrical conditions.
* Optimize current density, cell voltage, temperature and electrolysis duration.
* Study electrodeposition behaviour and product formation.
* Investigate selective deposition and separation behaviour.
* Monitor electrochemical parameters during operation.
* Identify factors affecting current efficiency, recovery, purity and energy consumption.
* Troubleshoot unstable electrolysis, electrode degradation, short circuits and other process issues.

7\. Product Collection \& Separation

* Develop methods for collecting deposited metallic products.
* Separate deposited material from electrodes and reactor components.
* Develop washing, salt\-removal and drying procedures.
* Recover entrained molten salt where possible.
* Develop methods for separating different product fractions.
* Minimize product loss during post\-electrolysis processing.

8\. Purification \& Downstream Processing

* Develop suitable post\-processing and purification procedures.
* Study thermal, chemical and electrochemical purification methods where required.
* Optimize removal of residual salts and impurities.
* Develop methods for achieving consistent product purity.
* Establish suitable product specifications based on application requirements.

9\. Characterization \& Analysis

The candidate should be capable of performing or coordinating characterization using techniques such as:

* XRD
* SEM/FESEM
* EDS/EDX
* ICP\-OES / ICP\-MS
* XRF
* Raman spectroscopy
* TGA/DSC
* Particle\-size analysis
* Electrochemical characterization
* Chemical composition analysis
* Metallographic analysis

The candidate will be responsible for correlating feedstock composition, electrolysis parameters and final product quality.

10\. Process Optimization

* Perform experimental optimization of temperature, current density, voltage, salt composition, feedstock loading and electrolysis time.
* Conduct controlled experimental studies and maintain detailed laboratory records.
* Develop material and energy balances.
* Evaluate recovery, purity, current efficiency and specific energy consumption.
* Identify process bottlenecks.
* Develop repeatable laboratory protocols.
* Compare alternative process configurations.
* Support development of Design of Experiments (DoE) where appropriate.

11\. Scale\-Up

* Support transition from laboratory\-scale experiments to larger electrochemical systems.
* Develop preliminary reactor and cell\-sizing calculations.
* Study heat management and thermal uniformity.
* Evaluate electrode life and reactor material compatibility.
* Develop continuous or semi\-continuous processing concepts where applicable.
* Identify engineering challenges associated with scale\-up.
* Support pilot\-scale equipment development and commissioning.

12\. Process Safety

* Follow strict procedures for high\-temperature operations.
* Develop SOPs for molten\-salt handling.
* Maintain appropriate ventilation and containment systems.
* Follow procedures for handling reactive chemicals, metallic powders and high\-temperature materials.
* Assess risks associated with corrosive salts and chemical exposure.
* Follow appropriate protocols for electrical and high\-current equipment.
* Where applicable, understand and follow institutional procedures for handling **radioactive materials or contaminated materials**.
* Maintain chemical waste and process\-residue management procedures.

13\. Documentation \& R\&D

* Maintain detailed laboratory notebooks and experimental records.
* Prepare technical reports and experimental summaries.
* Develop SOPs and process\-flow documentation.
* Perform literature and patent reviews.
* Benchmark published electrochemical processes.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and IP generation.
* Prepare technical data for pilot projects, grants and commercialization activities.

Required Technical Knowledge

Candidates should have working knowledge of several of the following:

* Molten\-salt electrochemistry
* Electrolysis
* Electrodeposition
* High\-temperature chemical processing
* Electrochemical cell design
* Inorganic chemistry
* Metallurgy
* Materials processing
* Powder processing
* Thermal processing
* Chemical separation
* Electrochemical characterization
* Process development
* Laboratory\-scale reactor development

Preferred Experience

Preference will be given to candidates with hands\-on experience in:

* Molten\-salt electrolysis
* High\-temperature electrochemistry
* Electrowinning/electrorefining
* Metal extraction
* Metal deposition
* Chloride/fluoride molten\-salt systems
* Electrochemical separation
* High\-temperature reactors
* Powder metallurgy
* Metallurgical processing
* Recycling of complex metallic feedstocks
* Electrochemical process scale\-up
* High\-current DC power systems
* Inert\-atmosphere processing

Experience with **Glove Box, tube furnace, high\-temperature reactor, potentiostat/galvanostat, DC power supply or electrolysis cell development** will be advantageous.

Educational Qualification

**Preferred:**

* M.Tech./M.E. in Metallurgical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Engineering, Electrochemistry or related fields.
* M.Sc. in Chemistry, Inorganic Chemistry, Physical Chemistry, Materials Chemistry or Electrochemistry.
* B.Tech./B.E. in Chemical, Metallurgical, Materials or related engineering disciplines with strong electrochemical research experience.

Experience

**2–5 years of relevant research or industrial experience.**

Freshers are generally not preferred.

Candidates should demonstrate practical laboratory/research experience rather than only theoretical knowledge.

The ideal candidate should be:

* Hands\-on and experimentally strong.
* Comfortable working at high temperatures.
* Strong in electrochemistry and inorganic chemistry.
* Comfortable designing experiments independently.
* Good at troubleshooting experimental failures.
* Strong in scientific data interpretation.
* Comfortable working with laboratory equipment.
* Interested in converting laboratory chemistry into an industrial process.
* Comfortable working in a startup environment where processes are still being developed.

title: CMM Programmer & Quality Inspector
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

**Position:** CMM Programmer \& Quality Inspector  
**Department:** Quality Assurance  
**Location:** LGB Forge Ltd., Coimbatore  
**Reporting To:** Quality Manager / Quality Engineer

Job Purpose

To carry out dimensional inspection of components using Coordinate Measuring Machine (CMM), develop and execute CMM inspection programs, analyse measurement results, and ensure products meet drawing, customer and quality requirements.

Key Responsibilities

* Operate CMM equipment for dimensional inspection of forged and machined components.
* Create, modify and execute CMM inspection programs as per component drawings and inspection requirements.
* Read and interpret engineering drawings, GD\&T, tolerances and specifications.
* Perform dimensional inspection using CMM and other precision measuring instruments.
* Prepare and maintain CMM inspection reports and measurement records.
* Verify critical dimensions, geometrical tolerances, profile, position, concentricity, flatness and other GD\&T characteristics.
* Carry out first\-off, in\-process and final inspection as required.
* Identify dimensional deviations and communicate non\-conformities to the concerned department.
* Support root cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions for quality issues.
* Maintain CMM equipment, fixtures, probes and accessories in good working condition.
* Ensure proper calibration status of measuring instruments and CMM equipment.
* Maintain inspection records as per the Quality Management System requirements.
* Support customer inspection, new product development and PPAP activities, wherever required.
* Coordinate with Production, Tool Room, Engineering and Quality teams for dimensional issues.
* Follow company safety, quality and housekeeping requirements.
* Participate in internal/customer audits and provide required measurement records and data.

Technical Skills Required

* Good knowledge of **CMM operation and programming**.
* Knowledge of **GD\&T and engineering drawings**.
* Knowledge of measuring instruments such as Vernier Caliper, Micrometer, Height Gauge, Bore Gauge, etc.
* Ability to analyse CMM measurement reports and identify deviations.
* Knowledge of inspection methods and quality standards.
* Basic computer skills and ability to maintain inspection records.
* Knowledge of CMM software such as **PC\-DMIS / CALYPSO / MODUS** will be an advantage.

Qualification

* Diploma / ITI / B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent.
* Candidates with relevant CMM inspection experience will be preferred.

Experience

**2–5 years of experience in CMM operation/programming in an automotive, forging or machining industry.**

Freshers with strong knowledge of GD\&T and CMM may also be considered for a trainee\-level position.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Food provided
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

title: Security Engineer II
description:
**XSIAM Administrator \& Automation Engineer**
**About The Role**
 We are looking for an XSIAM Administrator \& Automation Engineer to own the day\-to\-day administration, data onboarding, detection engineering and automation strategy of our Cortex XSIAM (Extended Security Intelligence and Automation Management) platform. This role sits at the intersection of security operations engineering and AI\-driven automation — you will design, build, and continuously improve the detection content, playbooks, and AI\-assisted workflows that let our SOC operate at machine speed. You will work closely with multiple security operations team such as incident response, threat hunt, insider risk to ensure XSIAM is correctly configured, fully onboarded, and increasingly autonomous in how it triages, investigates, and responds to threats.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Platform Administration**
* Administer and maintain the Cortex XSIAM tenant: user roles, RBAC, licensing, health monitoring, and platform upgrades.
* Onboard and normalize new data sources (logs, endpoint telemetry, cloud, identity, network) using XDM (Cortex Data Model) mapping and parsing rules.
* Manage integrations and content packs, including third\-party connectors, brokers, and collectors.
* Tune detection content — BIOCs, correlation rules, analytics, and incident scoring — to reduce noise and improve fidelity.
* Monitor platform performance, data ingestion costs, and storage tiering, and troubleshoot ingestion or parsing failures.


**Logging and Detection Engineering**
* Onboard logs directly from sources or via secure data pipeline management solution such as Cribl
* Extend detection engineering scope by creating corelation, analytics rule using XSIAM jupyter notebooks.
* Support detection engineering and threat\-hunting initiatives with automation and XQL query development.


**Automation \& Playbook Engineering**
* Design, build, and maintain automation playbooks (XSOAR/XSIAM playbook engine) to automate alert triage, enrichment, containment, and remediation.
* Develop custom automations, scripts, and integrations (Python) to extend out\-of\-the\-box XSIAM capabilities.
* Continuously identify manual SOC workflows and convert them into automated, auditable playbooks, driving down mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to respond (MTTR).
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for playbook and content versioning, testing, and deployment across environments.


**AI\-Driven Security Operations**
* Apply Cortex XSIAM's native AI/ML capabilities (AI\-driven incident scoring, causality analysis, alert clustering, and DRP/attack\-surface insights) to accelerate investigation and reduce analyst workload.
* Integrate large language model (LLM)\-based assistants and agentic workflows into playbooks for tasks such as alert summarization, natural\-language incident querying, phishing/malware triage, and auto\-generated investigation reports.
* Evaluate and pilot emerging AI/agentic\-SOC features (e.g., autonomous investigation agents, AI copilots, natural\-language\-to\-XQL query generation) and lead responsible adoption across the security operations team.
* Build feedback loops and guardrails (human\-in\-the\-loop approval steps, confidence thresholds, audit logging) to ensure AI\-assisted actions remain safe, explainable, and compliant.
* Use AI\-assisted coding tools to accelerate development of custom scripts, integrations, and XQL queries, while maintaining rigorous testing and code\-review standards.


**Required Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of experience in security operations, SIEM/SOAR administration, or detection/automation engineering.
* Hands\-on experience administering Cortex XSIAM, Cortex XSOAR, or a comparable SIEM/SOAR platform (Splunk SOAR, Microsoft Sentinel, IBM QRadar, etc.).
* Strong scripting ability in Python, and comfort working with REST APIs to build custom integrations.
* Practical knowledge of XQL (or equivalent query language) for building correlation rules, dashboards, and threat\-hunting queries.
* Solid understanding of SOC workflows: alert triage, incident response, threat intelligence, and case management.
* Experience with data onboarding/parsing (log normalization, XDM/CIM\-style schemas) from diverse sources (EDR, cloud, network, identity).
* Familiarity with applying or integrating AI/LLM capabilities into operational workflows (prompt design, AI copilots, or agentic automation) — production experience preferred, strong conceptual understanding acceptable.


**﻿Preferred Qualifications**
* Palo Alto Networks Certified XSIAM Engineer, XSIAM Analyst, or XSOAR Engineer certification.
* Experience with CI/CD tooling (Git, Jenkins/GitHub Actions) for security content and playbook lifecycle management.
* Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerized environments.
* Experience with MITRE ATT\&CK\-mapped detection engineering.
* Prior experience deploying agentic AI workflows, AI\-assisted SOC copilots, or natural\-language query interfaces in a security context.


**Education**
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Relevant certifications (CISSP, CISM, CEH) are preferred.

The Company supports businesses throughout the international trade lifecycle, including business connections, verification, negotiations, digital tri\-partite agreements, export services, shipment coordination, after\-sales support and related business services.

The Company primarily serves 10 product sectors from India across 25 international countries.

Role

As an International B2B Marketing Executive, you will be responsible for developing and executing practical digital and organic marketing activities to strengthen TradeInfra's online presence, brand visibility and engagement among relevant Indian and international business audiences.

The role focuses on Digital Marketing, Social Media Marketing, SEO, Content Marketing, B2B Brand Marketing and organic online growth, using available free tools, platforms and AI technologies.

Important: This role is suitable for candidates who can independently work with free tools and platforms. The Company will not provide paid marketing tools or subscriptions at this stage. The Executive will be expected to build and develop marketing activities from a startup\-level foundation. A B2B website is already available for TradeInfra.

Responsibilities

\- Plan and execute Digital Marketing activities to improve TradeInfra's online visibility and brand presence.

\- Generate relevant B2B leads through digital marketing and organic online channels.

\- Manage Social Media Marketing across LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and other relevant platforms.

\- Create, publish and optimise professional B2B content for International Buyers, Indian Suppliers, industries, products and international trade.

\- Execute practical SEO activities, including keyword research, search\-intent research, content optimisation and basic on\-page SEO.

\- Create AI\-assisted marketing videos, short\-form videos and other visual content using available free AI and digital tools.

\- Monitor marketing performance, analyse results and continuously improve campaigns and content.

\- Support the Sales/Business Development team with relevant marketing content, campaigns and audience insights.

\- Maintain accurate marketing records and submit required weekly performance reports to management.

\- Follow Company policies, SOPs, confidentiality requirements and approved brand guidelines.

Compensation

This is a performance\-based opportunity with no fixed salary or guaranteed monthly income.

The Marketing Executive will be eligible for a Performance Incentive of up to 8% on every successful sale generated by the Company, irrespective of which authorised Business Development Executive completes the sale.

The applicable incentive will be based on the Executive's work, performance and demonstrated marketing results.

Incentive eligibility will begin after completion of the first month from the date of joining, subject to satisfactory performance and the Company's applicable incentive policy.

Working Arrangement

\- Good understanding of digital marketing and major social media platforms.

\- Basic knowledge of SEO, keyword research, content optimisation and organic marketing.

\- Ability to create professional written and visual B2B content.

\- Ability to effectively use free AI tools and technologies for marketing activities and productivity.

\- Ability to create or learn to create short\-form marketing videos and visual content using free tools.

\- Familiarity with Canva or similar free design tools is preferred.

\- Good written and verbal communication skills.

\- Creative thinking and ability to develop practical marketing ideas.

\- Ability to learn TradeInfra's business model, services and target audiences and apply marketing skills accordingly.

\- Strong self\-learning ability and willingness to continuously improve marketing skills.

\- Self\-motivated and capable of working independently in a startup environment.

\- Comfortable with performance\-based compensation.

\- Minimum Age: 18\+

\- Education: 12th / Graduation / Master's

\- Location: India

\- Work Mode: Work From Home

Company Support

The Company will provide the necessary business understanding, product/service information, marketing direction, operational guidance, SOPs and relevant training required to understand TradeInfra's business and target audiences.

The Executive will be expected to independently apply their marketing skills using available free digital platforms, free tools and AI technologies to produce measurable marketing results.

The objective is not simply to publish content. The objective is to build TradeInfra's digital presence, organic reach, credibility, lead generation and overall marketing impact among relevant Indian and international business audiences.

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. description:
**About Apptimate**

Apptimate is a modular and scalable ERP solution designed to help businesses manage their day to day operations through a single platform. It offers multiple integrated modules helping businesses streamline their operations and reduce dependency on multiple standalone systems.

**About the Role**

We are looking for **Customer Support Executives** who will be responsible for assisting Apptimate users and businesses through calls, understanding their concerns, guiding them on the platform, and ensuring a smooth customer experience.

The ideal candidate should be confident on calls, patient while handling customers, and comfortable communicating in **Haryanvi**.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Handle inbound and outbound calls from Apptimate customers/users.
* Understand customer queries related to Apptimate ERP and its modules.
* Guide customers regarding basic product features, processes and usage.
* Assist customers with issues related to **Apptimate modules**.
* Follow up with customers to ensure their issues are resolved.
* Coordinate with the technical/product team for issues requiring further assistance.
* Maintain proper records of customer queries, complaints and resolutions.
* Communicate product updates, changes and important information to customers when required.
* Ensure timely response and a positive customer experience.
* Identify recurring customer issues and share feedback with the internal team for product improvement.

**Requirements**

* Excellent verbal communication and customer handling skills.
* **Fluency in Haryanvi is mandatory.**
* Basic English/Hindi communication skills will be an added advantage.
* Comfortable handling regular customer calls and follow ups.
* Basic computer knowledge.
* Ability to understand software products and explain them in a simple manner.
* Good listening, patience and problem solving skills.
* Prior experience in **customer support, telecalling, SaaS/ERP support or client servicing** will be preferred.
* Freshers with excellent communication skills and the right attitude may also be considered.

**Preferred Skills**

**Customer Support \| Calling \| Haryanvi \| ERP / SaaS \| Client Handling \| Problem Solving \| Follow ups \| Communication**

**What We’re Looking For**

Someone who can be the **first point of contact for Apptimate customers**, understand their problems, communicate clearly, and make sure every customer receives the right assistance at the right time.

**If you enjoy talking to people, solving problems and learning software products, we’d love to hear from you.**

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Language:

* Haryanvi (Preferred)

Location:

* Noida, Uttar Pradesh (Required)

Good to Have

* Knowledge of software development services.
* Familiarity with CRM or lead\-management systems.
* Basic knowledge of digital marketing and social media.
* Experience in cold calling and customer acquisition.
* Interest in emerging technologies and software solutions.

Why Join Us?

You will get an opportunity to work closely with a **software development and technical team** and gain practical experience in:

You will learn how to understand real business requirements and connect them with appropriate **software development products and IT solutions**.

title: Business Development Associate (BDA)
description:
**About Airtribe**

Airtribe is an AI\-first upskilling platform for working professionals. From Product Management to Backend Engineering, our programs are designed around real\-world use cases, AI tools, and hands\-on learning.

We work with instructors from companies like Microsoft, Meta, Razorpay, Coinbase, Gojek, and Uber, and have helped 5,000\+ professionals accelerate their careers.

Backed by Better Capital, 640 Ventures, and Kunal Shah, we are building a fast\-growing learning platform focused on real outcomes.

**The Context**

At Airtribe, Business Development is not about pushing sales. It is about helping working professionals make the right career decisions.

As we scale, the volume of learners and conversations increases, but maintaining trust, clarity, and quality in each interaction becomes harder. This role exists to ensure that every learner interaction is thoughtful, consultative, and outcome\-driven, not transactional.

**The Role**

As a Business Development Associate, you will work closely with learners to understand their goals and guide them toward the right programs. You will own the journey from the first conversation to final enrollment, ensuring clarity, trust, and a strong learner experience throughout.

This is a role built for people who are early in their careers and hungry to grow fast. We will give you the training, the environment, and the support. What we are looking for is the drive to make it count.

**What You'll Own**

* End\-to\-end learner conversations from first touchpoint to enrollment
* Understanding learner goals and guiding them with clarity and empathy
* Follow\-ups, objection handling, and decision support
* Maintaining quality and consistency across all interactions
* Accurate documentation of conversations, follow\-ups, and outcomes
* Building relationships through calls, events, and networking opportunities

**What Problems You'll Solve**

* Helping learners make informed decisions instead of rushed choices
* Reducing drop\-offs caused by confusion or lack of clarity
* Building trust in a high\-volume, fast\-moving sales environment
* Ensuring conversations are consultative, not script\-driven

**How This Role Evolves**

In the initial phase, your focus will be on understanding the product, learner personas, and running effective conversations.

Over time, you will be expected to improve conversion quality, handle more complex conversations, and contribute to refining sales processes.

Based on performance, this role can evolve into owning larger pipelines, mentoring junior team members, or moving into high\-impact sales or growth roles.

**What We're Looking For**

* Fresh graduates, freshers with internship experience, or candidates with up to 10 months of experience
* Strong communication skills, both verbal and written
* Ability to build trust quickly and handle conversations with clarity
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced, target\-driven environment
* Ownership mindset, proactive and accountable
* A genuine interest in sales and helping people make the right decisions

*Nice to have:*

* Prior internship or experience in sales, inside sales, or customer\-facing roles
* Exposure to edtech or consultative sales environments

**Compensation and Growth**

* During the 3\-month probation period, the salary will be Rs. 17,000 to 20,000 per month, plus incentives
* On successful confirmation, your fixed pay increases by 90% to 150%, along with incentives
* This is a performance\-driven role, and your growth here is directly tied to the impact you create

**What This Role Is Not** This is not a script\-driven or transactional sales role.

We are not looking for someone who pushes for closures. We are looking for someone who understands learners, builds trust, and helps them make the right decisions.

**Why Join Airtribe**

* High\-impact role with direct business visibility from day one
* A clear and fast growth path in a performance\-driven environment
* Significant salary growth on confirmation
* Collaborative and ambitious team culture
* Comprehensive medical insurance

At Airtribe, Business Development is about building trust and driving meaningful outcomes, not just closing deals.

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Junior Accountant
description:
**Job Location \& Days**

* Ghatkopar East, Mumbai.
* Working days: Monday to Saturday.

**Work Experience**

* Fresher to 2 years of experience in accounting, taxation, or a related finance support role. Freshers with strong fundamentals and a willingness to learn are welcome to apply.
* Prior exposure to Tally and basic GST/TDS filing (even through internship or articleship) is a plus, but not mandatory.

**Educational Qualification**

* Graduate or postgraduate in Commerce (B. Com/M. Com) or a related field (e.g., BAF, BBI). Candidates who have pursued or attempted CA/CS/CMA are also welcome.

**Skill Set Required**

* **Working knowledge of Tally, or a strong willingness to learn it quickly.**
* Comfortable with MS Office, especially Excel (basic formulas, VLOOKUP, reconciliation sheets).
* Good communication skills — able to explain figures clearly to seniors, clients, and vendors, not just enter data.
* Basic understanding of accounting principles (journal entries, ledgers, trial balance) and awareness of GST/TDS/Income Tax compliance requirements.
* Detail\-oriented and comfortable with deadline\-driven work — statutory filing dates are non\-negotiable.

**Job Description / Key Responsibilities**

* Manage day\-to\-day financial records and bookkeeping.
* Prepare and assist with tax filings (GST, TDS, Income Tax) and ensure compliance with applicable regulations.
* Analyse financial data to support management decision\-making.
* Provide input on tax planning and savings opportunities.

**Salary**

* Rs 10,000 – 25,000 per month, based on experience and qualification.

**Other Requirements**

* High integrity and honesty — non\-negotiable for a role handling financial data (verified through structured reference checks; see Interview Methodology).
* Track record of reliability. For freshers, this can be assessed through academic consistency and internship feedback rather than job history.
* Comfortable working within a defined compliance calendar (monthly/quarterly/annual filing deadlines).

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Associate Systems Support Engineer
description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Associate Systems Support Engineer based in India.**
 This role offers the opportunity to support critical application and database environments in a customer\-focused, technically demanding setting. You will help monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize application performance across development and QA environments. The position combines hands\-on systems support with application performance management and incident resolution. You will work closely with clients and internal technical teams to investigate complex issues and drive them through to resolution. The role also involves creating operational documentation, improving monitoring practices, and identifying recurring issues for proactive resolution. You will collaborate across international teams and operate in a 24/7 environment with rotational shifts. It is an excellent opportunity to deepen your expertise across Windows infrastructure, SQL, application monitoring, and cloud technologies.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Provide responsive technical support to clients, track ongoing issues, communicate progress, and drive problems through to resolution.
* Act as a key point of contact for application and database performance issues, maintaining a strong focus on customer experience.
* Monitor and evaluate application performance using tools such as AppDynamics, Dynatrace, New Relic, or similar application performance management platforms.
* Analyze complex application, infrastructure, and database performance problems, identify root causes, and coordinate remediation.
* Track identified defects, fixes, and technical issues across the client environment and ensure timely resolution.
* Convert known or recurring issues into proactive alerts and establish appropriate operational workflows with support teams.
* Monitor key server and application performance indicators, including CPU, memory, queues, I/O, page writes, and related metrics.
* Support Windows\-based application environments, including IIS, worker processes, configuration, certificates, event logs, clustering, and related infrastructure components.
* Perform SQL analysis and troubleshooting, including queries, SQL jobs, blocking, and Always On environments.
* Prepare and maintain technical and operational documentation, procedures, and support materials.
* Deliver weekly and monthly client updates and participate in regular technical and leadership calls.
* Work effectively within a 24/7 operational environment, including rotational shifts, while maintaining timely incident analysis and resolution.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* At least 1 year of professional experience in application support, systems monitoring, or a related technical support environment.
* Hands\-on experience with application or infrastructure monitoring and performance management tools such as AppDynamics, Dynatrace, New Relic, or equivalent platforms.
* Working knowledge of Windows Server infrastructure and .NET\-based application support, including IIS, worker processes, Web.config, certificate bindings, and Windows Event Logs.
* Understanding of server performance metrics and troubleshooting tools, including CPU, memory, queue length, MSMQ, I/O, page writes, and Perfmon.
* Familiarity with Windows clustering, COM\+, Log Parser, basic networking concepts, and Azure monitoring.
* Intermediate to advanced SQL skills, including SQL queries, SQL Jobs, blocking analysis, and Always On.
* Experience with IT service management platforms such as ServiceNow or Service Desk tools.
* Basic knowledge of ITIL principles; an ITIL Foundation certification is an advantage.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, with the persistence to investigate complex technical issues and drive them to resolution.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, particularly for working with international clients and teams.
* Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with a customer\-first mindset and the ability to communicate technical information clearly.
* Relevant IT certifications are considered an advantage.


**Benefits**
* Fully remote opportunity based in India.
* Full\-time position within an international, collaborative technical environment.
* Opportunity to work with enterprise application, infrastructure, database, and monitoring technologies.
* Exposure to international clients and cross\-functional technical teams.
* Opportunities to develop expertise in application performance management, SQL, Windows infrastructure, Azure monitoring, and IT service management.
* Learning and professional development opportunities.
* Comprehensive employee benefits package.
* Supportive and collaborative workplace culture.
* Environment that encourages employees to make an impact, learn, and grow professionally.
* Customer\-focused organization with a strong emphasis on service quality and technical excellence.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description:
Job Description — Mechanical Design Engineer

About Motorall

Motorall is developing next\-generation autonomous mobility and material\-handling systems for warehouses, ports, mining and industrial logistics.

Our product portfolio includes **Cyborg autonomous mobile robots for 200–1,000 kg payloads**, as well as **T\-REX heavy\-duty autonomous vehicles designed for 20–50 tonne cargo movement** across ports, mines and industrial environments.  
Motorall is building integrated robotic platforms combining **mechanical systems, electric powertrains, drive\-by\-wire, sensors, autonomy, fleet management and industrial vehicle architecture**.

We are looking for a highly capable **Mechanical Design Engineer** who can take ownership of the mechanical architecture of our robots and electric vehicles—from concept and CAD through prototyping, testing and deployment.

Role Overview

This is a **hands\-on product\-development role**, not a conventional CAD\-design position.

The selected engineer will work on the design and development of:

* Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs)
* Heavy\-duty autonomous ground vehicles
* Electric/hybrid powertrain systems
* Chassis and structural systems
* Drive systems and wheel\-end assemblies
* Battery\-pack integration
* Steering, suspension and braking systems
* Robotic mechanisms and payload interfaces
* Modular robot platforms
* Trailer/cargo coupling mechanisms
* Mechanical systems for industrial and port environments

The engineer will work closely with electrical, electronics, controls, autonomy and manufacturing teams to develop complete working robotic vehicles.

Key Responsibilities1\. Robot Mechanical Design

* Design complete mechanical architectures for autonomous mobile robots.
* Develop chassis, frame, body, payload decks and structural members.
* Design mounting systems for LiDAR, cameras, radar, batteries, motors, controllers and other sensors/electronics.
* Design mechanical interfaces for conveyor, flatbed, lift and robotic\-arm top modules.
* Develop modular robot architectures that can be adapted for different payloads and applications.
* Design mechanisms for loading, unloading, docking and material handling.
* Design mechanical safety systems, guards, bumpers and protective structures.
* Develop mechanisms for autonomous docking and vehicle positioning.

Motorall's Cyborg platform is designed for 200–1,000 kg payloads and supports modular top modules including conveyors, flatbeds, lifts and robotic\-arm integration.

2\. Heavy Electric Vehicle Design

* Develop mechanical architecture for large electric autonomous vehicles.
* Design heavy\-duty chassis and structural systems for high\-payload applications.
* Develop drivetrain layouts for electric/hybrid vehicles.
* Work on motor, gearbox, differential, axle and wheel\-end integration.
* Design mounting systems for traction motors and power electronics.
* Perform mechanical integration of battery packs and high\-voltage components.
* Design systems for serviceability, maintenance and component replacement.
* Support development of vehicles intended for continuous 24/7 industrial operation.

The T\-REX platform is intended for 20–50 tonne cargo handling and uses an electric/hybrid powertrain architecture for port, mining, construction and heavy\-industrial applications.

3\. EV Powertrain Development

The candidate should be capable of working on the complete mechanical side of an EV powertrain.

Responsibilities may include:

* Traction motor integration
* Gearbox/reduction\-stage integration
* Differential and axle integration
* Driveshaft and coupling design
* Wheel\-end design
* Torque and load calculations
* Gear ratio selection and mechanical validation
* Bearing and shaft selection
* Powertrain mounting
* Structural analysis of drivetrain components
* Thermal\-management packaging
* Battery\-to\-powertrain mechanical integration
* Mechanical protection of high\-voltage systems

Experience with **BLDC, PMSM, induction or other electric traction motors** will be advantageous.

4\. CAD \& Product Design

The engineer will be expected to independently create and manage production\-ready CAD.

Responsibilities include:

* 3D part modelling
* Assembly modelling
* Detailed engineering drawings
* GD\&T
* Tolerance stack\-up
* Design for Manufacturing (DFM)
* Design for Assembly (DFA)
* Sheet\-metal design
* Welded\-frame design
* Machined\-component design
* Fabrication drawings
* BOM generation
* Engineering change management

5\. Autonomous Robot Integration

The mechanical engineer will work alongside the autonomy and electronics teams to ensure that mechanical architecture supports autonomous operation.

This includes:

* Sensor mounting and protection
* LiDAR/camera/radar mounting
* Sensor field\-of\-view considerations
* Drive\-by\-wire mechanical interfaces
* Steering actuator integration
* Brake actuator integration
* Motor/controller packaging
* Battery and electronics enclosure design
* Cable\-routing provisions
* Service access
* Emergency\-stop and safety\-system integration

Experience

**2–6 years of relevant professional/project experience.**

Freshers should generally not be considered unless they have exceptionally strong hands\-on experience through major robotics/EV projects, Formula Student, Baja, autonomous vehicle projects, research projects or demonstrated product development.

The ideal candidate will have previously worked on at least one of:

* AMR/AGV/UGV
* Electric vehicle
* Autonomous vehicle
* Heavy machinery
* Automotive powertrain
* Robotics platform
* Industrial machine
* Mobile robotics

The ideal candidate should:

* Think from first principles.
* Understand how a machine actually moves and carries load.
* Be comfortable with both equations and CAD.
* Be able to take a concept from a blank screen to a physical prototype.
* Understand the difference between a laboratory prototype and a deployable industrial machine.
* Be comfortable working with manufacturing teams.
* Be willing to physically inspect and troubleshoot machines.
* Have strong ownership and execution ability.
* Be capable of independently driving a mechanical subsystem from concept to validation.

Advantageous Additional Skills

Candidates with experience in any of the following will receive preference:

* Formula Student
* SAE Baja
* Autonomous vehicle competitions
* IIT robotics projects
* Electric vehicle projects
* Heavy\-duty vehicle design
* Mobile robot development
* ROS\-based robot hardware integration
* Robotic arm integration
* CNC machining
* Welding/fabrication
* FEA
* Vehicle testing
* Design optimization
* Rapid prototyping
* 3D printing
* Embedded hardware packaging

**Portfolio\-based evaluation will be an important part of the selection process.**

Pay: ₹60,000\.00 \- ₹80,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

description:

**Location:** Kankarbagh, Patna, Bihar  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 0–2 Years

**Job Summary:**

We are looking for a motivated and customer\-focused **Customer Success Manager (CSM)** to build strong relationships with clients, ensure successful onboarding, improve customer satisfaction, and support long\-term customer retention. The candidate should have excellent communication, problem\-solving, client\-handling, and relationship\-management skills.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage and maintain strong relationships with existing customers.

* Excellent **verbal and written communication skills**.
* Strong problem\-solving and interpersonal skills.
* Good understanding of **customer relationship management and customer experience**.
* Ability to handle customer queries professionally and patiently.
* Strong follow\-up and relationship\-building skills.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple internal teams.
* Customer\-focused, proactive, organized, and responsible personality.
* Basic knowledge of **CRM, MS Office, and Google Workspace**.

**Preferred Skills:**

**Customer Success \| Customer Relationship Management \| Client Handling \| Customer Onboarding \| Customer Retention \| Customer Support \| Communication Skills \| Problem Solving \| CRM \| Follow\-up \| Customer Experience \| Account Management \| Upselling \| Cross\-selling \| Relationship Management**

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Customer satisfaction
* Customer retention rate
* Successful onboarding
* Customer response and resolution time
* Number of customer follow\-ups
* Customer engagement
* Upselling/cross\-selling opportunities
* Customer feedback and issue resolution

**What We Offer**

* Professional and supportive work environment
* Learning and growth opportunities
* Exposure to real\-world **customer success and client relationship management**
* Opportunity to work directly with customers
* Career development opportunities
* Practical experience in customer onboarding, retention, and account management

Pay: ₹18,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

title: CRM Executive
description:
We are looking for a confident, responsible and organised CRM, Order Processing \& Process Coordination Executive. The candidate will communicate with clients, confirm orders, manage the CRM and coordinate the complete internal process—from customer enquiry and order confirmation to dispatch and successful delivery.

Key Responsibilities:

Customer \& CRM Management:

\* Communicate with clients through phone calls and WhatsApp

\* Understand customer requirements and provide accurate product information

\* Follow up with interested customers and convert enquiries into confirmed orders

\* Maintain professional relationships with new and existing customers

\* Record all customer conversations, follow\-ups and order updates in the CRM

\* Take complete responsibility for keeping the CRM accurate and up to date

Order Processing:

\* Confirm product, quantity, price, payment and delivery details with customers

\* Create and process confirmed orders in the company’s CRM or order\-management system

\* Maintain accurate customer and order details in CRM and Excel sheets

\* Share quotations, invoices, payment details and order confirmations with customers

\* Track orders from confirmation through production, billing, packing, dispatch and delivery

\* Follow up on pending payments, incomplete orders and delayed deliveries

Process Coordination:

\* Coordinate the complete workflow between sales, accounts, production, inventory, packing and dispatch teams

\* Ensure every department receives complete and accurate order information

\* Follow up with concerned team members to ensure tasks are completed on time

\* Maintain process trackers for confirmed, pending, under\-process, packed and dispatched orders

\* Monitor order timelines and ensure that committed delivery dates are followed

\* Identify process delays, missing information and operational issues

\* Escalate urgent orders, delays or unresolved issues to the concerned manager

\* Coordinate with courier and logistics partners when required

\* Ensure that the company’s order\-processing procedures and checklists are followed

\* Provide customers with regular order status and delivery updates

\* Coordinate customer complaints, returns, replacements and order corrections

\* Ensure proper communication and smooth handover between departments

\* Follow up until each assigned task or order is successfully completed

Reporting Responsibilities:

\* Prepare daily reports for enquiries, follow\-ups, confirmed orders and pending orders

\* Maintain reports for payments, production, packing, dispatch and delivery status

\* Share pending\-task and process\-delay reports with management

\* Update daily work status and highlight issues requiring immediate attention

Required Skills:

\* Good communication and customer\-handling skills

\* Confidence in speaking with clients over phone calls and WhatsApp

\* Strong follow\-up and process\-coordination skills

\* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel and CRM software

\* Ability to coordinate with multiple departments and team members

\* Ability to manage customer enquiries and close orders

\* Basic computer, email and internet knowledge

\* Good organisational, time\-management and problem\-solving skills

\* Attention to detail and accurate data entry

\* Ability to manage multiple customers, orders and tasks simultaneously

\* Responsible attitude and a strong sense of task ownership

Qualifications:

\* Minimum qualification: 12th Pass or Graduate

\* Freshers with strong communication and coordination skills may apply

\* Experience in CRM, telecalling, customer support, sales coordination, process coordination or order processing will be preferred

Who Should Apply?

Candidates who can communicate confidently with customers, follow up regularly, confirm orders and independently coordinate the complete order\-processing cycle. The candidate should be capable of working with different departments and taking responsibility for each order until its successful delivery.

**About the Role**

Chrisvin Geomet Services Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a **Geophysicist – Sales \& Business Development** who can combine technical knowledge in geophysics with strong communication and business development skills.

The candidate will be responsible for promoting the company's **geophysical \& Seismic products, and related technical services**, identifying potential clients, developing business opportunities, understanding client requirements and supporting the organization in expanding its customer base.

This role is ideal for a geophysicist who is interested in moving beyond technical operations and building a career in **technical sales, client relationship management and business development**.

**Key Responsibilities** 

**1\. Business Development \& Lead Generation**

* Identify and research potential clients in the **geophysical exploration, oil \& gas, energy, mining and related industries**.
* Develop new business opportunities through market research, networking, email outreach, LinkedIn and other professional channels.
* Build and maintain a database of prospective clients and business opportunities.
* Generate qualified leads and convert prospects into business opportunities.
* Track sales leads, follow\-ups, proposals and business development activities.

**2\. Technical Sales \& Service Promotion**

* Understand and promote the company's **products** **\& services**.
* Communicate technical service offerings to prospective clients in a clear and business\-oriented manner.
* Understand client technical requirements and coordinate with internal technical teams to propose suitable solutions.
* Prepare and deliver technical presentations, service overviews and business proposals.
* Support preparation of quotations, proposals and commercial documents.

**3\. Client Relationship Management**

* Establish and maintain professional relationships with existing and prospective clients.
* Conduct client meetings, presentations and discussions to understand business requirements.
* Act as a bridge between clients and the technical team.
* Follow up with clients regarding proposals, requirements and potential projects.
* Collect client feedback and communicate it internally for service improvement.

**4\. Market Research \& Business Promotion**

* Research industry trends, competitors, potential markets and emerging business opportunities.
* Identify organizations that may require seismic data processing and geophysical services.
* Support promotional activities through **LinkedIn, email campaigns, industry networks, conferences and professional associations**.
* Develop business promotion content in coordination with the management/marketing team.

**5\. Technical Understanding**

* Apply knowledge of **geophysics, seismic \& instrumentation** when communicating with clients.

**Company Description** 
  

 AIMIL PHARMACEUTICALS ( INDIA ) LTD is a fast\-growing Ayurvedic pharmaceutical company offering a wide range of generic and proprietary herbal products across India. The company promotes its products ethically through a large team of field officials serving leading institutions, trade channels, and hospitals nationwide. AIMIL is ISO 9001:2000 certified and has received multiple National Awards from the Government of India for research and development, product quality, and entrepreneurial excellence. Its manufacturing unit is approved and accredited by Health Canada, and the company collaborates with the Defence Research \& Development Organization (DRDO) to manufacture research\-based products, reflecting strong technological and innovation capabilities.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Product Manager will oversee the end\-to\-end lifecycle of Ayurvedic and herbal product lines, from market analysis and concept development to launch and post\-launch performance. This full\-time, on\-site role based in New Delhi involves defining product strategies, coordinating with R\&D, manufacturing, sales, and marketing teams, and ensuring products align with regulatory and quality standards. The Product Manager will analyze market trends, competitor activity, and customer feedback to identify opportunities, refine positioning, and support ethical promotion across institutions, hospitals, and trade channels. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include preparing product briefs, training field teams on product knowledge, supporting marketing campaigns and medical communication, monitoring sales performance, and recommending improvements to enhance product reach and profitability.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong product management skills, including product lifecycle management, market analysis, and strategic planning.
* Ability to collaborate with cross\-functional teams such as R\&D, manufacturing, sales, and marketing.
* Sound understanding of pharmaceuticals or Ayurvedic/Herbal products, including regulatory and quality considerations.
* Proficiency in data analysis, sales performance tracking, and use of productivity tools (e.g., MS Excel, PowerPoint).

title: D2C Growth Generalist
description:
We’re hiring:
 **D2C Growth Generalist – Product Launches** 




**I’m looking for generalist killers.** 




**People who learn ridiculously fast, figure things out themselves, and want an insane amount of responsibility early in their careers.** 




**You do NOT need D2C experience. We’ll train you.** 




**What I care about is whether you can think, execute, learn and take ownership.** 




  




 The job
 
 You’ll eventually own products from
 **idea → launch → scale.** 




**That means learning how to:** 




**• Research products and markets** 




**• Analyse competitors and customer psychology** 




**• Figure out positioning, angles and offers** 




**• Build and optimise product pages** 




**• Write copy that sells** 




**• Work with creative strategists and editors to produce ads** 




**• Understand Meta Ads and performance data** 




**• Launch products and analyse what happens** 




**• Identify what’s broken and fix it** 




**• Double down when something starts working** 




**• Use AI heavily to research, create and execute faster** 




**Basically:** 




**Find opportunity → Build → Launch → Learn → Fix → Scale → Repeat.** 




  




 You are probably a fit if:
 
 • You’re extremely resourceful
 



 • You learn new things unusually fast
 



 • You have high agency — if you don’t know something, you figure it out
 



 • You’re analytical AND creative
 



 • You’re very comfortable with technology and AI
 



 • You can operate without someone giving you instructions every 30 minutes
 



 • You obsess over getting the outcome, not just completing the task
 



 • You enjoy moving fast and having multiple things happening at once
 



 • You want responsibility, not a comfortable job description
 



 I don't care if your degree perfectly matches the role.
 



 I don't care if you've never launched a D2C product before.
 



**I can teach you D2C.** 




**It’s much harder to teach someone to be curious, hungry, resourceful and relentless.** 




  




 What this role becomes
 
 Initially, you'll work closely with us and learn our entire product\-launching system.
 



 As you get good, you'll start owning your own launches and eventually operate inside your own pod with
 **Creative Strategists \+ AI Editors** 
 supporting you.
 



 Your job becomes simple:
 



**Make products win.** 




**And you'll have the resources and autonomy to figure out how.** 




**This is a role for someone who wants to compress 5 years of learning into 1\.** 




**If you're looking for a narrowly defined job where you do the same thing every day, this probably isn't it.** 




**If you're the person who somehow ends up figuring shit out when nobody else knows how — I want to meet you.** 




**📍 Powai, Mumbai — Work from office** 




**💼 Full\-time** 



* **💰 25k/m \+ meaningful performance incentives**

**About Sudev Wood Tech**

Sudev Wood Tech is engaged in the manufacturing and execution of **modular furniture, customized furniture, interior solutions, doors, woodwork, and related interior fit\-out services**. We are looking for a motivated and result\-oriented **Field Sales Executive** who can contribute to business growth by identifying new customers, generating leads, developing client relationships, and converting opportunities into sales.

**Job Summary**

The Field Sales Executive will be responsible for **generating new business, meeting potential customers, visiting project sites, developing client relationships, understanding customer requirements, presenting the company's products and services, and achieving assigned sales targets**.

The candidate should be comfortable with extensive field visits and should have good communication, negotiation, follow\-up, and relationship\-management skills.

The role is suitable for an individual who is **self\-motivated, confident, target\-oriented, and willing to work actively in the field to generate business opportunities**.

Key Responsibilities  
**1\. Lead Generation \& New Business Development**

* Identify and generate new sales leads through field visits, references, networking, market research, and other relevant sources.
* Identify potential customers, builders, contractors, architects, interior designers, dealers, and businesses that may require the company's products and services.
* Explore new markets and customer segments to increase business opportunities.
* Develop and maintain a strong sales pipeline.

**2\. Field Sales \& Client Visits**

* Conduct regular field visits to meet prospective and existing customers.
* Visit residential and commercial project sites to understand requirements and identify business opportunities.
* Meet clients, contractors, architects, interior designers, builders, and other relevant decision\-makers.
* Explain and present Sudev Wood Tech's products, services, and customized solutions to potential customers.
* Maintain regular communication with clients throughout the sales process.

**3\. Customer Requirement Understanding**

* Understand the customer's requirements, budget, project scope, timelines, and expectations.
* Coordinate with the internal design, production, estimation, and execution teams wherever required.
* Ensure that customer requirements are communicated accurately to the concerned internal departments.
* Provide appropriate product/service recommendations based on customer needs.

**4\. Sales \& Target Achievement**

* Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets assigned by the management.
* Convert qualified leads into successful sales.
* Follow up consistently with prospective customers until closure.
* Maintain a healthy sales pipeline and work towards improving conversion rates.
* Identify opportunities for repeat business and referrals.

**5\. Client Relationship Management**

* Build and maintain professional relationships with existing and potential customers.
* Regularly follow up with clients regarding quotations, proposals, requirements, and project status.
* Resolve basic customer queries and coordinate with the concerned department for technical or operational issues.
* Maintain long\-term relationships to encourage repeat business and referrals.
