* Coordinate with the concerned teams for preparation of quotations and proposals.
* Share quotations and required information with customers in a timely manner.
* Explain quotation details, product specifications, pricing, and scope of work to customers.
* Negotiate with customers within the limits and guidelines approved by management.
* Coordinate with the internal team after order confirmation to ensure smooth execution and customer communication.

**7\. Market Research \& Competitor Analysis**

* Monitor market trends, customer requirements, pricing, and competitor activities.
* Collect information regarding competitors' products, pricing, services, and market presence.
* Identify new business opportunities and provide relevant market feedback to management.
* Develop knowledge of the local market and potential customer segments.

**8\. Sales Reporting \& Documentation**

* Maintain proper records of leads, customer visits, follow\-ups, quotations, and sales conversions.
* Submit regular sales and field\-visit reports to the reporting manager.
* Update the status of leads and opportunities regularly.
* Maintain accurate customer information and sales\-related records.
* Ensure timely follow\-up on all active leads.

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong convincing and negotiation abilities.
* Good customer\-handling skills.
* Strong follow\-up and relationship\-building skills.
* Target\-oriented and result\-driven approach.
* Ability to generate leads independently.
* Good presentation and pitching skills.
* Ability to understand customer requirements.
* Basic knowledge of sales processes and business development.
* Good knowledge of the local market is an advantage.
* Basic computer knowledge, including **MS Excel, MS Word**.
* Ability to maintain sales reports and customer records.
* Willingness to travel extensively for field visits.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.

title: Product Designer II
description:
**About AiPrise**
 AiPrise is a YC\-backed, Series A company building the global compliance infrastructure for financial services. We help banks, fintechs, cross\-border payment providers, stablecoin and crypto companies, and marketplaces gain a 360° view of every business they onboard, anywhere in the world.
   

  

 Through a single integration, we connect 800\+ data sources and 80\+ verification partners across 200\+ countries, powering KYB, KYC, AML, sanctions screening, and ongoing monitoring for companies like Meta, Airwallex, Fireblocks, and Bridge.
   

  

 Our AI Agents help compliance teams do more with less, resolving more cases, catching more fraud, and scaling operations without scaling headcount.
   

  

 We're \~60 people, Series A funded, and obsessed with a single problem: making compliance feel simple for the teams who live in it every day.
   

  

 Borders shouldn't be blockers. Compliance is hard. AiPrise shouldn't be.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 As a Product Designer II at AiPrise, you'll own design for a defined feature area of our compliance platform end to end, turning complicated processes, data, and decisions into clear, intuitive experiences.
   

  

 Our platform serves compliance analysts reviewing flagged cases, compliance managers configuring the rules that decide what gets flagged, business customers completing verification for the first time, and our own Forward\-Deployed Engineering team standing up and supporting customer workflows. Depending on where you're working, you'll design for several of them.
   

  

 You'll work with product and engineering to take defined problems from discovery through launch. The problem and its owner will be clear; how it gets solved is where you come in. We move fast and share work early, so expect feedback from customers and teammates to shape your designs while they're still taking form.
   

  

 You'll partner closely with product and engineering, with enough proximity to leadership to see why decisions get made and how your work lands with customers. Our priorities and processes will keep evolving as we grow, so you'll prioritize your own work with limited oversight and change course when new information arrives.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 Design Judgment
   

  

* Make design decisions independently within your feature area, applying and extending our design system where it needs to stretch.
* Weigh user needs, design quality, delivery speed, business priorities, and technical constraints, and catch usability problems before they reach engineering.
* Build working domain expertise in the compliance and verification workflows your feature area touches, deep enough to connect your day\-to\-day design work to roadmap goals and explain how it ladders up to quarterly objectives.


 Execution
   

  

* Own medium\-complexity projects end to end, from discovery and exploration through final design, implementation, and launch, with minimal oversight.
* Create clear user flows, prototypes, final designs, and documentation, anticipating edge cases and the non\-happy paths that make compliance software either trustworthy or infuriating.


 Customer \& Data Insights
   

  

* Combine customer conversations, usability testing, and product analytics to validate design decisions and identify problems worth solving, rather than only responding to the feedback in front of you.
* Work with internal teams who sit closest to customers to pressure\-test what you're seeing in the data.


 Communication \& Influence
   

  

* Partner closely with product and engineering to clarify the problem, requirements, constraints, and measures of success.
* Explain your design rationale clearly, contribute confidently in product and planning discussions, and keep stakeholders current on progress, risks, and open questions.
* Help newer designers get better, through design reviews, feedback, and pairing on tricky problems.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

* 3\+ years as a product designer, with a track record of shipping features and workflows to customers.
* Experience designing complex B2B, enterprise, fintech, compliance, identity, fraud, risk, or other data\-heavy products, where the hard part was the information and not the interface.
* A portfolio that shows how you frame problems, use research and data, explore solutions, and make design decisions, not just the final screens.
* Fluency in interaction design, information architecture, visual design, and prototyping, with the attention to edge cases and implementation quality that complex products demand.
* Clear written and verbal communication, and a collaborative approach to working with product managers and engineers.

 MBA students, recent graduates, and early\-career professionals who are serious about building a career in Human Resources and want hands\-on experience in a fast\-paced company.

 Interested candidates can send their resumes to hello@vistomadigital.com or apply directly through LinkedIn.

 HR Manager

 Registrar / Senior Management
 



**Job Summary:** 




 MNR University is looking for an experienced and dynamic
 **HR Manager** 
 to manage and strengthen the university's human resources function. The role will be responsible for recruitment and onboarding of faculty and non\-teaching staff, employee relations, HR policies, performance management, payroll coordination, statutory compliance, and employee engagement.
 



**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for
 **faculty, administrative, technical, and support staff** 
 .
* Coordinate faculty recruitment processes, including screening, interviews, documentation, and joining formalities.
* Develop manpower plans in coordination with academic and administrative departments.
* Manage employee onboarding, induction, probation, confirmation, transfers, promotions, and exits.
* Maintain accurate and confidential employee records and HR databases.
* Manage attendance, leave, employee documentation, and HRMS processes.
* Coordinate payroll, salary revisions, deductions, and employee compensation\-related matters.
* Ensure compliance with applicable

 .
* Develop and implement HR policies, SOPs, and employee\-related procedures.
* Handle employee grievances, disciplinary matters, and workplace conflicts.
* Coordinate performance appraisal and performance management processes.
* Identify training and development requirements for faculty and staff.
* Organize employee engagement, welfare, and team\-building initiatives.
* Prepare HR MIS, manpower reports, attrition reports, recruitment status, and other reports for management.

 on HR matters.

* MBA/PGDM in
 **Human Resources** 
 preferred.

* Additional certification in HR, labour laws, payroll, or HR analytics will be an advantage.

* **8–10 years of HR experience** 
 , preferably in a university, college, educational institution, or large organization.

 **faculty recruitment and academic\-institution HR processes** 
 will be highly preferred.

**Required Skills:** 



* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong leadership and people\-management abilities.
* Good knowledge of HR practices and applicable labour regulations.
* Strong recruitment and negotiation skills.
* Excellent documentation and reporting abilities.

* Strong problem\-solving and conflict\-resolution skills.



**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):** 



* Timely closure of faculty and staff vacancies.
* Employee retention and attrition management.

 A proactive HR professional with strong

title: Head of Human Resources
description:
**About Patra**




  





 Patra is an outcome\-focused operating partner working exclusively for the insurance industry. Combining expert global teams, process intelligence, and purpose\-built technology, Patra delivers measurable results to clients. With 20 years of deep domain expertise, exceptional client retention rates, and significant sustained investment in AI, Patra partners with agencies, brokers, MGAs, MGUs, and carriers to transform how insurance operations are delivered.
 



  





**Position Summary**




 Patra is seeking a seasoned HR leader to serve as Head of HR for our operations in India. As the senior HRBP leader in the country, the Head of HR is the primary point of HR partnership for India\-based senior leaders, requiring a strong blend of business partnering skill and operational excellence, with a deep understanding of talent dynamics in a global delivery environment.
 



 This role leads the India HR Business Partner team, shares accountability of recruiting and total rewards outcomes in India with the US leaders of those functions, and ensures that the global HR strategy is executed with local rigor, compliance, and cultural fluency. The Head of HR will play a critical role in building a high\-performing HR team, strengthening operational leadership capabilities, and embedding a strong values\-driven culture aligned with global standards.
 



 Operating as a true business partner to India site and operations leadership, the Head of HR maintains tight alignment with the North America based global HR leader – to whom the role reports directly – while adapting global programs to the realities of the Indian market and regulatory environment. The role requires the ability to lead through influence in a global matrix, balancing country\-level HRBP ownership with joint accountability across functions.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Strategic HR Leadership** 



* Align HR strategies and plans with the business strategy, executing an India HR plan tied to global business and delivery objectives
* Execute the strategic direction set by global HR, including implementation of value\-added HR initiatives and programs that support business priorities
* Foster a high\-performance, client\-centric, and collaborative culture across the India organization
* Leverage HR policies, programs, and practices to create and maintain a positive, high\-performing workplace
* Leverage HR analytics to improve retention, utilization, and productivity; support, track, and report HR metrics as a means of measuring the effectiveness of our people practices
* Champion collaboration across the India HR team, and Patra Operations, Technology, and Compliance teams
* Proactively communicate with management in India to ensure appropriate collaboration on employee activities and processes
* Have a curiosity to dig into small issues before they become a problem



**HR Business Partnership and Leadership Advisory** 



* Provide leadership, advice, and counsel to senior leaders in India on human resources issues, serving as the primary HR point of contact for the country's leadership population
* Lead the regional HRBP organization and its key initiatives, ensuring consistent quality of partnership across sites and functions
* Act as leader of a high\-performing, collaborative HR team that mutually supports overall internal customer groups and each other
* Advise leaders on organizational design, workforce planning, leadership effectiveness, and change management tied to transformation initiatives
* Translate global HR strategy, policy, and programs into India execution, identifying local legal or cultural adaptations where required



**Employee Relations, Compliance, and Operations** 



* Advise senior management on the appropriate resolution of escalated employee relations issues; own employee relations for India, including investigations, disciplinary matters, POSH compliance, and grievance handling
* Educate supervisors and managers and monitor management actions and decisions to maintain legal and company policy compliance and values
* Partner with the Patra compliance function to ensure compliance with Indian labor laws and other statutory requirements, including PF, ESI, gratuity, shops and establishments, and contract labor regulations, with alignment to global HR governance
* Partner with HR Operations on HRIS adoption and data integrity for the India employee population



**Talent, Engagement, and Culture** 



* Identify and develop leadership talent for pipeline and succession planning, including building leadership pipelines for delivery heads
* Manage projects, programs, and practices that engage, inspire, and recognize workforce performance
* Drive engagement initiatives tailored to distributed Operations teams
* Partner with all HR functions, including Talent Acquisition, Learning and Development, Compensation, Benefits, and HR Operations, to deliver quality service



**Talent Acquisition (joint with NA TA leadership)** 



* Co\-accountability for India hiring outcomes, including volume, quality, time\-to\-fill, and cost\-per\-hire against operational demand
* Partner with the NA Talent Acquisition leader on recruiting strategy, employer brand in the India market, sourcing channels, and vendor management
* Ensure hiring plans remain synchronized with capacity planning and client ramp requirements



**Total Rewards (joint with NA Total Rewards leadership)** 



* Work with management and Total Rewards colleagues to ensure compensation and benefits are competitive and equitable, co\-owning India compensation and benefits strategy with attention to market competitiveness, internal equity, and cost discipline
* Provide India market intelligence on pay benchmarks, statutory benefits, and emerging practices to inform global rewards decisions
* Oversee execution of merit, promotion, and incentive cycles for the India population in line with the global calendar



**Global Stakeholder Management** 



* Act as the India voice in global HR forums and initiatives
* Bring global best practices into local execution
* Maintain tight operating rhythms with NA\-based HR leadership, with decision rights clearly documented across jointly owned functions



**Qualifications** 



* 10\+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 8 years leading an HRBP team in India, ideally within BPO, ITES, technology services, or global shared services
* Demonstrated success operating in a global matrix, reporting into NA or other international HR leadership
* Deep expertise in Indian labor law, statutory compliance, and POSH
* Strong working knowledge of talent acquisition and compensation in the India market, including high\-volume hiring environments
* Experience with HR analytics and metrics\-driven decision making
* Experience supporting 24x7 or multi\-shift operations preferred
* Executive presence and the ability to influence senior operations leaders without direct authority
* Comfort with HR technology; Darwinbox experience a plus
* MBA or postgraduate degree in Human Resources preferred



  





 Patra Corporation is an equal opportunity employer committed to celebrating diversity and creating a safe and inclusive environment for all employees.

title: HR Operations & Client Delivery Lead
description:
**📍 Location** 
 Mohali, Punjab — On\-Site
   

  

**🕐 Shift** 
 Night Shift
   

  

**🏢 Department** 
 Human Resources \& People Operations
   

  

**📊 Reports To** 
 HR Director / Head of HR
   

  

**💼 Employment Type** 
 Full\-Time, Permanent
   

  

**📅 Experience Required** 
 5\+ Years in HR Operations / HRBP roles
   

  

**🎓 Education** 
 MBA – HR / PGDM (HR) or equivalent postgraduate degree
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The HR Operations \& Client Delivery Lead is a senior, client\-facing HR professional who serves as the strategic people partner for business units and client accounts. This role is anchored in HR Business Partnering — driving workforce planning, employee lifecycle management, performance enablement, compliance, and talent development — while ensuring seamless delivery of HR services to internal stakeholders and external clients.
   

  

 Recruitment sits within the scope of this role as a supervised function; the incumbent will oversee and govern the recruitment process and team without being measured on it as a primary deliverable. Instead, the core KPIs are centered on HR operations excellence, employee experience, client satisfaction, and people metrics.
   

  

* HR Business Partnering (Primary)


 ▪ Act as a trusted strategic HR advisor to business unit heads and client account managers.
   

  

 ▪ Partner with leadership to understand business objectives and align people strategies accordingly.
   

  

 ▪ Drive org design, headcount planning, and workforce restructuring conversations.
   

  

 ▪ Lead employee relations — counsel managers on performance, conflict resolution, disciplinary actions, and grievances.
   

  

 ▪ Conduct skip\-level meetings, pulse checks, and engagement diagnostics; present actionable insights to leadership.
   

  

 ▪ Champion diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives across assigned business units.
   

  

 ▪ Support change management initiatives, including mergers, restructures, and new client ramp\-ups.
   

  

* HR Operations \& Service Delivery


 ▪ Own the end\-to\-end employee lifecycle for assigned accounts: onboarding → performance → retention → exit.
   

  

 ▪ Ensure accuracy, governance, and compliance of HR data in HRIS systems.
   

  

 ▪ Drive operational SLAs for HR services, including documentation, policy adherence, and query resolution.
   

  

 ▪ Manage and continuously improve HR SOPs, process maps, and governance frameworks.
   

  

 ▪ Coordinate with payroll, compliance, and finance teams for seamless HR\-ops delivery.
   

  

 ▪ Ensure 100% statutory and regulatory compliance (PF, ESI, gratuity, labor law, etc.) for assigned accounts.
   

  

 ▪ Oversee offboarding processes, including exit interviews, clearances, and knowledge transfer.
   

  

* Client Delivery \& Stakeholder Management


 ▪ Serve as the primary HR point of contact for allocated client accounts (internal or external).
   

  

 ▪ Conduct periodic business reviews with clients on HR health metrics, attrition, headcount, and compliance.
   

  

 ▪ Build strong client relationships and proactively anticipate HR needs aligned to client contracts.
   

  

 ▪ Ensure client\-specific HR deliverables are met within agreed timelines and quality standards.
   

  

 ▪ Collaborate with account management and delivery teams to support client escalations.
   

  

* Performance Management \& Talent Development


 ▪ Drive the performance appraisal cycle — calibration sessions, bell curve management, and PIP governance.
   

  

 ▪ Identify high\-potential employees and design individual development plans (IDPs).
   

  

 ▪ Partner with L\&D to ensure training needs are captured and fulfilled as per business requirements.
   

  

 Coach managers on effective feedback delivery and performance documentation
   

  

* Recruitment Oversight (Supervisory — Not Primary KPI)


**Recruitment Is a Governed, Supervised Function Within This Role**
 ▪ Oversee the recruitment team and ensure hiring plans are executed within approved TATs and budgets.
   

  

 ▪ Review and approve job descriptions, offer letters, and hiring decisions at designated bands.
   

  

 ▪ Monitor quality\-of\-hire metrics and recruiter performance dashboards.
   

  

 ▪ Intervene strategically in senior or critical role hiring as a business partner.
   

  

 ▪ Ensure recruitment practices comply with organizational policies and DEI commitments.
   

  

*Note: Day\-to\-day recruitment execution is handled by the Talent Acquisition team. This role governs the function, not drives it.*
***Core Competencies***
 ▪ HR Business Partnering \& Consulting
   

  

 ▪ Employee Relations \& Conflict Resolution
   

  

 ▪ HR Operations \& Service Delivery Management
   

  

 ▪ Stakeholder \& Client Relationship Management
   

  

 ▪ Data\-Driven Decision Making \& People Analytics
   

  

 ▪ Change Management \& Organizational Development
   

  

 ▪ Labor Law \& Statutory Compliance
   

  

**Technical Skills**
 ▪ Proficiency in HRIS platforms (Zoho People, Darwinbox, SAP SuccessFactors, or equivalent)
   

  

 ▪ Advanced Excel / Google Sheets for MIS and reporting
   

  

 ▪ Familiarity with ATS platforms for recruitment oversight
   

  

 ▪ Experience with engagement and performance tools
   

  

***Behavioral Attributes***
 ▪ Strong executive presence and influencing ability
   

  

 ▪ High emotional intelligence and empathy
   

  

 ▪ Proactive, solutions\-first mindset
   

  

 ▪ Comfortable operating in ambiguity and fast\-paced environments
   

  

*Collaborative yet assertive — able to hold ground with leadership*
**Experience \& Qualifications**
 ▪ 5\+ years of progressive HR experience, with a minimum of 3 years in an HRBP or HR Operations Lead capacity.
   

  

 ▪ Demonstrated experience in client\-facing HR service delivery roles (BPO, KPO, IT/ITeS, or staffing environments preferred).
   

  

 ▪ Experience managing or supervising recruitment teams is an asset.
   

  

 ▪ Proven track record of managing HR for 200\+ employee headcount.
   

  

 ▪ Strong knowledge of Indian labor laws and compliance frameworks.
   

  

 ▪ Swing shift compatibility is mandatory — must be comfortable working afternoon to late\-evening hours.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 ▪ Competitive salary benchmarked to industry standards
   

  

 ▪ Structured career progression into Senior HRBP / HR Manager / HR Head roles
   

  

 ▪ Direct visibility and access to senior leadership and client stakeholders
   

  

 ▪ Performance\-linked incentive tied to KPI achievement
   

  

 ▪ Learning \& development budget for certifications and HR tools training
   

  

 ▪ Collaborative, high\-performance HR team culture

 ARK Solutions, Inc. is a nationally recognized workforce solutions company supporting Fortune 500 companies, government agencies, and consulting organizations across IT, Professional Services, Healthcare, Legal, and Administrative staffing. With operations in the United States and India, ARK's success is built on strong relationships, disciplined processes, and a commitment to the people we employ and serve. We believe that an engaged, supported, and accountable workforce is essential to delivering exceptional results.
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 ARK Solutions is seeking a hands\-on and people\-focused Manager – HR Operations \& Employee Experience to oversee the complete employee lifecycle for ARK's India operations. This position will serve as the primary point of accountability for day\-to\-day HR operations in India, including onboarding, employee relations, attendance and leave management, payroll coordination, benefits administration, training coordination, performance management, compliance, employee engagement, and offboarding. The individual will work closely with India leadership, department managers, Talent Acquisition, Finance, and other internal teams to ensure employees receive timely support and that HR processes are followed consistently. The role will also participate in the India hiring process as a second\-level interviewer, helping ARK evaluate candidate suitability beyond technical qualifications. **Key Responsibilities** 




 Employee Onboarding and Integration
 



 Employee Relations and HR Support
 



 Attendance, Leave and Time Management
 



 Payroll, Compensation and Finance Coordination
 



 Benefits, Insurance and Retirement Programs
 



 Performance Management and Employee Development

 Talent Acquisition Partnership and Candidate Evaluation
 



 Employee Engagement and Workplace Culture

 HR Compliance, Records and Process Governance

* 8–12 years of progressive experience in HR operations, employee relations, or HR generalist roles in India.

title: Sr HRBP
description:
**About Lokal:**
 In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier\-2/3 towns weren't really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they'd come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.
   

  

 This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place \& one app \- local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight \- when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies \& marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
   

  

 Today, Lokal is a
 **house of focused apps,** 
 many products, one mission:
   

  

 to connect Tier\-2/3\+ India to the
 **Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts** 
 they've always deserved.
   

  

 We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:
   

  

* Emotional Well\-being \& Peer Support \- safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt \& Eaze)
* Astrology \& Guidance \- instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
* Edutainment \& Skill Learning \- practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
* Matrimonial Matchmaking \- hyperlocal, compatibility\-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
* Agri Consulting \- farmer\-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
* Local Jobs \- blue\- and grey\-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
* Social \& Community \- Place to find \& post social updates (Lokal app)
* Advisory Services \- early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more


 Under the hood, Lokal is a
 **discovery and access platform** 
 : local\-language internet \+ deep Bharat insight\+ AI. When someone opens a product we've built, they don't wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.
   

  

 This is the story new teammates walk into:
   

  

 a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre —
 **access changes lives** 
 .
   

  

**We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.**
 We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital
   

  

**Requirements**
 Qualifications and Skills:
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field
* 5\+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 3 years in a senior HRBP role
* Strong understanding of HR best practices, employment laws, and regulations
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships and influence stakeholders at all


 levels.
   

  

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Experience with HRIS systems and data analytics
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team


**Desired Skills:**
* Experience in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment
* Experience working in start\-ups

It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in\-vitro diagnostic products.

Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

**Key Qualifications and Skills** 
 :
   

  

**Essential:**



* Recent graduate in Business, Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Analytics, Life Sciences, Engineering, or from any engineering discipline.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to understand and document business processes and requirements.

**Nice to Have**

**What Success Looks Like:**

 BE Computer Science/MCA or any other Bachelor’s degree with the right experience

It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

title: Business Analyst - D2C
description:
**Job Title: Business Analyst – D2C**
**Experience: 2–5 Years**
**Function: D2C / Business \& Analytics**
**Role Overview**
 We are looking for a highly analytical and business\-oriented D2C Business Analyst who can convert data into actionable insights and directly contribute to revenue growth, profitability, and margin improvement.
   

  

 The role requires strong hands\-on expertise in SQL and Power BI, along with a solid understanding of D2C/e\-commerce business metrics. The candidate will work closely with D2C, Performance Marketing, Product, Finance, CRM, Operations, and Supply Chain teams to identify growth opportunities, cost leakages, and margin improvement areas.
   

  

 This is not purely a reporting role. The candidate will be expected to identify problems, recommend actions, and track the business impact of those actions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities1\. Business \& D2C Analytics**
* Own regular analysis of D2C business performance across revenue, orders, customers, products, channels, and profitability.
* Build a strong understanding of the complete D2C funnel: Traffic → PDP → Add to Cart → Checkout → Purchase → Delivery → Repeat Purchase.
* Identify trends, anomalies, business opportunities, and performance gaps.
* Conduct daily, weekly, monthly, and YTD performance analysis against targets.
* Build automated dashboards and reduce dependency on manual reporting.
* Margin \& Profitability Improvement


 A key objective of this role will be to identify and execute opportunities for contribution margin improvement.
   

  

* Build SKU, category, customer, channel, and campaign\-level profitability analysis.
* Identify margin leakages across:
+ Discounts and promotions
+ Performance marketing spend
+ Shipping and logistics costs
+ COD and payment gateway costs
+ RTO and cancellations
+ Returns and refunds
+ Marketplace/affiliate commissions
+ Cashback and loyalty costs

* Evaluate the incremental profitability of promotional campaigns and sale events.
* Recommend actions to improve Gross Margin, CM1, CM2 and overall D2C contribution margin.
* Identify high\-revenue but low/profit\-negative SKUs, campaigns, channels, and customer cohorts.
* Work with business teams to translate findings into measurable margin improvement initiatives.
* SQL \& Data Analysis
* Write advanced SQL queries for large datasets across orders, customers, products, marketing, CRM, and operational data.
* Perform data extraction, transformation, validation, and reconciliation.
* Build reusable SQL datasets and reporting layers.
* Conduct cohort, funnel, retention, SKU, channel, and customer segmentation analysis.
* Work with multiple data sources to create a single view of D2C business performance.


 Strong hands\-on SQL proficiency is mandatory for this role.
   

  

* Power BI \& Business Dashboards
* Build and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards for leadership and functional teams.
* Automate recurring MIS and business reports.
* Develop dashboards for:
+ Revenue \& GMV
+ D2C P\&L / Contribution Margin
+ Marketing \& ROAS
+ Customer Acquisition
+ Retention \& Cohorts
+ Product/SKU Performance
+ Inventory
+ COD/Prepaid Mix
+ RTO \& Returns
+ Funnel \& Conversion

* Build alerts and exception\-based reporting so teams can quickly identify business issues.
* Ensure data accuracy and consistency across dashboards.
* Customer \& Retention Analytics
* Analyze New vs Repeat customer behavior.
* Build customer cohorts and retention curves.
* Track Repeat Purchase Rate, Purchase Frequency, LTV, CAC and CAC:LTV.
* Identify high\-value and low\-value customer segments.
* Analyze CRM campaigns across WhatsApp, SMS, Email and Push Notifications.
* Recommend opportunities to increase retention and customer lifetime value.
* Marketing \& Growth Analytics
* Analyze channel\-level performance across Meta, Google, Affiliates and other acquisition channels.
* Evaluate CAC, ROAS, conversion rate and incremental revenue.
* Connect marketing performance with actual contribution margin, rather than evaluating channels only on ROAS.
* Identify opportunities to optimize marketing spend toward more profitable customer cohorts, products and channels.
* Business Planning \& Forecasting
* Support monthly and annual D2C planning.
* Build revenue, order, AOV, traffic and margin projections.
* Support inventory and demand forecasting using historical trends and annual business plan
* Perform scenario analysis for pricing, discounts, marketing spends and promotional events.
* Track Actual vs Target vs Forecast and highlight risks early.
* Cross\-Functional Business Partnership


**Work Closely With**
 D2C Team – Revenue, profitability and business planning
   

  

 Performance Marketing – CAC, ROAS and channel profitability
   

  

 Product – Funnel and conversion improvement
   

  

 CRM – Retention and customer lifecycle
   

  

 Finance – Margin and D2C P\&L
   

  

 Operations – RTO, logistics and fulfilment costs
   

  

 Supply Chain – Inventory and demand planning
   

  

 The analyst should proactively bring insights to teams rather than waiting for reporting requests.
   

  

**Key Requirements**
* 2–5 years of experience in Business Analytics, preferably within D2C, e\-commerce, retail or consumer businesses.
* Advanced SQL knowledge – mandatory.
* Strong hands\-on Power BI experience – mandatory.
* Strong Excel/Google Sheets capabilities.
* Strong understanding of D2C and e\-commerce business metrics.
* Ability to work with large and complex datasets.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability.
* Ability to translate analysis into clear business recommendations.
* Comfortable working directly with senior business stakeholders.


**Good to Have**
* Experience with Shopify or similar e\-commerce platforms.
* Knowledge of GA4 and digital analytics.
* Understanding of Meta and Google Ads data.
* Exposure to BigQuery or similar data warehouses.
* Basic Python knowledge.
* Experience building automated business reporting systems.
* Understanding of D2C P\&L and contribution margin structures.


**Key Success Metrics**
**Performance In This Role Will Primarily Be Evaluated On**
* Contribution Margin Improvement
* Identification and reduction of margin leakages
* Revenue and profitability insights generated
* Reduction in RTO/returns and associated costs through analytics
* Improvement in marketing efficiency
* Improvement in customer retention/LTV
* Accuracy and adoption of Power BI dashboards
* Reduction in manual reporting
* Speed and quality of actionable business insights
* Accuracy of business forecasts


**Ideal Candidate**
 We are looking for someone who doesn't stop at saying:
   

  

 “Revenue declined by 10%.”
   

  

**Instead, The Candidate Should Be Able To Explain**
 “Revenue declined by 10% because conversion dropped in these customer cohorts/SKUs/channels. Here is the ₹ impact, the likely root cause, and the actions we should take to recover revenue while protecting contribution margin.”
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines strong technical analytics capabilities with commercial/business thinking and uses data to influence decisions that improve both the top line and bottom line of the D2C business.
   

  

 Interested candidates can share your profile on
 **career@swissbeauty.in.**

Job role
We are looking for a **Business Operations Engineer** who will support the organization across **business operations, QMS, finance coordination, team performance analytics, MIS reporting, and process improvement**.


The role requires an analytical and detail\-oriented individual who can work with data, coordinate with multiple teams, maintain operational records, monitor KPIs, identify gaps, and support management in improving business processes.


The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with **Excel/Google Sheets, dashboards, trackers, documentation, and cross\-functional teams** and should have a strong ownership mindset.

  

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
-----------------------------


* Monitor and coordinate day\-to\-day **business and operational activities** across different functions and ensure timely completion of assigned tasks and action items.
* Prepare and maintain **MIS reports, dashboards, trackers, and management reports** related to business operations, team performance, finance, and QMS.
* Collect, consolidate, validate, and analyze data from Sales, Marketing, Finance, HR, Quality, Product, and other functions to provide accurate and timely operational insights.
* Track **team\-wise and individual KPIs**, targets, productivity, task completion, utilization, and performance against defined goals, and highlight gaps to the respective HOD/management.
* Support the management team in **weekly/monthly business performance reviews** by preparing data, reports, presentations, and action trackers.
* Maintain and monitor **QMS documentation, SOPs, records, forms, revision history, audit\-related documents, CAPA trackers, and compliance records** in coordination with the Quality team.
* Support preparation for **internal and external audits** by coordinating required documents, records, evidence, and action\-item follow\-ups.
* Track QMS observations, CAPAs, corrective actions, and compliance activities and follow up with responsible team members for timely closure.
* Prepare Quotations/PIs /Invoices and coordinate with the stakeholders for **invoices, payments, receivables, expenses, vendor/customer records, reconciliations, and other business\-related financial trackers**.
* Maintain accurate business and finance\-related data and identify discrepancies or missing information for correction.
* Monitor operational expenses, pending payments, receivables, and other assigned financial/business metrics and provide regular updates.
* Identify **process gaps, delays, duplication, inefficiencies, and operational risks** and coordinate with concerned teams for resolution.
* Develop and improve **Excel/Google Sheets\-based trackers, dashboards, and reporting systems** to improve visibility and accountability.
* Support process automation and digitization of repetitive operational and reporting activities.
* Maintain action trackers from management/HOD meetings and follow up with respective owners until closure.
* Coordinate with different departments to ensure timely completion of cross\-functional activities and escalate critical delays.
* Support management in **data\-driven decision\-making** by providing accurate analysis, trends, and operational insights.
* Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of business, employee, financial, customer, and operational information.
* Perform other business operations and analytical activities assigned by management.
  
  

Must have skills
MS Office MIS and dashboard preparation Basic understanding of business operations and process management Basic understanding of QMS and ISO standards is preferred Basic understanding of finance, invoices, payments, and reconciliation Strong numerical and analytical ability Attention to detail and data accuracy Structured problem\-solving approach
Good to have skills
High ownership and accountability Strong follow\-up and coordination skills Good written and verbal communication Ability to work with multiple teams Proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues Ability to work independently with minimal supervision Willingness to learn across Business Operations, QMS, Finance, and Analytics
Qualifications
* **0–2 years of experience** in Business Operations, Business Analysis, Operations, MIS, Quality, Finance Operations, or a similar role.
* **B.E./B.Tech candidates preferred**, especially candidates with an analytical or engineering mindset.
* Freshers with strong Excel, analytical, communication, and problem\-solving skills may also be considered.
* Candidates who demonstrate **career stability, ownership, attention to detail, and willingness to work across functions** will be preferred.

description:
**Description**
 Prime Video is a first\-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios\-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video add\-on subscriptions such as Apple TV\+, Max, Crunchyroll and MGM\+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.
   

  

 Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Do you want to invent, disrupt and redefine what entertainment means for fans, creators, and communities all around the globe?
   

  

 As part of the Prime Video team, you’ll get to work on projects that are fast\-paced, challenging, and varied. Also, you’ll get to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.
   

  

 We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill\-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented creatives, technologists, marketing professionals and so much more, you can decide where a career with Prime Video takes you!
   

  

 We are seeking a highly skilled and technically adept Data Engineer I to join our PVA Data Engineering team. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain scalable, fault\-tolerant data pipelines and infrastructure to support data\-driven insights. Leveraging native AWS technologies and Amazon’s internal tools, you will handle data ingestion, transformation, integration, and ensure high standards of data quality through validation, cleansing, and deduplication.
   

  

 This role will be responsible for building and maintaining efficient, scalable, and privacy/security complaint data pipelines to support our business stakeholders. These pipelines will be built using both tools available in Native AWS as well as Amazon internal tools and technologies.
   

  

 This role will need to be able to work closely with stakeholders to understand their needs and work alongside them to ensure data being ingested meets the business user's needs and will well modeled and organized to promote scalable usage and good data hygiene.
   

  

 This role is expected to leverage new technologies like Gen AI to and adapt to business needs, building and improving frameworks and processes with these new tools to accelerate development and improve data quality.
   

  

 You'll also manage diverse technologies such as Python, EMR, Spark, Iceberg, Airflow, and many AWS data services like Glue, Athena, Redshift to build a scalable platform that supports analytics and experimentation. The ideal candidate must be customer\-obsessed with a passion for advertising, able to synthesize a variety of technologies, and effectively lead complex projects.
   

  

 In this position, your attention to detail and dedication to high\-quality, well\-documented data products will empower stakeholders to make better, data\-driven decisions.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Modern Data Infrastructure \& Real\-Time Processing
   

  

* Engineer modern data infrastructure supporting real\-time data processing for AI/ML inference and training workloads
* Build semantic layers enabling intelligent query routing and context\-aware data access
* Develop infrastructure for AI\-powered automated workflows and orchestration
* Implement AI\-driven data quality, entity resolution, and metadata management solutions


 Data\-as\-a\-Product Delivery
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end accountability for data products from ingestion to consumption
* Deliver data products with clear SLAs, quality metrics, and customer satisfaction measures
* Build self\-service platforms with embedded governance, lineage, and discovery capabilities
* Establish data contracts and APIs for reliable, versioned data consumption


 AWS Infrastructure \& Pipeline Engineering
   

  

* Manage AWS resources including EC2, Lambda, S3, Redshift, and EMR
* Build high\-quality data pipelines supporting analysts, data scientists, and downstream consumers
* Implement CDC and event\-driven architectures for real\-time data availability
* Deploy infrastructure\-as\-code using CDK


**About The Team**
 Prime Video Advertising \- Data, Measurement and Insights(“PVA\-DMI”) team is a central data and analytics team within the PV\-Ads org that plays a pivotal role in fueling the worldwide growth of Amazon’s video advertising business. We own data platform, reporting, dashboards, measurement, and analytical solutions for PV Ads.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 1\+ years of data engineering experience
* Experience with SQL
* Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
* Experience with one or more query language (e.g., SQL, PL/SQL, DDL, MDX, HiveQL, SparkSQL, Scala)
* Experience with one or more scripting language (e.g., Python, KornShell)


**Preferred Qualifications**

title: Data Engineer 1
description:
**Job Summary**
 Supports, develops and maintains a data and analytics platform. Effectively and efficiently process, store and make data available to analysts and other consumers. Works with the Business and IT teams to understand the requirements to best leverage the technologies to enable agile data delivery at scale.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Implements and automates deployment of our distributed system for ingesting and transforming data from various types of sources (relational, event\-based, unstructured). Implements methods to continuously monitor and troubleshoot data quality and data integrity issues. Implements data governance processes and methods for managing metadata, access, retention to data for internal and external users. Develops reliable, efficient, scalable and quality data pipelines with monitoring and alert mechanisms that combine a variety of sources using ETL/ELT tools or scripting languages. Develops physical data models and implements data storage architectures as per design guidelines. Analyzes complex data elements and systems, data flow, dependencies, and relationships in order to contribute to conceptual physical and logical data models. Participates in testing and troubleshooting of data pipelines. Develops and operates large scale data storage and processing solutions using different distributed and cloud based platforms for storing data (e.g. Data Lakes, Hadoop, Hbase, Cassandra, MongoDB, Accumulo, DynamoDB, others). Uses agile development technologies, such as DevOps, Scrum, Kanban and continuous improvement cycle, for data driven application.
   

  

**Competencies**
 System Requirements Engineering \- Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.
   

  

 Collaborates \- Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.
   

  

 Communicates effectively \- Developing and delivering multi\-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
   

  

 Customer focus \- Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer\-centric solutions.
   

  

 Decision quality \- Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.
   

  

 Data Extraction \- Performs data extract\-transform\-load (ETL) activities from variety of sources and transforms them for consumption by various downstream applications and users using appropriate tools and technologies.
   

  

 Programming \- Creates, writes and tests computer code, test scripts, and build scripts using algorithmic analysis and design, industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
   

  

 Quality Assurance Metrics \- Applies the science of measurement to assess whether a solution meets its intended outcomes using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including the SDLC standards, tools, metrics and key performance indicators, to deliver a quality product.
   

  

 Solution Documentation \- Documents information and solution based on knowledge gained as part of product development activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.
   

  

 Solution Validation Testing \- Validates a configuration item change or solution using the Function's defined best practices, including the Systems Development Life Cycle (SDLC) standards, tools and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.
   

  

 Data Quality \- Identifies, understands and corrects flaws in data that supports effective information governance across operational business processes and decision making.
   

  

 Problem Solving \- Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data\-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.
   

  

 Values differences \- Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
   

  

**Education, Licenses, Certifications**
 College, university, or equivalent degree in relevant technical discipline, or relevant equivalent experience required. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
   

  

**Experience**
 Relevant experience preferred such as working in a temporary student employment, intern, co\-op, or other extracurricular team activities.
   

  

 Knowledge of the latest technologies in data engineering is highly preferred and includes:
   

  

* Exposure to Big Data open source
* SPARK, Scala/Java, Map\-Reduce, Hive, Hbase, and Kafka or equivalent college coursework
* SQL query language
* Clustered compute cloud\-based implementation experience
* Familiarity developing applications requiring large file movement for a Cloud\-based environment
* Exposure to Agile software development
* Exposure to building analytical solutions
* Exposure to IoT technology


**Core Responsibilities Unique To The Role**
* Develop and maintain enterprise data products by building data pipelines, data transformations, and curated datasets that support reporting, analytics, automation, and GenAI use cases across Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, Product Lifecycle, and other Enterprise Products domains. 2\) Apply Data\-as\-a\-Product principles to create reusable, discoverable, and governed data assets with appropriate metadata, lineage, and quality controls, enabling self\-service consumption and consistent business outcomes across multiple consumers. 3\)


 Collaborate with Product Managers, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Solution Engineers to support delivery of AI\-ready data products by ensuring data is reliable, well\-structured, and optimized for analytics, machine learning, and GenAI applications.
   

  

**Required Skills, Education, Or Experience**
* Experience developing and supporting data integration, ETL/ELT processes, data pipelines, and data transformations using modern data platforms and cloud\-based technologies. 2\) Working knowledge of data modeling, SQL, data quality practices, metadata management, and data governance principles supporting enterprise\-scale data products. 3\) Ability to translate business and product requirements into efficient technical solutions while considering scalability, performance, maintainability, and reusability. 4\) Experience working in Agile, cross\-functional teams and collaborating effectively with product, engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders. 5\) Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Analytics, or equivalent practical experience.


**Preferred (Nice To Have) Skills, Education, Or Experience**
* Experience working within a Data\-as\-a\-Product operating model, including exposure to data catalogs, lineage, data quality frameworks, and certified data products. 2\) Exposure to AI/ML or GenAI initiatives, including preparation of AI\-ready datasets, semantic models, knowledge assets, or data structures supporting intelligent business solutions.

The DE team uses data and insights to drive increased strategic and operational efficiencies across the organization. As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you will hold a highly visible analytical role that requires partnership with staff across the Medpace organization.
   

  

 What’s in this for you?
   

  

* Work in a collaborative, fast paced, entrepreneurial, and innovative workplace;
* Gain experience and exposure to advanced BI concepts from data warehousing to AI;


**Responsibilities**
 What’s involved?
   

  

 We are looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst to add depth to our growing Analytical team in a variety of areas – including SQL, Python, Data Modeling, and Data Warehousing. This role will work in close partnership with the US Data Engineering team to drive enterprise\-wide data initiatives to completion.
   

  

 An ideal candidate in this role will apply great analytical skills, communication skills, and problem\-solving skills to continue developing our analytics \& BI capabilities. We are looking for team members who thrive in working with complex data sets, conducting deep data analysis, are intensely curious, and enjoy designing and developing long\-term solutions.
   

  

 What you bring to the table – and why we need you!
   

  

* Technical Skills – either experience in, or strong desire to learn fundamental technical skills needed to drive Data initiatives (SQL, Python, Dimensional Modeling, etc.);
* Communication Skills \- Partner with other data engineers to implement data architecture and design, to support complex analysis;
* Analytical Skills \- Conduct complex analysis and proactively identify key business insights to assist departmental decision making.
* Data Visualization skills \- Designing and developing key metrics, reports, and dashboards to drive insights and business decisions to improve performance and reduce costs;


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Business, Life Science, Computer Science, or Related Degree;
* 0\-5 years of experience in business intelligence or data engineering – advanced SQL and Python preferred;
* Strong analytical and communication skills;
* Excellent organization skills and the ability to work independently.

 Medpace is a full\-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) providing phase l\-lV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through the advancement of clinical research. We leverage in\-country regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major therapeutic areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic, endocrinology, central nervous system, and anti\-viral and anti\-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, we employ more than 6,500 people across 40\+ countries.
   

  

**Why Medpace?**
 When you join Medpace, you become part of an innovative team that brings cutting\-edge therapies to market while building a meaningful and rewarding career focused on scientific excellence and improving patient outcomes around the world through continuous learning and cross\-functional collaboration.
   

  

***Purpose\-Driven Work***
* 
+ Work alongside physicians, scientists, and industry\-leading experts committed to advancing the global development of medical therapeutics through clinical research excellence


***Collaborative Culture***
* 
+ Contribute to an interactive team environment that empowers decision making, creative thinking, and continuous learning through open communication and mutual trust.
+ Leadership throughout Medpace is both accessible and approachable


***Continuous Growth \& Development***
* 
+ Office based environment with on\-site mentors
+ Defined career paths with clear advancement opportunities
+ Industry renowned onboarding and training programs designed to accelerate professional development
+ Ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities throughout your career
+ An environment that encourages employees to influence change, contribute ideas, and grow quickly


**Other Employee Benefits**
* 
+ Competitive compensation programs that recognize and reward performance
+ Comprehensive health, wellness, retirement, and PTO benefits

At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the world's leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting\-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency.
 



  



 By “Connecting Convenience” across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real\-time market intelligence via mobile applications, such as GasBuddy.  We’re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth.
 



  


**Role Overview:**



  



 As a Data Engineer II, you will design, develop, and support scalable cloud\-based data pipelines that enable analytics, reporting, and business intelligence across the organization. Working within AWS\-native technologies, you will integrate enterprise applications into centralized data platforms while ensuring data quality, reliability, and performance. You will collaborate with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate reporting requirements into scalable data solutions that support informed business decisions.
 



  






  






  




**Key Responsibilities** 
  

  
* Design, develop, and maintain cloud\-based data pipelines supporting enterprise reporting and analytics.
  
* Build and optimize ETL/ELT processes using AWS\-native data services and modern data engineering practices.
  
* Integrate enterprise source systems, including Salesforce, NetSuite, and other business applications, into centralized data platforms.
  
* Develop and maintain scalable data models supporting reporting and business intelligence initiatives.
  
* Monitor pipeline performance, troubleshoot data issues, and implement improvements to ensure data accuracy and reliability.
  
* Partner with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  
* Support data governance initiatives by maintaining data quality, metadata, and documentation.
  
* Contribute to automation, continuous integration, and infrastructure\-as\-code practices to improve development efficiency.
  
* Participate in code reviews and promote engineering best practices across the team.
  

  


  


  




**Qualifications** 
  

  
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  
* 2\-4 years of experience in data engineering or cloud data platform development.
  
* Experience developing data pipelines using AWS services such as S3, Glue, Redshift, AppFlow, and Step Functions.
  
* Experience working with SQL, Python, and PySpark.
  
* Understanding of dimensional modeling, data warehousing concepts, and modern data lake technologies.
  
* Experience integrating enterprise applications such as Salesforce, NetSuite, or similar SaaS platforms.
  
* Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred).
  
* Practical experience with applying AI/ML techniques to data engineering problems, such as automated data quality checks, anomaly detection, or intelligent pipeline monitoring
  
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
  
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills.
  

  


  


  




**Behavioral Competencies** 
  

  
* Ensures Accountability
  
* Manages Complexity
  
* Communicates Effectively
  
* Balances Stakeholders
  
* Collaborates Effectively
  

  


  





  




  



 PDI is committed to offering a well\-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career.  This includes a competitive salary, market\-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work\-life balance with ample time off \[time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements.  Employees have access to continuous learning, professional certifications, and leadership development opportunities. Our global culture fosters diversity, inclusion, and values authenticity, trust, curiosity, and diversity of thought, ensuring a supportive environment for all.
 



  


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Data Engineer 2
description:
**Job Summary**
 Supports, develops and maintains a data and analytics platform. Effectively and efficiently process, store and make data available to analysts and other consumers. Works with the Business and IT teams to understand the requirements to best leverage the technologies to enable agile data delivery at scale.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Implements and automates deployment of our distributed system for ingesting and transforming data from various types of sources (relational, event\-based, unstructured). Implements methods to continuously monitor and troubleshoot data quality and data integrity issues. Implements data governance processes and methods for managing metadata, access, retention to data for internal and external users. Develops reliable, efficient, scalable and quality data pipelines with monitoring and alert mechanisms that combine a variety of sources using ETL/ELT tools or scripting languages. Develops physical data models and implements data storage architectures as per design guidelines. Analyzes complex data elements and systems, data flow, dependencies, and relationships in order to contribute to conceptual physical and logical data models. Participates in testing and troubleshooting of data pipelines. Develops and operates large scale data storage and processing solutions using different distributed and cloud based platforms for storing data (e.g. Data Lakes, Hadoop, Hbase, Cassandra, MongoDB, Accumulo, DynamoDB, others). Uses agile development technologies, such as DevOps, Scrum, Kanban and continuous improvement cycle, for data driven application.
   

  

**Competencies**
 System Requirements Engineering \- Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.
   

  

 Collaborates \- Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.
   

  

 Communicates effectively \- Developing and delivering multi\-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
   

  

 Customer focus \- Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer\-centric solutions.
   

  

 Decision quality \- Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.
   

  

 Data Extraction \- Performs data extract\-transform\-load (ETL) activities from variety of sources and transforms them for consumption by various downstream applications and users using appropriate tools and technologies.
   

  

 Programming \- Creates, writes and tests computer code, test scripts, and build scripts using algorithmic analysis and design, industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
   

  

 Quality Assurance Metrics \- Applies the science of measurement to assess whether a solution meets its intended outcomes using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including the SDLC standards, tools, metrics and key performance indicators, to deliver a quality product.
   

  

 Solution Documentation \- Documents information and solution based on knowledge gained as part of product development activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.
   

  

 Solution Validation Testing \- Validates a configuration item change or solution using the Function's defined best practices, including the Systems Development Life Cycle (SDLC) standards, tools and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.
   

  

 Data Quality \- Identifies, understands and corrects flaws in data that supports effective information governance across operational business processes and decision making.
   

  

 Problem Solving \- Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data\-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.
   

  

 Values differences \- Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
   

  

**Education, Licenses, Certifications**
 College, university, or equivalent degree in relevant technical discipline, or relevant equivalent experience required. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
   

  

**Experience**
 3 to 6 Years of relevant experience
   

  

 Relevant experience preferred such as working in a temporary student employment, intern, co\-op, or other extracurricular team activities.
   

  

 Knowledge of the latest technologies in data engineering is highly preferred and includes:
   

  

* Exposure to Big Data open source
* SPARK, Scala/Java, Map\-Reduce, Hive, Hbase, and Kafka or equivalent college coursework
* SQL query language
* Clustered compute cloud\-based implementation experience
* Familiarity developing applications requiring large file movement for a Cloud\-based environment
* Exposure to Agile software development
* Exposure to building analytical solutions
* Exposure to IoT technology


**Core Responsibilities Unique To The Role**
* Develop and maintain enterprise data products by building data pipelines, data transformations, and curated datasets that support reporting, analytics, automation, and GenAI use cases across Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, Product Lifecycle, and other Enterprise Products domains. 2\) Apply Data\-as\-a\-Product principles to create reusable, discoverable, and governed data assets with appropriate metadata, lineage, and quality controls, enabling self\-service consumption and consistent business outcomes across multiple consumers. 3\)


 Collaborate with Product Managers, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Solution Engineers to support delivery of AI\-ready data products by ensuring data is reliable, well\-structured, and optimized for analytics, machine learning, and GenAI applications.
   

  

**Required Skills, Education, Or Experience**
* Experience developing and supporting data integration, ETL/ELT processes, data pipelines, and data transformations using modern data platforms and cloud\-based technologies. 2\) Working knowledge of data modeling, SQL, data quality practices, metadata management, and data governance principles supporting enterprise\-scale data products. 3\) Ability to translate business and product requirements into efficient technical solutions while considering scalability, performance, maintainability, and reusability. 4\) Experience working in Agile, cross\-functional teams and collaborating effectively with product, engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders. 5\) Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Analytics, or equivalent practical experience.


**Preferred (Nice To Have) Skills, Education, Or Experience**
* Experience working within a Data\-as\-a\-Product operating model, including exposure to data catalogs, lineage, data quality frameworks, and certified data products. 2\) Exposure to AI/ML or GenAI initiatives, including preparation of AI\-ready datasets, semantic models, knowledge assets, or data structures supporting intelligent business solutions.

title: Associate Mathematician
description:
**Gaming:**
 Welcome to the world of land\-based gaming. At Light \& Wonder, it’s all about the games, and our Gaming team builds cutting\-edge technology, products, and content for the most iconic casinos and operators across the globe.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Uses advanced mathematical and statistical concepts and theories to analyze and collect data and construct solutions to business problems. Performs complex statistical analysis on experimental or business data to validate and quantify trends or patterns identified by business analysts. Constructs predictive models, algorithms and probability engines to support data analysis or product functions; verifies model and algorithm effectiveness based on real\-world results. Designs experiments and methodologies to generate and collect data for business use. Projects may include a focus on “quantitative finance” or help identify new business opportunities. Incumbents whose primary function is performing basic statistical analysis of business data and building recommendations and plans for business actions should be matched to Business Intelligence. Incumbents whose primary role is technical and focused on designing and building system\-generated reports, reporting tools and dashboards for data generation should be matched to Data Informatics.
   

  

 About Light \& Wonder: Light \& Wonder, Inc. is the leading cross\-platform global games company. Through our three unique, yet highly complementary business segments, we deliver unforgettable experiences by combining the exceptional talents of our 6,500\+ member team, with a deep understanding of our customers and players. We create immersive content that forges lasting connections with players, wherever they choose to engage. At Light \& Wonder, it’s all about the games. The Company is committed to the highest standards of integrity, from promoting player responsibility to implementing sustainable practices. To learn more visit www.lnw.com.
   

  

 At Light \& Wonder, all our team members are known as Creators. We empower our creators to innovate, create, and bring fun to the workspace. The core principles that unite our team, guide our actions, and drive our growth are:
   

  

* Dare to be bold \- We always bring courage to work to reach for the unbelievable
* Celebrate perspectives \- We combine diverse talents to look at the familiar in unfamiliar ways
* Never settle \- We relentlessly push forward to create the extraordinary in every detail
* Uphold integrity \- We promote accountability and respect to raise the bar for ourselves and the industry
* Win as a team \- We bring out the best in each other to share collective success


**Position Summary:** 
 As an Associate Mathematician, you will collaborate with a team of highly skilled artists, software engineers, and game designers to deliver engaging and innovative gaming experience. Bring our games to life by developing the math models that drive slot game play. Success in this role requires strong collaboration, efficiency under pressure, and a proactive, positive attitude.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and document math models for slot games, including pay tables, reel strips, feature triggers, and bonus structures, with clear demonstration of probabilities and Return to Player (RTP) through theoretical calculations and simulations.Modify the existing math models as per the requirements.
* Collaborate closely with game designers and other mathematicians to brainstorm new mechanics and features, assessing mathematical feasibility, risk profile, and expected player experience (e.g., hit rate, volatility, pacing).
* Build, run, and refine simulations to verify math models, stress\-test edge cases, and gather performance statistics (e.g., win size distributions, session length, feature frequency).
* Work hand\-in\-hand with software engineers and math test engineers to ensure accurate implementation of math models, including debugging discrepancies between theoretical results and live game behaviour.
* Support regulatory compliance by preparing math documentation, responding to questions, and helping address issues raised during internal testing or certification.
* Iterate on game math throughout development, tuning parameters based on internal feedback, playtests, and early performance data while preserving the intended player experience, RTP targets, and jurisdictional requirements.
* Stay informed about slot games and market trends, analysing math structures and features from products and sharing insights with the team.


**Experience**
* 0–3 years of professional experience in applied mathematics, probability, statistics, combinatorics, or a closely related field; strong new graduates with relevant projects and interests will be considered.
* Experience designing or modeling systems with randomness (e.g., games, simulations, casino math, trading models, or similar).
* Demonstrated interest in slot machines, casino games, and/or game design—through professional experience, academic work, personal projects, or hobbyist game design (slots, table games such as blackjack, poker, baccarat, etc.) is preferred.
* Prior experience in the game or casino industry is preferred but not required; relevant internships, academic projects, or personal projects will be considered.


**Education**
* Master’s degree required in Mathematics, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative field. Ph.D. in related field is plus.
* Coursework or projects with a strong focus on probability, statistics, or combinatorics are strongly preferred.


**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities**
* Strong applied math skills with the ability to build, analyze, and balance stochastic models (e.g., RTP, hit frequency, volatility, bonus frequencies).
* Able to independently develop, evaluate, and iterate on new mathematical game concepts that align with player experience and product goals.
* Regularly contributes creative ideas and mechanics to game design discussions; comfortable collaborating with designers, artists, and producers and explaining math clearly to non\-mathematicians.
* Proficiency with analytical and development tools, including:
* Strong Excel or similar spreadsheet skills for building and tuning math models.
* Experience with at least one programming or scripting environment for simulation and analysis (e.g. C\#, C\+\+, Python); C\+\+ is a strong plus.
* Detail\-oriented and comfortable with iterative work enjoys tuning parameters, validating results, and rigorously testing math models.
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal; able to document math clearly and support math reviews with other teams.
