title: LDAP Software Engineer - India
description:
**All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.** 



  

 About JumpCloud®
   


 JumpCloud® is the AI\-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.
 


  


  
 


  

**JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.** 
  





  





  

**About the Role**
  



 As a Software Engineer II on the Cloud LDAP team, you will build, scale, and operate JumpCloud’s LDAP\-as\-a\-Service: the systems that let customers authenticate and look up users and groups over LDAP against the JumpCloud directory.
 



  



 You will work with a globally distributed engineering team on high\-availability LDAP infrastructure—protocol handling, directory sync, replication, and edge serving—primarily on our Go, Python, and/or Node.js backend stacks. This role is LDAP development. You will implement and maintain LDAP protocol behavior, directory data pipelines, and the services in front of our OpenLDAP clusters, and you will use AI\-assisted development tools ( Cursor, Gemini, Claude etc) to ship high\-quality code faster.
 



  






  




**What You Will Do:** 
  
* **What You Will Do**
  

	  
	+ **LDAP platform development:**
	
	 Design, implement, test, and deploy scalable, secure services that power Cloud LDAP, including protocol proxies, sync workers, and supporting APIs.
	  
	+ **Protocol \& directory behavior:**
	
	 Own backend work for LDAP operations customers rely on—bind (including MFA\-aware bind flows), search, compare, and related directory semantics (DNs, filters, attributes, schemas, ACLs).
	  
	+ **Sync, replication, and availability:**
	
	 Contribute to how directory changes flow into LDAP (async create/update/delete), how data is replicated to regional read replicas, and how the service stays available under load and during failover.
	  
	+ **Edge \& proxy services:**
	
	 Work on the LDAP request path (load balancing, connection limits, TLS/STARTTLS, eventing/observability, password handling, and related edge protections).
	  
	+ **AI\-driven efficiency:**
	
	 Use AI coding assistants to generate code, write solid automated tests, and speed up debugging—without skipping review or operational rigor.
	  
	+ **Cloud infrastructure:**
	
	 Run containerized services with Docker and Kubernetes and operate cloud\-native components on AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, DynamoDB, and related services).
	  
	+ **Quality \& automation:**
	
	 Add automated tests for new LDAP features and legacy paths, and use CI/CD to keep quality gates in place.
	  
	+ **Collaborative engineering:**
	
	 Partner with product and senior engineers across time zones on requirements, feasibility, and thorough code reviews. Participate in on\-call for production LDAP alerts.
  

  



  




**What We’re Looking For:** 
  

**What We’re Looking For**
  

  
* **Experience:**

 3–5 years of professional software development, with a strong emphasis on backend systems, networked services, and APIs.
  
* **Core technical stack:**

 Proficiency in Go, C\+\+, Node.js, and/or Python.
  
* **LDAP \& directory foundations:**

 Solid understanding of LDAP (or a closely related directory protocol). Comfort with bind/search, DNs, filters, schemas, TLS/STARTTLS, and how applications (Linux, NAS, custom clients, Samba, and similar) consume LDAP. OpenLDAP, 389 Directory Server, Active Directory LDAP, or similar experience is a strong plus.
  
* **Distributed systems:**

 Practical experience with high\-availability services, messaging/queues, replication, or proxy/load\-balancer request paths.
  
* **Cloud \& DevOps basics:**

 Experience deploying on AWS and a working understanding of Kubernetes and/or Infrastructure as Code (e.g. Terraform).
  
* **AI tool fluent:**

 Demonstrated use of AI coding assistants to increase velocity, find bugs, and improve code quality.
  
* **Education:**

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  

  


  

  

**Nice to Have**
  

  
* Experience with OpenLDAP overlays, replication (provider/consumer), or LDAP proxy/middleware.
  
* Familiarity with directory sync from an identity source of truth, service meshes, or HAProxy/Consul\-style service discovery.
  
* Comfort debugging protocol\-level issues with tools such as ldapsearch, packet captures, or server logs.
  

  


  

  





  




  


**Where you’ll be working/Location:** 



  



 JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.
 



  


  
 


  


**You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role.** 



  


  
 


  



 Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on\-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed.
 



  


  
 


  


**Language:** 



  



 JumpCloud has teams in 15\+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.  Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.
 



  


  
 


  


**Why JumpCloud?** 

  
 



  



 If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS\-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.  
 



  



  
 



  



 One of JumpCloud's three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." \- Rajat Bhargava, CEO
 



  



  
 



  



 Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud.  Please note JumpCloud is not accepting third party resumes at this time.   
 



  



  
 



  



 JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.
 



  


  
 


  



**Scam Notice:** 




  



 Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.
 



  


  
 


  



 All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice" 
 



  



  
 



  



 \#BI\-Remote
 



  


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. Please see our Privacy Policy (https://jumpcloud.com/privacy) for more information about our personal data practices.

title: Full Stack Software Lead
description:
**About Kaari** 




  





 Kaari Labs is building spatial commerce infrastructure for modern retail. We help brands turn product images into interactive 3D and AR shopping experiences, and an end\-to\-end solution that allows customers to build and deploy 3D assets on the web.
 



  





**Our Vision** 




 Our larger vision is to build 3D intelligence that enables AI to understand the physical world. This involves building foundational 3D AI models and workflows that can create and edit 3D assets and scenes in filmmaking, robotics, and manufacturing, on problems like virtual set designing, and product prototyping.
 



  





 These are ambitious goals, and to get there sustainably we have started with e\-commerce as a wedge to break into the market. Our current offering turns product pages into interactive 3D experiences, this includes 3D asset generation, an AI\-native 3D editor, and delivering mixed reality shopping experiences on the web. Spatial commerce has a clear commercial value and fast feedback loops, making it the right entry point into broader 3D intelligence. This positions us to balance revenue alongside having a testbed for evaluating and experimenting on moonshot 3D AI problems.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 We're hiring a software lead who lives in the code. You will own large parts of Kaari's product: the AI\-native 3D editor, dashboards, APIs, and set the technical defaults for how we ship. You should be comfortable making architectural calls and reviewing work. This is for someone who has already led development on a production system and wants to do that again in a small, fast\-moving team. This is a full\-time hybrid role based in Mumbai, with flexibility for partial work from home.
 



  





**What you will work on** 



* Own end\-to\-end product slices: React/TypeScript UI, Next.js flows, APIs, storage, auth, embeds
* React and TypeScript frontend experiences for dashboards, editors, viewers, and configurators
* Next.js product flows for 3D asset management, material libraries, analytics, and client\-facing tools
* Backend APIs, storage flows, signed asset delivery, authentication, and integrations
* Scalable systems for serving 3D/AR experiences through lightweight embeds on brand websites
* Internal tools that help teams generate, refine, manage, and deploy 3D product assets faster
* Product decisions around performance, reliability, and developer experience along with deciding the quality and the architecture bar



  





**What we are looking for** 



* 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience
* Strong React, TypeScript, and modern frontend fundamentals
* Experience building full\-stack production grade products, preferably with Next.js or similar frameworks. We don't care too much about AI slop demos.
* Solid software design and database fundamentals — you can make sound architectural calls across APIs, schema design, caching, auth, and deployment.
* Experience making high\-level technical decisions and setting the engineering standard in a fast\-paced startup environment.
* Strong product mindset: you bridge the gap between engineering and user needs, ensuring technical decisions drive real business value.
* Thoughtful use of AI: Everyone uses it, but we need you to understand every code change you make so that you are in control of your AI and not the other way round.
* Bachelor's or Master's in CS/Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.



  





**Bonus Points** 



* Background or interest in 3D, graphics, AR/VR, or applied AI is a strong plus.
* Experience technically leading a small team or owning a product area.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure and deployment.



  





**The Kind of Person Who'll Fit** 




 We want builders who take ownership, communicate clearly, and are not afraid to take on hard problems even when that requires learning new skills. Disagreement is expected. Power games are not. Argue hard, stay decent, then commit to what is best for Kaari.
 



  





 We value unusual technical or creative interests, and strong fundamentals. If you are excited about difficult problems in 3D, AI, and product engineering, and want to turn imagination into something real, you will fit well.
 



  





**Why Join Kaari** 




 You'll set technical direction on a product at the intersection of commerce, 3D, and advancing AI, while staying in the code. Small team, close to product and customers, real say in how the company gets built.
 



  





**To Apply** 




 Send your resume, GitHub/portfolio if available, and a short note about a production system you owned or are proud of: what you decided, what you shipped, and any opinions you have of Kaari.
 



 Email: siddharth \[at] kaari \[dot] design

title: Videographer
description:
**WHO WE ARE** 




 Legend of Toys (LOT) is a full stack D2C toys start\-up out of India. We design and manufacture toys where
 



 each product has a personality: a name, a backstory, a world it belongs to. We compete on identity, not price.
 



  





 L.O.T Build is our build\-and\-collect business: kits and models you assemble by hand and then keep on a
 



 shelf. Licensed worlds sit alongside our own India\-first lines: architecture, space, defence, and how things
 



 work. Every box carries an education layer: something to read, something to watch, a fact worth repeating at the dinner table.
 



  





**THE ROLE** 




 You own how L.O.T Build moves. Every film, every launch cut, every piece of motion that goes out for this line comes through you, shot, edited, and finished. You report to the Brand Manager for L.O.T Build and work to the direction they set. This is a junior role, but it is not an assisting role. You will be handed a brief and a standard, not a shot list to babysit. Expect to be behind a camera one day and deep in a timeline the next, and expect feedback that is direct about craft. You will be coached, properly and often. What we need from you is the appetite to be pushed. One thing to be clear about: your remit is L.O.T Build, not all of Legend of Toys. LOT Cars and the wider legendoftoys.com brand sit outside this role, though you will work closely alongside both.
 



  





**HOW WE WORK · AI\-FIRST** 




 We are an AI\-first creative team. Generative tools are part of how work actually gets made here, not a side
 



 experiment and not something you use quietly. We expect you to reach for them first and to keep finding
 



 better ones.
 



 – Use AI to get further, faster: generated b\-roll and establishing shots, rough assembly, scratch VO,
 



 upscaling, cleanup and rotoscoping, and fast variant generation for testing
 



 – The bar is not whether AI made it. The bar is whether it holds up. AI gets you to a draft. Your taste
 



 and eye get it to the standard
 



 – Bring tools to the team rather than waiting to be trained on one. What you find, we adopt
 



 – Know the limits: a generated shot that looks impressive and reads as fake is a shot we do not ship.
 



 Knowing when to put the camera back on a tripod is part of the skill
 



  





**WHAT YOU WILL OWN** 




 Shoot
 



 – Own product and lifestyle shoots end to end: camera, lighting, sound, and solving problems on set
 



 rather than after it
 



 – Shoot the build itself: hands, assembly, texture, detail, and the finished model as an object
 



 somebody would want on a shelf
 



 – Work to a shot list you help build, and know when to grab the extra angle nobody asked for
 



 Edit \& Post
 



 – Cut everything for the line: launch films, product explainers, social, paid ads, and marketplace video
 



 – Own colour, sound, pacing, and export discipline across every format and aspect ratio we ship
 



 – Keep footage and projects organised: a timeline someone else can open and understand is part of
 



 the job
 



 Motion Graphics
 



 – Build titles, kinetic type, callouts, and animated explainers in After Effects or equivalent
 



 – Turn the education layer into motion: how a mechanism works, how a build comes together, why the
 



 thing is worth knowing about
 



 – Maintain motion templates so repeat formats are not rebuilt from scratch every single launch
 



 Launch \& Volume
 



 – Deliver the video behind every product launch, on the calendar, without the schedule slipping
 



 – Produce at the volume paid and organic actually need, without letting quality drift as the count goes
 



 up
 



 – Version and adapt hero assets across channels instead of treating every placement as a new build
 



  





**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** 




 Experience
 



 – 1 \- 3 years shooting and editing, whether in\-house, agency, or freelance, or a reel strong enough to
 



 make the years irrelevant
 



 – Comfortable on a real set: camera, lights, and the confidence to reset something that is not working
 



 – Fluent in Premiere or Resolve, and working knowledge of After Effects for motion
 



 – Genuinely hands\-on with AI video tools: whatever you have found that works, and an opinion about
 



 why
 



 – Bonus, not required: 3D or Blender, stills photography, sound design, colour grading
 



 The Person
 



 – Obsessed with craft: the kind of person who rewatches their own cut and finds the frame that is off
 



 – Fast without being sloppy, and clear that a launch date is a real date
 



 – Takes direction well and asks the second question, not just the first
 



 – Curious about tools, sceptical about hype, biased toward shipping
 



 – Comfortable with ambiguity, fast timelines, and a brand that is still being built
 



  





**WHY THIS ROLE** 




 You will not be cutting someone else's footage on someone else's brand. L.O.T Build is early enough that the visual language for how this line moves has not been set yet, and you will be one of the people setting it. You get real coaching from the person who owns the brand, an AI\-first pipeline instead of a legacy one, and work that ships to a real market from week one.
 



 We are not a category player. We are trying to build something that has not been built in India before: a toy brand with a real identity, a real community, and products with personality. If that sounds like something worth building, we want to talk.

title: Embedded Firmware Engineer (ADAS)
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION** 




**Embedded Firmware Engineer/Sr. Engineer – ADAS** 




**Business Unit\-** 
 ADAS
 



**Reporting To\-** 
 Head of Embedded System
 



**Location\-** 
 Gurgaon, India
 



**Experience Required\-** 
 2–3 years in embedded firmware development, with exposure to automotive, Radar, ADAS, or ECU firmware development
 



**Key Competency\-** 
 Firmware development (C/C\+\+) with experience working on radar application.
 



  





**Education\-** 
 M.Tech/B.Tech / B.E. in Embedded systems, Electronics, Computer Science, or a related field
 



  





**ABOUT NOVUS HI\-TECH** 




 Novus Hi\-Tech Robotic Systemz Pvt. Ltd. designs and delivers advanced driver\-assistance, robotics, and connected\-device solutions across four business units: ADAS, ADAS Aftermarket, Mobile Robotics, and Defence Robotics. The ADAS business builds embedded firmware and sensor\-fusion software that runs directly on automotive\-grade hardware powering Electronic Control Units (ECUs) that support perception, driver\-assistance, and safety functions across vehicle platforms.
 



  





**ROLE SUMMARY** 




 We're looking for an Embedded Firmware Engineer to join our ADAS team, writing and testing C/C\+\+ firmware that runs directly on automotive\-grade ECUs. This is a hands\-on individual\-contributor role for an engineer who enjoys working close to the hardware debugging at the driver level, working with sensor data, and helping build reliable, safety\-critical software. You'll work closely with senior engineers and Engineering Manager, contributing to sensor\-fusion and perception modules while growing your expertise in AUTOSAR, RTOS, and automotive\-grade development practices.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 



* Design, develop, and test embedded firmware in C/C\+\+ for ADAS\-related Electronic Control Units (ECUs).
* Contribute to sensor\-fusion and perception software modules, working with data from radar, camera, LiDAR, or ultrasonic sensors.
* Write and maintain firmware aligned with AUTOSAR architecture and automotive coding standards.
* Debug and resolve low\-level issues involving RTOS, device drivers, and communication protocols (CAN, LIN, Ethernet, SPI, and I2C).
* Participate in code reviews, unit testing, static analysis, and CI/CD practices to maintain firmware quality.
* Support integration and validation activities with hardware, systems, and testing teams.
* Follow MISRA C/C\+\+ coding guidelines and contribute to functional\-safety\-compliant (ISO 26262\) development practices.
* Document design decisions, test results, and known issues clearly for the wider engineering team.
* Collaborate with senior engineers and managers on sprint planning, estimates, and technical trade\-offs.



  





**REQUIRED SKILLS \& EXPERIENCE** 



* 2–3 years of hands\-on embedded software development experience.
* Strong programming skills in C/C\+\+ for embedded, real\-time systems; experience on radar application development is preferred.
* Working knowledge of microcontroller/SoC\-based firmware development for automotive or similarly safety\-critical domains.
* Understanding of RTOS concepts and real\-time system design.
* Exposure to automotive communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, SPI, or I2C.
* Familiarity with embedded debugging tools such as JTAG, emulators, and oscilloscopes/logic analyzers.
* Basic understanding of AUTOSAR concepts and MISRA C/C\+\+ coding practices is a plus.
* Good analytical and debugging skills, with attention to detail in safety\-critical code.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a cross\-functional engineering environment.



  





**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** 



* Prior experience with radar, camera, or other ADAS sensor applications.
* Exposure to functional safety standards (ISO 26262\) or automotive cybersecurity practices (ISO 21434\).
* Familiarity with version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and static analysis tools.
* Coursework or project experience involving sensor fusion, signal processing, or embedded Linux.

* Good knowledge of manufacturing processes including CNC machining, sheet metal fabrication, welding, laser cutting, and 3D printing.

title: Engineer - Controls Engineering
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 Systems Engineering ist eine funktionsübergreifende technische Disziplin, die sich auf einen Ansatz, eine Denkweise und einen Prozess konzentriert. Alle Tätigkeiten, die sowohl die geschäftlichen als auch die technischen Anforderungen der Kunden berücksichtigen, mit dem Ziel, ein Qualitätsprodukt bereitzustellen, das die Anforderungen der Benutzer erfüllt. Die Disziplin zur Umsetzung eines soliden Prozesses zum Entwerfen, Erstellen und Optimieren von Systemen, der aus der Identifizierung und Quantifizierung von Systemanforderungen, der Erstellung alternativer Systementwurfskonzepte, der Durchführung von Design\-Trade\-off\-Studien, der Auswahl und Implementierung der besten Entwürfe und der Überprüfung der Tatsache besteht, dass das Design ordnungsgemäß integriert ist und ausgeführt wird. Prozess, der vom Konzept über die Produktion bis zum Betrieb verläuft.
   

  

 Beeinflusst die Qualität der eigenen Arbeit und der Arbeit anderer im Team.Führt betriebliche/technische Standardaufgaben aus, die in der Regel Anweisungen und Arbeitsabläufen unterliegen.Möglicherweise besteht Spielraum, um die Reihenfolge zu ändern und Aufgaben/Pflichten basierend auf sich ändernden Arbeitssituationen zu erledigen.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten**
* Identifizieren, entwickeln, bewerten, führen ein und verwalten Engineering\-Lösungen für die Anforderungen der Produkt\- und Steuerungssystemtechnologie. Wenden die Steuerungstheorie und mathematische Modellierung auf Entwurfs\- und Steuerungssysteme mit dem gewünschten Verhalten an. Beinhaltet Bedienbarkeit, Festlegen von Grenzen, Zyklusoptimierung, Steuerlogik, steuerungsbezogene Software, Sensoren, Hardware\- und Softwarealgorithmen sowie Feedback zur Steuerung der Leistung von Geräten, Subsystemen und Systemen.
* Erweiterung der Kenntnisse der eigenen technischen Disziplin zur Umsetzung von Richtlinien/Strategien.Kann Support\-Rollen mit spezialisiertem technischem Wissensgebiet beinhalten; laufender Erwerb von Kenntnissen und Fähigkeiten auf höherem Niveau.
* Grundlegendes Verständnis der wichtigsten Geschäftstreiber; nutzt dieses Verständnis, um eigene Arbeit zu leisten.Gute Kenntnisse darüber, wie sich die Arbeit des eigenen Teams in andere Teams integriert und zum Bereich beiträgt.
* Kann eine gewisse Autonomie besitzen, um Entscheidungen innerhalb eines definierten Rahmens zu treffen.Löst Probleme in Situationen, in denen gute technische Kenntnisse und Urteilsvermögen im Rahmen festgelegter Verfahren erforderlich sind.Konsultiert hochrangigere Teammitglieder zu Problemen außerhalb definierter Anweisungen/Parameter.
* Eine Stelle auf diesem Niveau erfordert gute zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten und kann notwendig sein, um ein Junior\-Team zu führen.Entwickelt für kundenorientierte Rollen starke Kundenbeziehungen und dient als Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden und GE Vernova.Erklärt anderen technische Informationen.


**Grundqualifikationen**
* Diese Rolle erfordert grundlegende Erfahrung . Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor\-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule (oder einem Abitur mit entsprechender Erfahrung).


**Gewünschte Eigenschaften**
* Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägte Sozialkompetenz und Führungsqualitäten. Fähigkeit, selbständig zu arbeiten. Starke Fähigkeiten zur Problemlösung.Hinweis:Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind.Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden.Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern.Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern.

**About The Business** 




 Tata Electronics Private Limited is a greenfield venture of the Tata Group with expertise in manufacturing precision components.
 



 Tata Electronics (a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd.） is building India’s first AI\-enabled state\-of\-the\-art Semiconductor Foundry. This facility will produce chips for applications such as power management IC, display drivers, microcontrollers (MCU） and high\-performance computing logic, addressing the growing demand in markets such as automotive, computing and data storage, wireless communications and artificial intelligence.
 



 Tata Electronics is a subsidiary of the Tata group. The Tata Group operates in more than 100 countries across six continents, with the mission 'To improve the quality of life of the communities we serve globally, through long term stakeholder value creation based on leadership with Trust.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 Responsible for designing, programming, integrating, commissioning, and troubleshooting industrial robotic systems in automated manufacturing environments. Collaborates with automation, PLC, vision, and production teams to deliver reliable, high\-performance robotic solutions that improve productivity, quality, and operational efficiency.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design, develop, and implement robotic automation solutions for manufacturing and assembly processes.
* Program, configure, test, and troubleshoot industrial robots to meet production requirements.
* Work with 6\-axis articulated and SCARA robots from manufacturers such as FANUC, ABB, Omron, Epson, and others.
* Install, commission, validate, and optimize robotic cells from concept through production launch.
* Integrate robotic systems with PLCs, machine vision systems, sensors, and peripheral equipment.
* Perform robot path optimization, cycle time improvement, and process validation activities.
* Conduct root cause analysis and resolve robotic equipment issues to ensure maximum uptime.
* Support preventive maintenance, upgrades, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with industrial safety standards, machine safety requirements, and risk assessment procedures.
* Utilize simulation and offline programming tools for system design, validation, and optimization.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to achieve project milestones, quality targets, and production goals.



  





**Required Skills \& Competencies** 



* Hands\-on experience in industrial robot programming, integration, commissioning, and troubleshooting.
* Strong knowledge of robotic automation, motion control, and manufacturing processes.
* Experience with industrial communication protocols:
* PROFINET
* EtherNet/IP
* EtherCAT
* Modbus
* TCP/IP
* RS\-232 Serial Communication
* Understanding of PLC integration, HMI systems, machine vision, and factory automation.
* Knowledge of robotic cell design, safety standards, and risk assessment methodologies.
* Proficiency in robot simulation and offline programming software.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and debugging skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a cross\-functional manufacturing environment.



  





**Qualifications** 



* Diploma / B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Relevant experience in industrial robotics, automation, or manufacturing engineering preferred.



  





**Experience:** 



* 4\-8 years

title: ADAS & Autonomous Driving Data Replay Engineer – SIL/HIL
description:
**Location:** 
 Pune, Maharashtra
 



**Work Mode:** 
 Mandatory Work from Office
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




1. Build, deploy, maintain, and operate autonomous driving data replay environments, including both Software\-in\-the\-Loop (SIL) and Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HIL) testing systems and their associated software and hardware infrastructure.
2. Perform replay, processing, and analysis of real\-world vehicle data collected from autonomous driving and ADAS testing, including camera/vision data, LiDAR, millimeter\-wave radar, vehicle bus data, and other relevant sensor data.
3. Evaluate the performance and quality of autonomous driving and ADAS algorithms based on real\-world recorded data and replay test results. Support issue reproduction, root\-cause analysis, and verification of algorithm improvements after software iterations.
4. Operate and maintain data replay workstations, servers, networking equipment, and associated hardware infrastructure to ensure stable and efficient execution of replay and validation tasks.
5. Work closely with algorithm, testing, and overseas R\&D teams to analyze issues, drive issue closure, and continuously improve algorithm quality. Prepare test results and analysis reports when required.
6. Support continuous improvement of the data replay toolchain, testing workflows, and automation capabilities to improve the efficiency of data processing and algorithm validation.



  





**Qualifications** 




  





**Education** 



* Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Vehicle Engineering, Automation, Electronic Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Degree from a top\-tier university in India is preferred.



  





**Technical Skills** 



* Strong knowledge of Ubuntu/Linux, with hands\-on experience in software deployment, system operation, and troubleshooting in Linux environments.
* Proficiency in Python, with practical experience in software development, data processing, or test automation.
* Knowledge of C/C\+\+ is preferred.
* Familiarity with autonomous driving and ADAS sensor data, including camera/vision, LiDAR, and millimeter\-wave radar, as well as their data structures, formats, and processing pipelines.
* Familiarity with autonomous driving data collection, data processing, data replay, software development, and algorithm validation workflows.
* Understanding of Software\-in\-the\-Loop (SIL) and Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HIL) testing methodologies and system architectures.
* Familiarity with the operation and maintenance of servers, workstations, networking equipment, and related hardware systems.
* Strong troubleshooting, system debugging, and problem\-solving skills.



  





**Experience** 



* At least 2 years of professional experience in autonomous driving, ADAS, data platforms, testing and validation, or a related field.
* Hands\-on experience in at least one complete autonomous driving/ADAS data replay, algorithm validation, or related testing project, covering activities such as environment setup, test execution, issue analysis, and validation closure.
* Experience with large\-scale autonomous driving data processing, SIL/HIL testing, algorithm regression testing, or real\-world issue reproduction is preferred.



  





**Other Requirements** 



* Good English communication skills and the ability to work effectively with engineering teams in Singapore, China and other overseas locations.
* Strong teamwork, ownership, and ability to independently troubleshoot and resolve technical issues.
* **This is a mandatory work\-from\-office role based in Pune. Candidates must be willing to work onsite.**



  





**Interested candidates can send their CV to hi@maprgo.com.**

 At Juspay, Associate Product managers take end to end product ownership, juggling between building the product, managing operations and evangelizing our creation with our customers.
 



  





**Being a Creator** 
 :
 



 Can PMs become TRUE creators? Can they CODE? Can they Design? Can they analyze data programmatically?
 



 Yes they do it here! We offer unique opportunities for PMs to upskill themselves and overlap with Devs and Designers. We believe PMs should participate in the creation process and make product specifications that is close to implementation.

* Own the vision of the organization
* Develop and foster a deep understanding of
* *Domain* 
 \- Payments
* *Technology* 
 \- Purescript/Haskell
* *Design* 
 \- Mobile UX/UI (Tools: Sketch, Flinto)

 \- Payments user journey and conversions (Tools: SQL, Tableau \& data science programming)

 \- CxOs, Sr. Executives, PMs and Devs of Merchants, Banks and Vendors
* Improve \& optimise product development processes continuously



  





**Apply if you have :** 



1. Aspiration for value creation
2. Aspiration for quality
3. Genuine user empathy
4. Openness and patience to learn harder things
5. Systematic approach to problem solving
6. Attitude and ability to get\-things\-done
7. Effectively balance big picture / details
8. Self\-motivated and driven
9. Persuasive without being forceful
10. The Giver attitude

* MBA with 1\-3 years of professional experience in Product Management.
* Strong strategic mindset along with exceptional execution capabilities and rigor.
* Proven expertise in stakeholder management
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to plan, coordinate and execute assigned tasks via collaboration with multiple cross functional teams



  





**Why work in Juspay?** 




  





***Payments.. big deal?***




 Yes, it is a big deal. The wind is strongly blowing in favor of electronic payments \- India wants to buy/order everything online, go cashless (regulation) and can’t have enough of using smartphones! Startups and internet businesses currently see a payment’ success rate of 60% ( 40 out of 100 people fail during the payments process!). These businesses that will define our future are absolutely dependent on solving digital payments. Big industry with bigger problems to solve!

 Payments is a complex ecosystem involving banks, RBI regulations, payment networks, telecom infrastructure, online and offline merchants. There is no way to align all these stars without radical engineering innovation. Talk to us about it.

 You get the opportunity to work in a free liberal environment with some of the best engineers and entrepreneurs. For us office is like home with everything needed to make us comfortably code all day and chill out too. We take an active interest in helping people reach their highest potential.

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**Associate Product Manager**




**Location:** 

 Pune \- On\-Site
 




**Type:** 

 Full\-Time
 




**Reporting To:** 

 Head of Engineering
 




  





**About omniXM**




 omniXM is a fast\-growing SaaS company building intelligent customer experience management products. Our flagship AI product, omniXMOS, includes a conversational survey analysis engine, omniSense, that processes real\-world business feedback at scale. The system combines deterministic data tools, LLM\-powered reasoning, multi\-modal report generation, and document\-grounded RAG \- all served through a FastAPI backend and deployed on Azure.
 



 We are scaling our Product team to drive the next phase of omniSense: smarter agentic workflows, richer insights, and AI experiences our customers can trust. We are looking for an experienced Technical Product Manager to own product development end\-to\-end and partner closely with our AI Engineering team.
 



  





**The Role**




 As an Associate Product Manager, you will work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, QA, Customer Success, and other stakeholders to help build and improve omniXM's AI\-powered products.
 



 You will initially focus on
 **learning the product, understanding customer problems, documenting requirements, supporting product execution, and working closely with engineering teams** 
 .
 



 As you gain product knowledge and demonstrate the ability to independently make sound product decisions, your responsibilities will expand toward
 **owning features, modules, and eventually an entire product independently** 
 .
 



 This role is ideal for someone who wants to build a long\-term career in Product Management and is willing to learn the business, technology, customers, and product development process from the ground up.
 



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities**




**1\. Product Understanding \& Discovery** 




 · Develop a deep understanding of omniXM products, customers, use cases, and business objectives.
 



 · Understand customer problems and translate them into potential product opportunities.
 



 · Participate in product discovery discussions with Product, Customer Success, Sales, and Engineering teams.
 



 · Study existing product functionality, workflows, user journeys, and areas for improvement.
 



 · Research competing products and industry trends to support product decisions.
 



 · Develop a strong understanding of how AI capabilities can be applied to solve customer problems.
 



  





**2\. Requirements \& Product Documentation** 




 · Assist in gathering and analyzing requirements from internal and external stakeholders.
 



 · Create clear and structured
 **PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, workflows, and functional specifications** 
 under guidance initially.
 



 · Convert business requirements into actionable requirements for Engineering and Design.
 



 · Identify gaps, dependencies, edge cases, and potential risks in requirements.
 



 · Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date product documentation.
 



 · Learn to define requirements for AI\-powered features where outputs may not always be deterministic.
 



  





**3\. Product Development \& Execution** 




 · Work closely with Engineering and Design teams throughout the development lifecycle.
 



 · Participate in backlog grooming, sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies.
 



 · Help prioritize and manage product backlog items.
 



 · Track feature development and ensure requirements are clearly understood by Engineering.
 



 · Follow up on dependencies, blockers, and delivery timelines.
 



 · Coordinate with QA to ensure features are tested against defined requirements.
 



 · Participate in product releases and post\-release validation.
 



 · Gradually take ownership of features and product modules as capability develops.
 



  





**4\. Product Quality \& Validation** 




 · Review developed features against requirements and acceptance criteria.
 



 · Create or contribute to test scenarios and acceptance criteria.
 



 · Work with QA to identify functional gaps and edge cases.
 



 · Perform product validation before and after releases.
 



 · Identify product usability issues and recommend improvements.
 



 · Develop an understanding of quality considerations for AI/LLM\-powered features, including accuracy, relevance, hallucination risks, and user trust.
 



  





**5\. Cross\-functional Collaboration** 




 · Work closely with Engineering, AI/ML, QA, Design, Customer Success, Sales, and other teams.
 



 · Communicate requirements and product decisions clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
 



 · Participate in customer discussions when required to understand product problems and feedback.
 



 · Ensure customer feedback is captured and translated into actionable product insights.
 



 · Help maintain alignment between customer needs, business priorities, and engineering execution.
 



  





**6\. Product Analytics \& Continuous Improvement** 




 · Track product usage and customer feedback to identify opportunities for improvement.
 



 · Learn to define and monitor product KPIs and success metrics.
 



 · Analyze feature adoption and user behavior.
 



 · Support product experiments and validation of new ideas.
 



 · Use data and customer insights to support product decisions.
 



  





**7\. Progression Towards Product Ownership** 




 The successful candidate is expected to progressively take on greater responsibility.
 



  





**During the initial 3 months:** 




 · Learn the product and domain deeply.
 



 · Understand the existing product architecture and workflows.
 



 · Learn our product development processes.
 



 · Work closely with senior Product and Engineering leadership.
 



 · Take ownership of smaller features and product improvements.
 



  





**By approximately 6 months:** 




 Based on performance and demonstrated capability, the candidate is expected to be ready to:
 



 · Independently manage a defined product/module.
 



 · Own requirements and prioritization for the assigned area.
 



 · Work directly with Engineering and QA.
 



 · Manage the product backlog.
 



 · Coordinate releases.
 



 · Interact with customers/stakeholders where required.
 



 · Make day\-to\-day product decisions independently.
 



 · Take accountability for the outcomes of the assigned product area.
 



  





**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**




 We are looking for a
 **high\-potential early\-career Product professional** 
 , not someone who simply wants to perform coordination or documentation work.
 



 The ideal candidate should be:
 



 · Curious and genuinely interested in how products are built.
 



 · Comfortable asking questions and challenging assumptions.
 



 · Strong at breaking complex problems into smaller, actionable pieces.
 



 · Comfortable working with engineers and understanding technical concepts.
 



 · Highly organized and detail\-oriented.
 



 · A strong communicator, both written and verbal.
 



 · Comfortable working in an ambiguous and fast\-moving startup environment.
 



 · Willing to take ownership rather than wait for instructions.
 



 · Analytical and comfortable using data to support decisions.
 



 · Able to learn quickly and independently.
 



 · Interested in AI, SaaS, technology products, and emerging AI capabilities.
 



  





**QUALIFICATIONS**




**Required** 




**· 1\+ years of experience** 
 in Product Management, Associate Product Management, Product Analysis, Business Analysis, Technical Product roles, or a similar function.
 



 · Experience working on software/SaaS products.
 



 · Basic understanding of product development lifecycle.
 



 · Familiarity with Agile/SCRUM methodologies.
 



 · Exposure to creating product documentation, user stories, requirements, workflows, or similar artifacts.
 



 · Good understanding of software applications and how users interact with them.
 



 · Strong written and verbal communication skills.
 



 · Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability.
 



 · Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred.
 



  





**Good to Have** 




 · Experience working with B2B SaaS products.
 



 · Experience working closely with Engineering teams.
 



 · Exposure to AI/ML/LLM\-based products.
 



 · Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Figma, Miro, or similar product tools.
 



 · Experience creating wireframes or user flows.
 



 · Basic understanding of APIs, databases, and software architecture.
 



 · Experience working with customer\-facing teams.

**Education**

title: Product Manager-I/II
description:
About Lokal :
   

  

 In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier\-2/3 towns weren't really using
   

  

 the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they'd come
   

  

 back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and,
   

  

 eventually, something they used for almost everything online.
   

  

 This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place \& one app \- local updates, classifieds,
   

  

 jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight \- when one use case
   

  

 outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation
   

  

 of focused companies \& marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
   

  

 Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
   

  

 to connect Tier\-2/3\+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they've always deserved.
   

  

**We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:**
* Edutainment \& Skill Learning \- practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
* Matrimonial Matchmaking \- hyperlocal, compatibility\-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
* Agri Consulting \- farmer\-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
* Local Jobs \- blue\- and grey\-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
* Social \& Community \- Place to find \& post social updates (Lokal app)
* Emotional Well\-being \& Peer Support \- safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt \& Eaze)
* Astrology \& Guidance \- instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)


 Advisory Services \- early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more
   

  

**Requirements**
**Role Overview : We are hiring a Product Manager to lead key initiatives. You'll own high\-impact projects across pricing, growth, user retention, expansion, and platform strategy—working closely with cross\-functional teams to scale Products at Lokal.
   

  

 Responsibilities :**
* Drive product strategy to maximize conversion and retention through data\-driven analysis of supply\-side


**levers and their business impact.**
* Own and enhance payment systems by improving payment success metrics, optimizing payment gateway


**(PG) Integrations, And Elevating The Overall Checkout Experience.**
* Design and run pricing experiments including default pricing, cohort\-based pricing, discounting models,


**and repeat\-user strategies to optimize revenue growth.**
* Collaborate with Marketing to unlock and scale new acquisition channels while continuously optimizing


**performance.**
* Strengthen trust and user satisfaction by defining and improving profile verification workflows and

title: Software Product Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Pronto Networks builds connectivity hardware designed for businesses that cannot afford network downtime, including restaurants, retailers, kiosks, and multi\-site operators where every transaction matters. Headquartered in Walnut Creek, CA with a global engineering footprint, the company designs and manufactures cellular routers, Wi\-Fi 6 access points, LTE/5G gateways, and Wi\-Fi HaLow (802\.11ah) devices for always\-on environments across hospitality, retail, healthcare, education, and smart cities. Pronto Networks is distinguished by its focus on POS and payments, delivering PCI\-compliant, high\-uptime solutions for mission\-critical deployments. Its cellular\-first design and OpenWrt\-based firmware give IT teams deep control, while certifications such as FCC and PTCRB support B2B and channel partners including VARs, MSPs, and OEMs. The company provides the radios, firmware, and support needed for enterprises modernizing connectivity across large, distributed deployments.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Software Product Manager role based in Indore. The Software Product Manager will own the product lifecycle for connectivity and networking software, including defining product vision, gathering and prioritizing requirements, and aligning features with customer and market needs. The role includes close collaboration with engineering to plan releases, write clear user stories, review technical designs, and monitor execution against scope and timelines. The Software Product Manager will analyze usage data and customer feedback to refine the roadmap, improve user experience, and drive product performance and reliability. Day\-to\-day responsibilities also involve coordinating cross\-functional stakeholders, managing project risks and dependencies, preparing product documentation, and supporting sales, marketing, and customer success teams with product insights.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess strong Software Product Management and Product Management skills, including roadmap ownership and requirements definition.
* Candidates should possess solid Software Development understanding, enabling effective collaboration with engineering and informed technical decision\-making.
* Candidates should possess robust Project Management skills to plan releases, manage timelines, and coordinate cross\-functional teams.
* Candidates should possess advanced Analytical Skills to interpret data, prioritize features, and measure product outcomes.
* Experience with networking, connectivity, or embedded systems products is highly beneficial.
* Proven ability to work with global engineering teams and communicate clearly with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field; a master’s degree or MBA is a plus.
* Familiarity with agile methodologies, product analytics tools, and user\-centric design practices is desirable.

title: Product Manager
description:
**About PhonePe Limited:**
 Headquartered in India, its flagship product, the PhonePe digital payments app, was launched in Aug 2016\. As of April 2025, PhonePe has over 60 Crore (600 Million) registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 4 Crore (40\+ million) merchants. PhonePe also processes over 33 Crore (330\+ Million) transactions daily with an Annualized Total Payment Value (TPV) of over INR 150 lakh crore.
   

  

 PhonePe’s portfolio of businesses includes the distribution of financial products (Insurance, Lending, and Wealth) as well as new consumer tech businesses (Pincode \- hyperlocal e\-commerce and Indus AppStore Localized App Store for the Android ecosystem) in India, which are aligned with the company’s vision to offer every Indian an equal opportunity to accelerate their progress by unlocking the flow of money and access to services.
   

  

**Culture:**
 At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe\-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!
   

  

**Challenges**
 Building for Scale, Rapid Iterative Development and Customer\-centric Product Thinking at each step defines every day for a developer at PhonePe. Though we engineer for a 50million\+ strong user base, we code with every individual user in mind. While we are quick to adopt the latest in Engineering, we care utmost for security, stability, and automation. Apply if you want to experience the best combination of passionate application development and product\-driven thinking
   

  

**Role**
 As the product manager solving growth focused problems, you will own and drive the vision and road map for products driving customer growth for both PhonePe and PhonePe’s merchant partners. You will be responsible for evangelizing and executing on the road map. You will work closely with internal and external stakeholders cutting across, business, technology, regulatory and industry. You will be responsible for defining, designing and detailing these growth solutions. You will also be responsible for delivery of the solutions working with cross\-functional, distributed teams. Finally, you will be key in helping us maintain our product agility and extend our leadership in delivering innovative growth focused solutions that run reliably at scale.
   

  

 This role will require deep problem\-solving acumen as well as strong communication and negotiation skills. Most of all it will require a proven track record of shipping world\-class product solutions, preferably in consumer facing products.
   

  

**Required Skills**
* Deep understanding of marketing tech stacks, industry trends, technology development and evolving customer needs
* Excellent negotiation skills and verbal and written communications skills
* Extremely analytical and data driven; ability to derive actionable conclusions from large data sets
* Proven customer champion
* Proven ability in delivering results in a fast\-paced, rapid\-growth environment
* Team player; ability to interface and build relationships at all levels internally and externally
* Experienced in influencing disparate stakeholders and working with cross functional teams across multiple locations and business units

 Glance AI is an AI commerce platform shaping the next wave of e\-commerce with inspiration\-led shopping, less about searching for what you want and more about discovering who you could be. Operating in 140 countries, Glance AI transforms every screen into a stage for instant, personal, and joyful discovery, where inspiration becomes something you can explore, feel, and shop in the moment.
   

  

 Its proprietary models, seamlessly integrated with Google’s most advanced AI platforms, Gemini and Imagen on Vertex AI, deliver hyper\-realistic, deeply personal shopping experiences across categories such as fashion, beauty, travel, accessories, home décor, pets, and more. Designed to seamlessly integrate into everyday consumer technology, Glance AI reimagines the future of e\-commerce with inspiration\-led discovery and shopping.
   

  

 With an open architecture built for effortless adoption across hardware and software ecosystems, Glance AI is creating a platform that can become a staple in everyday consumer technology. It partners with the world’s leading smartphone makers, connected TV manufacturers, telecom providers, and global brands — meeting people where they are: on mobile, smart TVs, and brand websites.
   

  

 Through Glance AI’s rich first\-party data and unparalleled consumer access, it harnesses InMobi’s global scale, insights, and targeting capabilities to create high\-impact, performance\-driven shopping journeys for brands worldwide. Part of the InMobi Group, a global technology and advertising leader reaching over 2 billion devices and serving more than 30,000 enterprise brands worldwide, Glance AI is backed by Google, Jio Platforms, and Mithril Capital.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Glance AI is building AI\-native consumer experiences for millions of users. We are looking for a Product Manager who combines strong consumer\-product judgment with a builder’s mindset. Someone who thinks deeply about how a product feels and behaves, not just what
   

  

 features it has.
   

  

 You will own consumer\-facing experiences end to end, from understanding the user problem and shaping the experience to launch, adoption, engagement, and iteration. This is a role for someone who moves fast, stays close to users and design, and is comfortable changing direction when a better idea emerges.
   

  

**What You’ll Own**
* Own consumer journeys and experiences, not just individual features.
* Identify meaningful user problems and turn them into clear product priorities.
* Work closely with design to shape intuitive, engaging, and differentiated interactions.
* Think deeply about flows, states, feedback, discovery, and how users experience the product end to end.
* Drive activation, engagement, retention, and repeat usage.
* Work with engineering and AI teams to understand what is possible, where the experience can break, and the right product trade\-offs.
* Use user behavior, research, experiments, and judgment to improve the product continuously.
* Prioritize sharply and move ideas from decision to users quickly.


**What We’re Looking For**
* 3–6 years of product management experience, preferably in consumer technology.
* Experience building and shipping consumer products used at meaningful scale.
* Strong product taste and an instinct for good UX and interaction design.
* A deep understanding of user behavior and what makes experiences intuitive, useful, and habitforming.
* Ability to look beyond a feature request and solve the underlying user problem.
* Strong execution and prioritization skills.
* Comfort working through ambiguity and making decisions without perfect information.
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration with design, engineering, data, and business teams.
* A hands\-on relationship with generative AI.


 You may have already shipped GenAI products, or you may be a strong consumer PM who actively experiments with AI and builds with it. What matters is that you are curious about what AI makes possible and can translate that into experiences that feel genuinely better for users.
   

  

**How We Work**
 We believe great products are built through strong judgment, rapid iteration, and close attention to the user experience. We test ideas early, learn quickly, and do not become attached to a solution simply because we built it. The best idea wins. We care about shipping, but shipping is not the goal. Building an experience users understand, enjoy, and return to is.

title: Category Associate -  Brand Curation
description:
**Company Description** 
 Dil Foods, through its Dil Brands vertical, creates and operates virtual food brands designed to serve the daily meal needs of people across India. By partnering with small and medium\-sized restaurants, Dil Brands helps them improve utilization of their existing kitchen assets and resources. This model enables restaurant partners to expand their customer reach and revenue without significant additional investment.
 



  





 This is not your run\-of\-the\-mill food role.
 



 We're building new food brands and cuisines from scratch and we're looking for someone who genuinely loves food, loves trying new cuisines, and wants to help conceptualize the next brand before it exists.
 



 If you've trained at IHM, come from a food\-tech background, or have hands\-on experience across Indian, Continental, or Asian kitchens and you're structured, process\-driven, and detail\-obsessed as much as you're creative \- this is that role.
 



 You'll work closely with our category head to spot gaps in the market, help conceptualize menus for new brands, and make sure everything behind the scenes \- from recipe details to product shoots to vendor samples runs without anything falling through the cracks.
 



 What you'll be doing:
 




 ●     
 
 Helping identify new brand and cuisine opportunities, and conceptualizing menus from the ground up
 




 ●     
 
 Tagging every recipe accurately and consistently \- ingredients, allergens, cuisine, and category so the menu stays clean and reliable as it scales
 




 ●     
 
 Coordinating product shoots end to end\- from planning and scheduling to being on\-set to make sure every dish is captured right
 




 ●     
 
 Tracking all product trials from kitchen to launch, so nothing gets lost in the process
 




 ●     
 
 Coordinating with vendors to source new samples and managing that relationship over time
 




 ●     
 
 Analyzing customer behavior, pricing, assortment, demand, and competition
 




 ●     
 
 Supporting the launch, optimization, and retirement of products based on performance
 




 ●     
 
 Improving availability, throughput, and wastage through data\-driven decisions
 



 Who we're looking for:
 



 Someone early in their career (0\-3 years) with a genuine food background \- creative enough to conceptualize a dish or a brand, and structured enough to track ten product trials at once without losing the thread. IHM grads, food\-tech professionals, and anyone who's spent real time in a kitchen and wants to move into brand and category building are especially encouraged to apply.
 



 If you love food, love discovering new cuisines, and want to help build brands from the very first idea to the final shoot \- let's talk.

title: Technical Program Manager – Data Center Infrastructure Deployments
description:
**About Nebius** 




  





 Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full\-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in\-house AI/ML infrastructure.
 



 Built by engineers, for engineers. From large\-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.
 



 Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R\&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500\+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R\&D.
 



  





**The role** 




  





 As a Technical Program Manager, you will own the delivery of a defined workstream within large\-scale GPU and data center infrastructure deployment programs. In this role you’ll be responsible for tracking progress, managing dependencies, and ensuring your workstream is delivered on time and at quality.
 



 This is a hands\-on role at the intersection of infrastructure, execution, and coordination, with strong exposure to real\-world data center delivery.
 



 Travel: On\-site presence at data centers will be required during key deployment phases.
 



  





**Your Responsibilities Will Include** 




  




* Own delivery of a defined workstream within a larger data center or infrastructure program.
* Track scope, schedule, and dependencies, escalating risks when needed.
* Coordinate with engineering, networking, construction, and operations teams.
* Maintain clear and structured reporting on progress, risks, and blockers.
* Support vendor and contractor coordination within your scope.
* Work closely with the Senior TPM to align on priorities and execution approach.



  





**Technical Scope \& Expectations** 




  





 This role requires exposure to physical infrastructure environments, not only software\-based projects.
 



  





**You Should Be Comfortable Working With Or Learning About** 




  




* Data center environments: basic understanding of infrastructure readiness (power, cooling, space, networking dependencies).
* Compute infrastructure: knowledge about server and storage equipment.
* Networking: cabling, connectivity, and integration dependencies.
* Deployment \& bring\-up: understanding how systems move from installation to operational readiness.



 You are not expected to be an expert, but you should:
 


* Be willing to learn technical concepts quickly.
* Understand how different parts of infrastructure depend on each other.
* Identify when something is not ready or at risk and escalate appropriately.
* Communicate effectively with technical teams.



  





**We Expect You To Have** 




  




* 2–5 years of experience in program management, operations, or technical coordination roles.
* Ability to organize work, track progress, and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
* communication skills and ability to work with cross\-functional teams.
* Structured thinking and attention to details.
* Willingness to learn and grow in a fast\-paced, technical environment.



  





**It will be an added bonus if you have** 




  




* Exposure to data center, networking, or hardware\-related projects,
* Familiarity with program management tools (Jira, Asana, etc.),
* Understanding of cloud environments infrastructure,
* Certifications or coursework in program management.



  





**Benefits \& Perks** 




  




* Competitive compensation
* Career growth and learning opportunities
* Flexibility and ownership
* Collaborative and innovative culture
* Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
* International environment and talented teams



  





**What's It Like To Work At Nebius** 




  





 Fast moving \- Bold thinking \- Constant growth \- Meaningful impact \- Trust and real ownership \- Opportunity to shape the future of AI
 



  





**Equal Opportunity Statement** 




  





 Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
 



 Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.
 



 If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

description:
**Overview**
 Microsoft is a company where passionate innovators come to collaborate, envision what can be and take their careers further. This is a world of more possibilities, more innovation, more openness, and the sky is the limit thinking in a cloud\-enabled world.
   

  

 Microsoft’s Azure Data engineering team is leading the transformation of analytics in the world of data with products like databases, data integration, big data analytics, messaging \& real\-time analytics, and business intelligence. The products our portfolio include Microsoft Fabric, Azure SQL DB, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure PostgreSQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, and Power BI. Our mission is to build the data platform for the age of AI, powering a new class of data\-first applications and driving a data culture.
   

  

 Within Azure Data, the Microsoft Fabric platform team builds and maintains the operating system and provides customers a unified data stack to run an entire data estate. The platform provides a unified experience, unified governance, enables a unified business model and a unified architecture.
   

  

 We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to strengthen how Fabric Quality measures, reports, and acts on service health — a top organizational focus and a critical effort for the business. This role builds trusted reporting, automates the manual workflows behind the quality rhythm, and standardizes service\-health telemetry and metrics, so "healthy" means the same thing across teams and raw signal becomes insight leaders and engineering teams act on. The team moves quickly, and the role calls for comfort working in an agile, fast\-paced environment.
   

  

 The work is hands\-on and cross\-team: identifying gaps across scenarios, defining the success criteria and metrics that matter, and ensuring the telemetry behind them is complete and trustworthy. It suits a TPM who executes reliably across multiple workstreams, cares about data correctness and consistency, and is proficient with telemetry, reporting, and automation — Power BI / DAX, Kusto, and scripting to remove manual toil. Working through ambiguity, developing hypotheses and solutions, and coordinating across engineering and data teams to land defined problems end\-to\-end — with a bias toward repeatable, AI\- and automation\-assisted workflows — rounds out the profile.

* Partner with engineering and data teams to onboard scenarios with complete, accurate telemetry, clear ownership, and measurable targets — and to refine the data pipelines, reporting models, and sampling strategies that keep signals consistent and accurate across environments.
* Identify monitoring gaps across key customer journeys, improving signal quality and ensuring issues are detected early with minimal noise.
* Support LiveSite by helping define alerting thresholds and partner with teams during incidents to investigate performance regressions and reliability issues, identify root causes, and drive follow\-up actions.

 Embody our culture and values

title: Scrum Master
description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision\-making through our leading AI\-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.
 



 What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.
 



 Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies who rely on our best\-in\-class platform.
 



 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
 
 our wins – big and small.
 



 Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next \- together!
 



 We are seeking an experienced and passionate Scrum Master to be the agile leader and performance coach for our engineering development teams. In this role, you will champion a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and predictable delivery. You will be the hands\-on partner to your teams, empowering them to deliver high\-quality, valuable software while fostering an environment where they can do their best work. If you are passionate about building teams that are both happy 
 *and* 
 high\-performing, and you thrive on guiding people to achieve tangible results, this is the role for you.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities** 



* Empower the team to run their own team ceremonies by providing the necessary support, tools, and guidance. Acting as a supportive figure to ensure meetings become team\-led, productive, and value\-driven.
* ensuring they are engaging, productive, and focused on delivering value.
* Act as a subject matter expert on lean and agile principles, ensuring the team to develop, own, and refine an effective process that consistently delivers value based on the chosen frameworks principles and practices.
* Promote transparency by maintaining clear reporting and visible Agile dashboards (e.g., burn\-down charts, flow metrics), making the team's progress and challenges understood by all.
* Coach the team towards greater self\-organization, cross\-functional collaboration, and a strong sense of ownership for their outcomes.
* Drive a culture of continuous improvement, guiding the team to use metrics to identify and solve bottlenecks or delays in their workflow
* Partner closely with the Product Owner to ensure the product backlog is healthy, well\-groomed, and prioritized to deliver maximum business value.
* Proactively identify, track, and relentlessly remove impediments and risks that are impacting the team's progress, protecting their flow and productivity.
* Act as a key collaborative partner to the Agile Delivery Manager (ADM), providing on\-the\-ground visibility into team\-level risks and working together to resolve systemic, domain\-level blockers.
* Facilitate productive communication and collaboration between the team and external stakeholders, ensuring alignment and clear expectations.



**Your Qualifications** 



* Proven Experience: 3\+ years of dedicated experience as a Scrum Master or Agile Coach in a software development environment, with a track record of improving team performance and health.
* Deep Agile Knowledge: Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or equivalent certification is required. You have a deep understanding of the principles behind Scrum, Kanban, and other agile methodologies, and you know when and how to apply them to get results.
* A Coach's Mindset: You don't just facilitate; you coach. You have demonstrable experience mentoring teams and individuals to foster self\-organization and a growth mindset. You are an empathetic listener and a powerful question\-asker.
* Data\-Driven Facilitator: You are comfortable using agile metrics not as a report card, but as a tool to help teams have insightful conversations and drive their own improvement.
* Exceptional Communicator: You have excellent moderation, facilitation, and conflict\-resolution skills. You can communicate complex topics clearly and effectively to a variety of audiences, from engineering teams to stakeholders.
* Technical Fluency: You are proficient with agile project management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence).



**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)** 




 We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!
 



 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  
 



**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer** 
  
 



 It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.
 



 Anaplan does not:  
 


* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.



 All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.
