 The Scrum Master at Cvent (SM) facilitates processes, escalates impediments, manages risk, and helps to drive continuous improvement at the team level. The scrum master acts as a servant leader to the team and promotes scrum best practices and coaches the team to track and constantly improves its velocity. The Scrum Master is expected to handle 2\-3 Sprint teams as a Scrum Master.
   

  

**Position Duties**
* Helps to establish sprint cadence.
* Coordinates with product owners to keep the sprint team’s backlog ready and groomed.
* Facilitates sprint planning, review, daily scrum, refinement meetings, and retrospective events at the team level.
* Publishes committed sprint objectives.
* Identifies and escalates impediments.
* Manage team or project level risks and issues and take corrective actions to mitigate them, develop mitigation strategies and support the teams in addressing challenges.
* Maintains relevant metrics to help the team monitor their performance.
* Coordinates elements of the sprint plan with other technology staff outside of the project.
* Take responsibility for managing dependencies within the sprint team as well as those dependencies from other development or operations teams.
* Participates as well as facilitate Scrum of Scrums.
* Encourages Architect, UX, QT and Sprint team collaboration.
* Coordinates timely response and support to production line customer issues and helps to ensure that team maintains adherence to Service Level Agreements (SLA).
* Facilitate Project / Epic estimation process.
* Identify and promote opportunities for integrating AI tools and automation into team processes for improved efficiency (e.g., backlog refinement, reporting, estimation, or retrospective analysis).

* Stakeholder Communication: Serve as a key point of contact for stakeholders regarding project progress and deliverables, ensuring they are informed and engaged throughout the project lifecycle.
* Actively encourage and guide the team in applying AI\-driven insights to optimize workflows, improve sprint predictability, and address bottlenecks.
* Communicates sprint/team or project status to stakeholders at a fixed cadence.
* Coordinate work teams consisting of R\&D / SRE / Cloud Operations / blended teams using agile methodologies.
* Promotes adherence to Agile software development best practices.
* Ensure team members have the necessary resources to complete their tasks.
* Ensure that sprint team deliverables meet the required quality standards.
* Drives continuous improvement initiatives at the team level.
* Collaborate with team members and stakeholders to identify and resolve issues.
* Acts as an Agile coach to the development team.
* 4\-7 years of technical experience including 2\-5 years of experience as a Scrum Master or Agile Coach.
* Understanding backlog tracking, burn down metrics, velocity, task definition, and other Agile terminology.
* Large/enterprise application development experience using Agile methodologies preferred but not required.
* Strong leadership, time management, conflict resolution, and analytical skills.
* Able to act as servant leader at the team level or project level.
* Situational Awareness \- Must be the first to notice differences and issues as they arise, make all necessary attempts to solve them before elevating them to management.

title: Visual Designer - Brand, Digital & AI Creatives
description:
**🎨 Hiring: Visual Designer \- Brand, Digital \& AI Creatives** 




 📍 Gurgaon, Haryana \| Full\-time \| In\-office
 



 🗓️ 6\-day work week
 



 🚀 Early\-stage, high\-ownership role
 



 🎯 Experience: 2–5 years of experience \| Freshers with strong portfolios \& design sense are also welcomed
 



  





**Before You Apply** 




 This is an in\-office role based in Gurgaon with a six\-day work week. Aumraa is an early\-stage startup, so this opportunity is best suited for someone who enjoys ownership, speed, experimentation and frequent feedback. You will work in an environment where responsibilities evolve quickly and your work directly shapes the brand.
 



 Please apply only if you are comfortable building from the ground up rather than working within a fully established design system.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We’re looking for an early\-career Visual Designers (Freshers to 2\-5 years of experience) to help build Aumraa’s visual identity across social media, digital campaigns, packaging, e\-commerce, ads, website visuals, and brand communication. You’ll work closely with the founder and team to create visuals that feel premium, devotional, modern, and culturally rooted.
 



  





**Who We Are** 




 Aumraa is building a mobile\-first faith\-tech product for modern Indian users \-  bringing together rituals, spiritual guidance, sacred products, and community into one seamless experience. We are reimagining how people engage with faith in everyday life by blending ancient wisdom with modern design, technology, and storytelling.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 



* Design high\-quality creatives for social media, ads, website, emailers, banners, campaigns, and e\-commerce.
* Build brand guidelines and evolve brand identity: visual language, typography systems, color and campaign crafts
* Create high performing creatives for Meta, Google, FB and other performance channels, including Hinglish first framework for Tier 2 and 3 audiences.
* Design product packaging, labels, boxes, sleeves, inserts, stickers, and other print collaterals.
* Partner with AI at every stage: image generation, prompt\-driven creative production, and workflow automation
* Support building basic motion ready assets, reels, launch teasers, animated stories, and short\-form visual content whenever needed.
* Use AI tools for moodboards, visual exploration, product backgrounds, campaign ideas, mockups, and faster creative directions.
* Partner with AI at every stage: image generation, visual generation, prompt\-driven creative production, and workflow automation
* Work with the marketing, growth and product teams to make sure all brand communication looks consistent and premium.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 2–5 years of experience in visual design, graphic design, brand design, or digital design. Freshers with exceptional portfolio and design sense are also welcomed.
* Strong understanding of typography, composition, colour, hierarchy and spacing.
* You are a wizard in using AI tools and can use them tastefully in creative workflow
* Evidence of AI\-assisted creative work \- not only final images, but the thinking and process behind them.
* Ability to take a loose brief and develop it into a clear visual direction.
* Have experience or interest in packaging and print design



  





 Years of experience matter less to us than 
 **taste, thinking, craft, speed and intent** 
 . Strong freshers and junior designers with an exceptional portfolio are welcome to apply.
 



  





**Tools You’ll Likely Use** 



* **Design:** 
  Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign and Figma
* **AI ideation and workflows:** 
  ChatGPT, Claude or similar tools
* **AI image generation:** 
  GPT Image, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Recraft or similar
* **AI video and motion:** 
  Higgsfield, Runway, Sora or similar
* **Additional advantage:** 
  After Effects, Premiere Pro, CapCut, Blender or other motion tools



  





 We are not hiring based on a fixed tool checklist. We care about how effectively you combine tools to reach a strong final result.
 



  





**Portfolio Expectations** 




 Please apply with a portfolio that shows your visual design work. We would love to see examples of social media creatives, campaign visuals, brand design, packaging, e\-commerce graphics, ads, website banners, AI\-assisted explorations, or motion/video work.
 



  





 We care more about your visual taste, clarity, consistency, and creative thinking than fancy presentation.
 



  





**Bonus \& Perks** 



* Competitive salary based on experience and portfolio quality
* Direct founder mentorship and feedback
* Exposure to brand building, packaging, campaigns, digital design, AI workflows, and launch execution
* Access to premium AI and design tools
* High ownership in an early\-stage team
* A chance to proudly say: “I’m part of Aumraa’s launch team.
